# petal-elements

> Community-maintained Material 3 Expressive web components (Lit custom
> elements), continued from material-web. Tags are `petal-*`, classes
> `Petal*`, CSS custom properties `--md-*`. Sizes, colors and motion follow
> Jetpack Compose Material 3. Works in plain HTML and any framework. Not an
> official Google project.

Docs ship in the package under `docs/` (`node_modules/petal-elements/docs/`).
Each component page has usage, accessibility, Compose behavior, theming tokens
and, at the end, an API section with tables of properties (and their
attributes), methods, events and slots. Read the page of every component you
use before writing markup; do not guess attribute or slot names.

## Setup

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:opsz,wght,FILL,GRAD@20..48,400,0..1,0&display=block">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/petal-elements/tokens/css/sys.css">
<style>
  :root { color-scheme: light dark; --md-ref-typeface-brand: Roboto; --md-ref-typeface-plain: Roboto; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-large); }
  :not(:defined) { visibility: hidden; }
</style>
<script type="module">
  import 'petal-elements/button/filled-button.js'; // one import per component used
</script>
```

- `npm install petal-elements`; bare imports work with any bundler. Without a
  bundler, map `petal-elements/` and `lit` with an import map (see
  docs/quick-start.md), or import `petal-elements/all.js` for everything.
- `sys.css` defines all `--md-sys-*` / `--md-ref-*` tokens; colors use
  `light-dark()`, so set `color-scheme` on `:root`.
- `<petal-icon>name</petal-icon>` shows a Material Symbols icon by name; an
  `<svg>` works instead.
- Own text: `font: var(--md-sys-typescale-<display|headline|title|body|label>-<large|medium|small>)`.

## Rules

- Use only attributes, slots and events listed in the component's doc.
  Content goes in named slots (`slot="headline"`, `slot="icon"`, ...).
- Name icon-only controls with `aria-label`; give fields a `label`.
- `petal-*-button` and `petal-icon-button` submit their `<form>` by default;
  add `type="button"` for script-only buttons.
- Form controls (text fields, selects, checkbox, radio, switch, slider, date
  and time pickers) are form-associated: use `name`, `value`, `required` and
  `new FormData(form)` as with native inputs.
- Style through `--md-*` custom properties (each doc's *Theming* section) and
  `--md-sys-*` tokens; do not pierce shadow DOM; do not add transitions or
  animations to components (they move on springs by themselves).
- Layout: navigation bar under 600px wide, navigation rail from 600px
  (expanded from 840px), FAB fixed 16px from the bottom end.
- Do not set `role`/`aria-*` to change a component's role: they are moved to
  the inner element at runtime (`data-role`, `data-aria-*` on the host).

## Guides

- [Building pages](docs/building-pages.md): page setup, colors and surfaces, responsive app shell (bar, rail, drawer), FAB placement, settings / form / dialog / search / list-detail screens, an events table, frameworks (React, Vue, Angular), rules
- [Motion](docs/motion.md): motion schemes, the six springs as CSS (`--md-sys-motion-spring-<fast|default|slow>-<spatial|effects>` + `-duration`), what each component animates, mouse hover previews, `transitionTheme()`, View Transitions, reduced motion
- [Using in an existing site](docs/migrating.md): from material-web (`md-` to `petal-`), from hand-written components (mapping table), things that surprise people
- [Quick start](docs/quick-start.md): CDN, install, import, build
- [Material 3 Expressive features](docs/expressive.md): button sizes and shapes, toggle buttons, button groups, filled FABs
- [Theming](docs/theming/README.md), [color](docs/theming/color.md) (incl. generating a scheme from one color), [typography](docs/theming/typography.md), [shape](docs/theming/shape.md), [tokens](docs/tokens.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md), [support and browsers](docs/support.md)

## Components

Format: doc — import path(s) — tags — key attributes; slots; events.

### Actions

- [Button](docs/components/button.md) — `button/{filled,filled-tonal,outlined,elevated,text}-button.js` — `petal-filled-button` etc. — `size` (xsmall…xlarge), `shape` (round|square), `toggle`, `selected`, `trailing-icon`, `href`, `type` (submit|button|reset), `disabled`, `soft-disabled`; slots: default label, `icon`; events: `click`, `change` (toggle)
- [Icon button](docs/components/icon-button.md) — `iconbutton/{icon,filled-icon,filled-tonal-icon,outlined-icon}-button.js` — `petal-icon-button` etc. — `size`, `width` (narrow|default|wide), `shape`, `toggle`, `selected`, `href`, `icon-motion`, `flip-icon-in-rtl`, `aria-label-selected`; slots: default icon, `selected`, `badge`; events: `click`, `change`
- [Button group](docs/components/button-group.md) — `buttongroup/button-group.js` — `petal-button-group` — `size`, `connected`, `single-select`; slot: buttons (toggle buttons for selection)
- [Split button](docs/components/split-button.md) — `splitbutton/split-button.js` — `petal-split-button` — `variant` (filled|tonal|elevated|outlined), `size`, `checked`, `trailing-label`; slots: default label, `icon`, `trailing-icon`; events: `click` (main action), `change` (menu toggle; anchor a `petal-menu` to it)
- [Segmented button](docs/components/segmented-button.md) — `segmentedbutton/{segmented-button-set,segmented-button}.js` — `petal-segmented-button-set` (`multiselect`), `petal-segmented-button` (`label`, `selected`, `icon` slot); event: `segmented-button-set-selection` (`detail.index`, `detail.selected`)
- [FAB](docs/components/fab.md) — `fab/fab.js`, `fab/branded-fab.js` — `petal-fab` — `variant` (primary|secondary|tertiary|surface|filled-primary|filled-secondary|filled-tertiary), `size` (small|baseline|medium|large), `label` (extended), `expanded`, `lowered`, `follow-pointer`; slot: `icon`
- [FAB menu](docs/components/fab-menu.md) — `fabmenu/{fab-menu,fab-menu-item,toggle-fab}.js` — `petal-fab-menu` (`expanded`, `items-label`; slots: items, `button`), `petal-fab-menu-item` (default label, `icon`), `petal-toggle-fab` (`checked`; `icon`, `checked-icon`)
- [Floating toolbar](docs/components/floating-toolbar.md) — `floatingtoolbar/floating-toolbar.js` — `petal-floating-toolbar` — `orientation`, `expanded`, `colors` (standard|vibrant), `fab-position`; slots: default, `leading`, `trailing`, `fab`
- [Chips](docs/components/chip.md) — `chips/{assist,filter,input,suggestion}-chip.js`, `chips/chip-set.js` — `petal-chip-set` > `petal-assist-chip` | `petal-filter-chip` | `petal-input-chip` | `petal-suggestion-chip` — `label`, `elevated`, `selected` and `removable` (filter), `href`; slot: `icon`; events: `click`, `remove` (cancelable)

### Navigation

- [Top app bar](docs/components/top-app-bar.md) — `appbar/top-app-bar.js` — `petal-top-app-bar` — `headline`, `subtitle`, `size` (small|medium|large), `centered`, `heading-level`, `scroll-target`; slots: `navigation`, `actions`, `headline`, `subtitle`, `collapsed-headline`, `collapsed-subtitle`; sticks to the top, collapses on scroll
- [Bottom app bar](docs/components/bottom-app-bar.md) — `appbar/bottom-app-bar.js` — `petal-bottom-app-bar` — `flexible`, `hide-on-scroll`, `scroll-target`; slots: default actions, `fab`; event: `hide-change`
- [Navigation bar](docs/components/navigation-bar.md) — `navigationbar/{navigation-bar,navigation-bar-item}.js` — `petal-navigation-bar` (`selected-index`; event `change`) > `petal-navigation-bar-item` (`selected`, `href`, `icon-position`; slots: default label, `icon`, `selected-icon`, `badge`); 64px, position it yourself
- [Navigation rail](docs/components/navigation-rail.md) — `navigationrail/{navigation-rail,navigation-rail-item}.js` — `petal-navigation-rail` (`expanded`, `selected-index`; slots: items, `header`; event `change`) > `petal-navigation-rail-item` (as bar items)
- [Navigation drawer](docs/components/navigation-drawer.md) — `navigationdrawer/{navigation-drawer,navigation-drawer-item}.js` — `petal-navigation-drawer` (`type` modal|dismissible|standard, `open`; `show()`, `close()`; events `change`, `open`, `opened`, `close`, `closed`) > `petal-navigation-drawer-item` (slots: label, `icon`, `selected-icon`, `badge` = trailing count)
- [Tabs](docs/components/tabs.md) — `tabs/{tabs,primary-tab,secondary-tab}.js` — `petal-tabs` (`active-tab-index`, `scrollable`, `auto-activate`; event `change`) > `petal-primary-tab` | `petal-secondary-tab` (`active`, `inline-icon`; slots: label, `icon`); show the panels yourself
- [Search](docs/components/search.md) — `search/search-bar.js` — `petal-search-bar` — `value`, `placeholder`, `layout` (full-screen|docked), `expanded`; slots: default results (e.g. a `petal-list`), `leading`, `trailing`; events: `input`, `search` (Enter), `open`, `close`

### Containment and overlays

- [Card](docs/components/card.md) — `card/{filled,elevated,outlined}-card.js` — `petal-filled-card` etc. — `clickable`, `href`, `target`, `disabled`, `dragged`; slot: content (no padding); give clickable cards an `aria-label`
- [Carousel](docs/components/carousel.md) — `carousel/carousel.js` — `petal-carousel` — `variant` (multi-browse|uncontained|hero), `item-width`, `item-spacing`; children are the items; height 221px by default; `scrollToItem(i)`, `currentIndex`
- [Dialog](docs/components/dialog.md) — `dialog/dialog.js` — `petal-dialog` — `open`, `type="alert"`, `quick`; slots: `icon`, `headline`, `content` (a `<form method="dialog">`), `actions`; `show()`, `close()`, `returnValue`; events: `open`, `opened`, `close` (cancelable), `closed`, `cancel`
- [Bottom sheet](docs/components/bottom-sheet.md) — `sheet/bottom-sheet.js`, `sheet/standard-bottom-sheet.js` — `petal-bottom-sheet` (modal; `open`, `skip-partially-expanded`; `show()`, `close()`, `expand()`) and `petal-standard-bottom-sheet` (docked; `value` partially-expanded|expanded|hidden, `peek-height`, `hideable`; event `change`); slots: content, `drag-handle`
- [Menu](docs/components/menu.md) — `menu/{menu,menu-item,sub-menu,menu-group}.js` — `petal-menu` (`anchor` = id, `open`, `positioning` absolute|fixed|document|popover, `anchor-corner`, `menu-corner`, `single-radio`; events `opening`, `opened`, `closing`, `closed`, `close-menu`) > `petal-menu-item` (`type` menuitem|menuitemcheckbox|menuitemradio, `checked`, `keep-open`, `href`, `disabled`; slots: `headline`, `supporting-text`, `start`, `end`), `petal-sub-menu` (slots `item`, `menu`), `petal-menu-group`
- [Tooltip](docs/components/tooltip.md) — `tooltip/tooltip.js`, `tooltip/rich-tooltip.js` — `petal-tooltip` (`for` = anchor id; text) and `petal-rich-tooltip` (`for`, `persistent`, `caret`; slots: text, `title`, `action`)
- [Snackbar](docs/components/snackbar.md) — `snackbar/snackbar.js` — `petal-snackbar` — message text, `action`, `dismissible`, `duration`, `action-on-new-line`; `await show()` resolves `action` | `timeout` | `dismiss` | `close`
- [Badge](docs/components/badge.md) — `badge/badge.js` — `petal-badge` (`value`; empty = dot) in the `badge` slot of an icon button or navigation item
- [Divider](docs/components/divider.md) — `divider/divider.js` — `petal-divider` (`inset`, `inset-start`, `inset-end`)

### Lists

- [List](docs/components/list.md) — `list/list.js`, `list/list-item.js` — `petal-list` (`segmented`) > `petal-list-item` (`type` text|button|link, `href`, `selected`, `three-line`; slots: default/`headline`, `overline`, `supporting-text`, `trailing-supporting-text`, `start`, `end`)

### Inputs

- [Text field](docs/components/text-field.md) — `textfield/{filled,outlined}-text-field.js` — `petal-filled-text-field`, `petal-outlined-text-field` — `label`, `value`, `type` (text|email|number|password|search|tel|url|textarea|…), `required`, `error`, `error-text`, `supporting-text`, `prefix-text`, `suffix-text`, `placeholder`, `readonly`, `maxlength`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `pattern`, `autocomplete`, `rows`; slots: `leading-icon`, `trailing-icon`; events: `input`, `change`
- [Select](docs/components/select.md) — `select/{filled,outlined}-select.js`, `select/select-option.js` — `petal-outlined-select` > `petal-select-option` (`value`, `selected`; slot `headline`) — `label`, `value`, `required`, `error`, `error-text`, `supporting-text`; slots: options, `leading-icon`; events: `change`, `input`
- [Checkbox](docs/components/checkbox.md) — `checkbox/checkbox.js` — `petal-checkbox` — `checked`, `indeterminate`, `name`, `value`, `required`; event `change`; wrap in `<label>`
- [Radio](docs/components/radio.md) — `radio/radio.js` — `petal-radio` — `name` (group), `value`, `checked`; event `change`
- [Switch](docs/components/switch.md) — `switch/switch.js` — `petal-switch` — `selected`, `icons`, `show-only-selected-icon`, `name`, `value`; event `change`
- [Slider](docs/components/slider.md) — `slider/slider.js` — `petal-slider` — `min`, `max`, `step`, `value`, `ticks`, `labeled`, `value-label`, `range` with `value-start`/`value-end`; events `input` (drag), `change` (release)
- [Date picker](docs/components/date-picker.md) — `datepicker/{date-picker,date-picker-dialog}.js` — `petal-date-picker` (inline) and `petal-date-picker-dialog` (`show()`) — `value` (ISO `2026-10-21`), `min`, `max`, `locale`, `display-mode` (picker|input), `isDateSelectable`; event `change` (dialog: on OK)
- [Time picker](docs/components/time-picker.md) — `timepicker/{time-picker,time-picker-dialog}.js` — `petal-time-picker`, `petal-time-picker-dialog` — `value` (`HH:MM`, 24 h), `hour-cycle` (12|24), `locale`, `display-mode` (picker|input), `layout`; event `change`

### Feedback

- [Progress](docs/components/progress.md) — `progress/{linear,circular}-progress.js` — `petal-linear-progress`, `petal-circular-progress` — `value` (0–`max`, default max 1), `indeterminate`, `wavy`, `buffer` (linear), `four-color`, `animate-value`
- [Loading indicator](docs/components/loading-indicator.md) — `loadingindicator/loading-indicator.js` — `petal-loading-indicator` — `contained`, `value` (determinate)
- [Pull to refresh](docs/components/pull-to-refresh.md) — `pulltorefresh/pull-to-refresh.js` — `petal-pull-to-refresh` — `refreshing`, `scroll-target`; event `refresh` (set `refreshing = false` when done)

### Building blocks

- [Icon](docs/components/icon.md) — `icon/icon.js` — `petal-icon` — ligature text or `<svg>`, `filled`
- [Elevation](docs/components/elevation.md) — `elevation/elevation.js` — `petal-elevation` in a `position: relative` parent, `--md-elevation-level` 0–5
- [Focus ring](docs/components/focus-ring.md), [ripple](docs/components/ripple.md) — `focus/md-focus-ring.js` (`petal-focus-ring`), `ripple/ripple.js` (`petal-ripple`) for your own controls
- Form behaviors for your own form elements: `behaviors/*.js`

## Motion and theme APIs

- Springs as CSS: `transition: transform var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial-duration) var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial)`; standard (calmer) scheme: load `tokens/css/motion-standard.css` after `sys.css` — see docs/motion.md
- `transitionTheme(apply, event)` from `petal-elements/theme/theme-transition.js`: switch light/dark with a circle from the clicked control
- Mouse hover previews the press automatically; touch keeps Compose's look; `prefers-reduced-motion` turns movement off

## Machine-readable API

- `.d.ts` next to every `.js`; tags are declared in `HTMLElementTagNameMap`
- [custom-elements.json](custom-elements.json): a custom elements manifest. Each `petal-*` class extends a base class in an `internal/` module, and the inherited attributes, members, events and slots are on those base declarations (follow `superclass`)

## Optional

- [Support and browsers](docs/support.md)
- [Breaking changes in v2 (aria attributes)](migrations/v2/README.md)
- Source: https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements — catalog: https://petal.anontokyo.vip/catalog/

---

File: docs/building-pages.md

# Building pages

How to put the components together into a complete page: the page setup,
layouts for phones, tablets and desktops, common screens, and the rules that
keep a page correct. It is written for people and for coding assistants; each
component's own page has its full API.

## Page setup

Every page needs the tokens, a font, the icon font, a color scheme and the
components it uses.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>My app</title>

  
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:opsz,wght,FILL,GRAD@20..48,400,0..1,0&display=block">

  
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/node_modules/petal-elements/tokens/css/sys.css">

  <style>
    :root {
      color-scheme: light dark; /* follow the system; or `light` / `dark` */
      --md-ref-typeface-brand: Roboto; /* titles */
      --md-ref-typeface-plain: Roboto; /* text */
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--md-sys-color-surface);
      color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface);
      font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-large);
    }
  </style>

  <script type="module">
    import 'petal-elements/button/filled-button.js';
    import 'petal-elements/icon/icon.js';
  </script>
</head>
<body>
  <petal-filled-button>Start</petal-filled-button>
</body>
</html>
```

*   **Tokens.** `sys.css` defines every `--md-sys-*` and `--md-ref-*`
    property. Colors use `light-dark()`, so `color-scheme` on `:root` chooses
    light or dark.
*   **Imports.** Import one module per component you use
    (`petal-elements/<folder>/<name>.js`; see the list in
    [llms.txt](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/llms.txt)),
    or `petal-elements/all.js` for everything. With a bundler (Vite, esbuild,
    webpack) bare imports work as they are. Without one, map them with an
    import map:

    ```html
    <script type="importmap">
      {"imports": {"petal-elements/": "https://esm.run/petal-elements/", "lit": "https://esm.run/lit", "lit/": "https://esm.run/lit/"}}
    </script>
    ```

*   **Icons.** `<petal-icon>search</petal-icon>` shows the Material Symbols
    icon named `search`; the names are on
    [fonts.google.com/icons](https://fonts.google.com/icons). An `<svg>` works
    in its place.
*   **Type.** Use the type scale for your own text: `font:
    var(--md-sys-typescale-<role>)`, where `<role>` is `display-`,
    `headline-`, `title-`, `body-` or `label-` and `large`, `medium` or
    `small`. `--md-sys-typescale-emphasized-<role>` is the bolder Expressive
    variant. Or adopt the classes from
    `petal-elements/typography/md-typescale-styles.js` (`class="md-typescale-title-large"`).
*   **Before the components load**, custom elements are unstyled. Hide them
    until they are defined to avoid a flash:

    ```css
    :not(:defined) { visibility: hidden; }
    ```

## Colors and surfaces

Use the color roles, not fixed colors, so the page follows light and dark and
any theme:

| Part of the page | Background | Text and icons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Page | `--md-sys-color-surface` | `--md-sys-color-on-surface` |
| Secondary text | | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant` |
| Panels and sections on the page | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-low` (or `-container`, `-container-high`, `-container-highest` for more emphasis) | `--md-sys-color-on-surface` |
| Prominent areas | `--md-sys-color-primary-container`, `-secondary-container`, `-tertiary-container` | the matching `--md-sys-color-on-*-container` |
| Dividers and outlines | `--md-sys-color-outline-variant` (decorative), `--md-sys-color-outline` (important) | |
| Errors | `--md-sys-color-error`, `-error-container` | `--md-sys-color-on-error`, `-on-error-container` |

Shapes: `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small` (4px) to `-extra-large` (28px) and
`-full`. Shadows: put a `<petal-elevation>` inside a `position: relative`
element and set `--md-elevation-level` (0 to 5); prefer cards, which have it
built in.

**Theme from one color.** Generate the roles from a source color with
[`@material/material-color-utilities`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@material/material-color-utilities)
and set them on `:root`:

```js
import {argbFromHex, hexFromArgb, Hct, MaterialDynamicColors, SchemeTonalSpot} from '@material/material-color-utilities';

function applyTheme(hex) {
  const source = Hct.fromInt(argbFromHex(hex));
  const light = new SchemeTonalSpot(source, false, 0);
  const dark = new SchemeTonalSpot(source, true, 0);
  const roles = {
    'primary': MaterialDynamicColors.primary,
    'on-primary': MaterialDynamicColors.onPrimary,
    'primary-container': MaterialDynamicColors.primaryContainer,
    'on-primary-container': MaterialDynamicColors.onPrimaryContainer,
    'surface': MaterialDynamicColors.surface,
    'on-surface': MaterialDynamicColors.onSurface,
    // ... every role you use: secondary, tertiary, error, surface-container-*,
    // on-surface-variant, outline, outline-variant, inverse-*.
  };
  for (const [role, color] of Object.entries(roles)) {
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      `--md-sys-color-${role}`,
      `light-dark(${hexFromArgb(color.getArgb(light))}, ${hexFromArgb(color.getArgb(dark))})`,
    );
  }
}
```

See [Color](theming/color.md), [Typography](theming/typography.md),
[Shape](theming/shape.md) and [Theming](theming/README.md).

## Layout and navigation

Choose the layout from the window width, with Compose's window size classes
(`WindowWidthSizeClass`):

| Width | Class | Navigation | Margins |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| under 600px | compact (phones) | `petal-navigation-bar` at the bottom, or a modal `petal-navigation-drawer` for many destinations | 16px |
| 600 to 839px | medium (tablets, folded) | `petal-navigation-rail` | 24px |
| 840px and wider | expanded (desktops) | `petal-navigation-rail` (`expanded`), or a `type="standard"` `petal-navigation-drawer` | 24px |

Use three to five destinations in a navigation bar; more go in a drawer.

### App shell

A page with a top app bar, a navigation bar on phones and a rail on wider
windows:

```html
<div class="shell">
  <petal-navigation-rail class="rail" aria-label="Main">
    <petal-navigation-rail-item selected><petal-icon slot="icon">home</petal-icon>Home</petal-navigation-rail-item>
    <petal-navigation-rail-item><petal-icon slot="icon">search</petal-icon>Search</petal-navigation-rail-item>
    <petal-navigation-rail-item><petal-icon slot="icon">person</petal-icon>Profile</petal-navigation-rail-item>
  </petal-navigation-rail>

  <div class="main">
    <petal-top-app-bar headline="Home" heading-level="1">
      <petal-icon-button slot="actions" aria-label="Notifications"><petal-icon>notifications</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
    </petal-top-app-bar>
    <main class="content">...</main>
  </div>

  <petal-navigation-bar class="bar" aria-label="Main">
    <petal-navigation-bar-item selected><petal-icon slot="icon">home</petal-icon>Home</petal-navigation-bar-item>
    <petal-navigation-bar-item><petal-icon slot="icon">search</petal-icon>Search</petal-navigation-bar-item>
    <petal-navigation-bar-item><petal-icon slot="icon">person</petal-icon>Profile</petal-navigation-bar-item>
  </petal-navigation-bar>
</div>

<style>
  .shell { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; }
  .rail { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; flex: none; }
  .main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .content { padding: 0 24px 24px; max-width: 1040px; }
  .bar { position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0; z-index: 1; }

  @media (width < 600px) {
    .rail { display: none; }
    .content { padding: 0 16px calc(64px + 16px); } /* room for the 64px bar */
  }
  @media (width >= 600px) {
    .bar { display: none; }
  }
</style>

<script type="module">
  // Keep the bar and the rail on the same destination.
  const rail = document.querySelector('.rail');
  const bar = document.querySelector('.bar');
  const show = (index) => { /* render the page for this destination */ };
  for (const nav of [rail, bar]) {
    nav.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const index = nav.selectedIndex;
      rail.selectedIndex = index;
      bar.selectedIndex = index;
      show(index);
    });
  }
  // Expand the rail on wide windows.
  const wide = matchMedia('(width >= 840px)');
  const fit = () => (rail.expanded = wide.matches);
  wide.addEventListener('change', fit);
  fit();
</script>
```

*   The navigation items fire `change` on their container; read
    `selectedIndex`. Setting `selectedIndex` changes the selection without an
    event. Items with `href` are links instead.
*   `petal-top-app-bar` sticks to the top of the page. When an inner element
    scrolls instead of the page, give it an id and set `scroll-target` on the
    bar. `size="medium"` and `"large"` bars have a big title that collapses
    as the page scrolls. Put it inside the scrolling column, as above.
*   Put the navigation bar at the bottom with `position: fixed` and leave room
    for it under the content (the bar is 64px high, plus the safe area on
    phones).
*   On phones, a `petal-navigation-drawer` (modal) opened from a menu button
    in the top app bar's `navigation` slot is the alternative to the bar.

### Floating action button

Place the page's main action in a `petal-fab` at the bottom end, 16px from the
edges (Compose's `Scaffold`), above the navigation bar on phones:

```css
.fab {
  position: fixed;
  inset-inline-end: 16px;
  inset-block-end: 16px;
}
@media (width < 600px) {
  .fab { inset-block-end: calc(64px + 16px); }
}
```

On a rail, the FAB can go in the rail's `header` slot instead. For several
related actions use a `petal-fab-menu`.

### Content

*   Group related content in cards (`petal-filled-card`,
    `petal-elevated-card`, `petal-outlined-card`) or on surface-container
    panels; cards add no padding, so give their content 16px.
*   Lay out cards in a grid that adapts:
    `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 16px`.
*   Lists of rows (settings, messages, files) are `petal-list` with
    `petal-list-item`; put `petal-divider` between groups.
*   Keep text lines readable: a column of text at most about 70 characters
    wide.

## Common screens

### Settings

```html
<petal-list aria-label="Settings">
  <petal-list-item>
    <petal-icon slot="start">wifi</petal-icon>
    <div slot="headline">Wi-Fi</div>
    <div slot="supporting-text">Home network</div>
    <petal-switch slot="end" selected aria-label="Wi-Fi"></petal-switch>
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-list-item type="button" id="language">
    <petal-icon slot="start">language</petal-icon>
    <div slot="headline">Language</div>
    <div slot="supporting-text">English</div>
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-divider></petal-divider>
  <petal-list-item type="link" href="/about">
    <div slot="headline">About</div>
  </petal-list-item>
</petal-list>
```

### Form

Text fields, selects, checkboxes, radios, switches, sliders and the date and
time pickers are form-associated: put them in a `<form>` with `name`s and
read `new FormData(form)`, as with native inputs. Buttons submit by default.

```html
<form id="signup">
  <petal-outlined-text-field name="name" label="Full name" required autocomplete="name"></petal-outlined-text-field>
  <petal-outlined-text-field name="email" label="Email" type="email" required autocomplete="email"></petal-outlined-text-field>
  <petal-outlined-select name="plan" label="Plan" required>
    <petal-select-option value="free"><div slot="headline">Free</div></petal-select-option>
    <petal-select-option value="pro"><div slot="headline">Pro</div></petal-select-option>
  </petal-outlined-select>
  <label><petal-checkbox name="terms" required></petal-checkbox> I accept the terms</label>
  <div class="actions">
    <petal-text-button type="reset">Clear</petal-text-button>
    <petal-filled-button>Create account</petal-filled-button>
  </div>
</form>
<petal-snackbar id="done">Account created</petal-snackbar>

<style>
  #signup { display: grid; gap: 16px; max-width: 400px; }
  .actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; }
</style>

<script type="module">
  const form = document.querySelector('#signup');
  form.addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault(); // the browser has already checked required fields
    const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));
    await fetch('/api/signup', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(data)});
    document.querySelector('#done').show();
  });
</script>
```

*   Invalid fields show their message after the user submits, or after
    `reportValidity()`. For a server-side error, set `error` and
    `error-text` on the field (and clear them when it changes).
*   Text fields are at least 280px wide, as in Compose; let them fill a
    column with `width: 100%` instead of fixing smaller widths.
*   For a date, use a read-only text field with a calendar icon button that
    opens `petal-date-picker-dialog` (see [Date picker](components/date-picker.md#dialog));
    for a time, `petal-time-picker-dialog`.

### Confirmation and choices

*   Ask for a decision with `petal-dialog`: a `headline`, `content` and
    buttons in `actions`, with `returnValue` telling which one closed it.
    Use `type="alert"` for destructive actions.
*   Confirm a finished action with `petal-snackbar`, with an `action` such as
    Undo; `show()` resolves with `action` when it is pressed.
*   Offer actions on phones with `petal-bottom-sheet` (a list of actions in
    the sheet), and on wider windows with a `petal-menu` anchored to the
    button.

```js
const dialog = document.querySelector('#delete-dialog');
deleteButton.addEventListener('click', () => dialog.show());
dialog.addEventListener('close', async () => {
  if (dialog.returnValue !== 'delete') return;
  removeItem();
  const snackbar = document.querySelector('#deleted');
  if ((await snackbar.show()) === 'action') restoreItem();
});
```

### Search

Use `petal-search-bar` in the top area: on phones its view opens full screen,
on wider windows `layout="docked"` drops it below the bar. Put suggestions or
results (a `petal-list`) inside it and update them on `input`; see
[Search](components/search.md).

### Lists and details

On wide windows show the list and the selected item's details side by side
(two columns); on phones open the details as a new view with a back button in
the top app bar's `navigation` slot. A carousel (`petal-carousel`) shows a
row of images or featured items.

### Loading and progress

*   While loading a whole region, show `petal-loading-indicator` (the
    Expressive indicator) in its place.
*   For a task with known progress, `petal-linear-progress` (`value` from 0
    to 1, `wavy` for the Expressive look); `indeterminate` when unknown.
*   Content that refreshes on a pull goes in `petal-pull-to-refresh`.

## Wiring up events

| Component | Event | Read |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Buttons, icon buttons, FAB, cards with `clickable` | `click` | |
| Toggle buttons and icon buttons (`toggle`) | `change` | `selected` |
| Button group with `single-select` | `change` on the button | the button's `selected` |
| Segmented button set | `segmented-button-set-selection` | `event.detail.index`, `selected` |
| Text field | `input` (each change), `change` (committed) | `value` |
| Select | `change` | `value`, `selectedIndex` |
| Checkbox, switch | `change` | `checked` / `selected` |
| Radio | `change` | `value` of the checked radio |
| Slider | `input` (while dragging), `change` (released) | `value`, `valueStart`, `valueEnd` |
| Date and time picker (inline) | `change` | `value` (`2026-10-21`, `14:30`) |
| Date and time picker dialogs | `change` (on OK only) | `value` |
| Filter chip | `click` | `selected` |
| Input chip | `remove` (cancelable) | |
| Tabs | `change` | `activeTabIndex` |
| Navigation bar, rail, drawer | `change` (cancelable) | `selectedIndex`, `selectedItem` |
| Menu items | `click` on the item; the menu fires `close-menu` | |
| Dialog, sheet, drawer, menu | `open`, `opened`, `close`, `closed` (`opening`, `closing` for menus) | dialog `returnValue` |
| Snackbar | the promise from `show()` | `action`, `timeout`, `dismiss` |
| Search bar | `input` (typing), `search` (Enter); `open` and `close` of the view | `value` |
| Pull to refresh | `refresh` | set `refreshing = false` when done |

Set properties from script (`field.value = 'x'`, `dialog.show()`), and
attributes in HTML. Boolean attributes are on when present
(`<petal-switch selected>`).

## Frameworks

The components are standard custom elements, so they work in any framework.

*   **React 19** passes properties and events to custom elements:
    `<petal-switch selected={on} onchange={(e) => setOn(e.target.selected)} />`.
    With React 18 or older, set properties and add listeners through a `ref`.
*   **Vue**: tell the compiler the tags are custom elements:
    `compilerOptions: {isCustomElement: (tag) => tag.startsWith('petal-')}`
    (in `vite.config` for `@vitejs/plugin-vue`). Use `:value` / `.prop`
    bindings and `@change`.
*   **Angular**: add `CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA` to the component or module.
*   **Svelte, Lit, Astro, plain HTML**: no setup.
*   **TypeScript**: each module declares its tags in `HTMLElementTagNameMap`,
    so `document.querySelector('petal-dialog')` is typed. Types are in the
    `.d.ts` next to each `.js`.
*   **Server rendering**: the components can be rendered with Lit SSR
    (`@lit-labs/ssr`); they read the browser (window size, media queries) only
    after they are connected.

## Rules that keep a page correct

*   Read a component's page before using it; use only the attributes, slots
    and events it lists. Slot names are exact (`slot="headline"`, not
    `slot="title"`).
*   Name every icon-only control with `aria-label`; give fields a `label`.
*   Use `type="button"` on buttons inside a form that should not submit it.
*   Style components through their `--md-*` custom properties (listed under
    *Theming* on each page) and `::part()` where offered; do not reach into
    their shadow DOM, and do not add transitions or animations to them (see
    [Motion](motion.md)).
*   Do not set `role` or `aria-*` to change a component's role; they move to
    the inner element (see [Using in an existing site](migrating.md)).
*   Dialogs, menus with `positioning="popover"` and the select menu are in
    the top layer: `z-index` does not change their order.
*   Test in light and dark (`color-scheme`), at phone and desktop widths, with
    the keyboard, and with reduced motion.

File: docs/motion.md

# Motion

Components move on springs, like Jetpack Compose Material 3. This page lists
the springs, what each component animates, how to use the same springs in
your own CSS and script, page-level transitions, mouse hover, and reduced
motion.

Components animate by themselves. Do not add your own transitions or
animations to them; style your own elements with the springs below instead.

## Motion schemes

A motion scheme is a set of six springs. Compose has two:

*   **Expressive** (`MotionScheme.expressive()`, the default, as in Compose's
    `MaterialExpressiveTheme`). Spatial springs overshoot a little.
*   **Standard** (`MotionScheme.standard()`). Calmer, with almost no
    overshoot.

`tokens/css/sys.css` uses the expressive scheme. Load
`tokens/css/motion-standard.css` after it for the standard scheme on the whole
page:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/petal-elements/tokens/css/sys.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/petal-elements/tokens/css/motion-standard.css">
```

To use it for part of a page only, copy its rule into a class and put the class
on that part. `motion-expressive.css` switches back.

## Springs

| Spring | Use | Expressive (damping / stiffness) | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fast-spatial` | Small things that move or change shape: buttons, switches, chips | 0.6 / 800 | 0.9 / 1400 |
| `default-spatial` | Medium movements: menus, sheets, drawers, indicators | 0.8 / 380 | 0.9 / 700 |
| `slow-spatial` | Large movements: full-screen views, long distances | 0.8 / 200 | 0.9 / 300 |
| `fast-effects` | Quick color and opacity changes | 1 / 3800 | 1 / 3800 |
| `default-effects` | Color and opacity changes | 1 / 1600 | 1 / 1600 |
| `slow-effects` | Slow fades | 1 / 800 | 1 / 800 |

*Spatial* springs are for position, size and shape; *effects* springs for
color and opacity, which should not overshoot (their damping is 1).

Each spring is a set of CSS custom properties, which follow the page's scheme:

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `--md-sys-motion-spring-<name>` | The spring as a `linear()` easing, from 0 to 1 |
| `--md-sys-motion-spring-<name>-duration` | How long the spring takes to settle, for example `359ms` |
| `--md-sys-motion-spring-<name>-damping` | Damping ratio, for script |
| `--md-sys-motion-spring-<name>-stiffness` | Stiffness, for script |

The fixed `--md-sys-motion-expressive-spring-*` and
`--md-sys-motion-standard-spring-*` properties hold each scheme's values.

### In CSS

Use the easing and its duration together in a transition:

```css
.panel {
  transition:
    translate var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial-duration)
      var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial),
    opacity var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-effects-duration)
      var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-effects);
}

.panel.hidden {
  translate: 0 100%;
  opacity: 0;
}
```

A CSS transition restarts from the current value when it is interrupted, but
not with the current speed, as a real spring would. For most hover, toggle and
open-close changes this is not noticeable.

### In script

For the Web Animations API, read the same properties:

```js
const style = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
element.animate(
  [{transform: 'scale(0.8)', opacity: 0}, {transform: 'none', opacity: 1}],
  {
    duration: parseFloat(style.getPropertyValue('--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial-duration')),
    easing: style.getPropertyValue('--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial'),
  },
);
```

`-damping` and `-stiffness` give the spring's physics, for animations that
follow a drag or must keep their speed when the target changes.

### Older easing tokens

`--md-sys-motion-easing-*` (`standard`, `emphasized`, ...) and
`--md-sys-motion-duration-*` (`short1` to `extra-long4`) are the Material 3
easing curves and durations. Components no longer use them; prefer the
springs.

## What the components animate

All of these follow the page's motion scheme, and turn off with reduced
motion (see below).

| Component | Motion |
| --- | --- |
| Buttons (`size`) | Corners morph to the pressed shape on the default effects spring (no bounce, as Compose's `Button`); toggle buttons on fast spatial. See [Expressive](expressive.md). |
| Button group | The pressed button widens by 15% and the others make room, on fast spatial. |
| Icon button (`size`) | Corners morph to the pressed shape on default effects. |
| FAB | An extended FAB collapses to its icon (`expanded`) on fast spatial; the label fades on fast effects. |
| FAB menu | The button morphs into a close button; items come in one after another. |
| Floating toolbar | Expands and collapses on fast spatial. |
| Split button | The trailing button morphs while checked; its chevron turns. |
| Switch, checkbox, radio | The thumb moves and resizes on fast spatial; the check mark draws on default spatial; the radio dot grows on fast spatial. |
| Chips | A selected filter chip's check mark grows in on fast spatial. |
| Text field, select | The label floats on fast spatial; indicator and outline colors on fast effects. |
| Menu, select menu | Scales in from 80% from the anchor's corner and fades (default spatial and default effects); closes the same way back. |
| Dialog | Scales in from 80% and fades in; closes on fast effects. |
| Bottom sheet | Opens and settles on default spatial; dragged, it keeps the drag's speed. |
| Navigation drawer | Opens on default spatial, closes on fast effects. |
| Navigation bar, rail | The selection indicator grows from its center on default spatial; an expanding rail widens on default spatial. |
| Tabs | The indicator moves and resizes on default spatial. |
| Top app bar | Medium and large bars collapse as the page scrolls (the title follows the scroll); the container color changes when content scrolls under the bar. |
| Bottom app bar | `hide-on-scroll` slides it away; it settles on fast spatial. |
| Search | The view opens on slow spatial and closes on default spatial. |
| Carousel | Items grow and shrink as they scroll, following the scroll. |
| Date picker | Months slide (default spring for the arrows, default effects for a swipe); the year grid unfolds over the calendar on default effects. |
| Time picker | A tap moves the dial's handle on default spatial; the hour and minute faces cross-fade on default effects. |
| Loading indicator | Shapes morph into each other every 650ms while turning. |
| Progress | Wavy indicators move their wave; with `animate-value`, a new value is reached on slow spatial instead of jumping. |
| Pull to refresh | The flower opens with the pull, spins while refreshing, and folds and slides away when done. |
| Ripple | A circle grows from the pointer on press. |
| Lists, menus with groups | Item corners grow on hover, focus and selection on fast spatial. |

Endless animations (loading indicators, wavy progress) draw only while they
are in the viewport, and pick up again when they scroll back into view.

Each component's page describes its motion in detail under *Compose behavior*
or *Motion*. Methods that open and close (`show()`, `close()`) return promises
that resolve after the animation, and `quick` skips the animation where a
component has it.

## Mouse hover

With a mouse or trackpad, components preview their press: they go 30% of the
way toward their pressed look while hovered, on the fast spatial spring, and
back on the default spatial one. This is a petal-elements addition (Compose
has no hover shapes). It needs no setup.

*   Sized buttons and icon buttons: corners toward the pressed shape.
*   Button groups: the hovered button widens a little and connected inner
    corners tighten.
*   Switches: the thumb grows toward its pressed size.
*   Clickable cards: lift 3px, with a light that follows the pointer.
*   Icon buttons: the icon moves by its name (`arrow_forward` forward,
    `settings` turns, `favorite` grows); `icon-motion` chooses or turns it off.
*   FAB with `follow-pointer`: moves up to 4px toward a near pointer.

Touch screens (`(hover: none)` or a coarse pointer) keep Compose's look.

## Page transitions

### Theme switch

`transitionTheme(apply, origin)` from `theme/theme-transition.js` changes the
theme with a circle that grows from the pressed control, using the View
Transitions API.

```js
import {transitionTheme} from 'petal-elements/theme/theme-transition.js';

toggle.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
  transitionTheme(() => {
    const dark = document.documentElement.style.colorScheme !== 'dark';
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = dark ? 'dark' : 'light';
  }, event);
});
```

`apply` makes the change; `origin` is the click event, an element, or
`{x, y}`. It returns a promise that resolves when the transition ends. Without
View Transitions support, or with reduced motion, it applies the change at
once. See [Theming](theming/README.md#theme-transition).

### Your own page transitions

For changes between views of a single-page app, use the View Transitions API
with the springs:

```js
function go(render) {
  if (!document.startViewTransition || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
    render();
    return;
  }
  document.startViewTransition(render);
}
```

```css
::view-transition-group(*) {
  animation-duration: var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial-duration);
  animation-timing-function: var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial);
}

::view-transition-old(root),
::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-effects-duration);
}
```

Give shared elements (a card and the detail page's header) the same
`view-transition-name` so that one grows into the other.

## Reduced motion

When the system asks for reduced motion
(`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`), components change at once: no shape
morphs, slides, scales, ripples, waves or hover movement. Colors still
change, and hover still changes shapes, without movement.

Do the same in your own styles:

```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .panel {
    transition-duration: 0s;
  }
}
```

Check for it in script before starting an animation, as above with
`matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')`.

---

File: docs/migrating.md

# Using petal-elements in an existing site

This guide is for moving a site to petal-elements: from material-web, or
from hand-written Material 3 components or another UI kit, one component at a
time. It is written to be read by people and by coding assistants. The
package ships with it: `node_modules/petal-elements/docs/migrating.md`.

For new pages, start with [Building pages](building-pages.md).

## Where to look things up

| What | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Component list and import paths | `node_modules/petal-elements/llms.txt` |
| Page setup, layouts, common screens, events | `node_modules/petal-elements/docs/building-pages.md` |
| Springs, component motion, page transitions, reduced motion | `node_modules/petal-elements/docs/motion.md` |
| Properties, methods, events, slots, tokens of one component | `node_modules/petal-elements/docs/components/<name>.md` (the *API* section at the end) |
| Exact types | the `.d.ts` next to each `.js`, or `node_modules/petal-elements/custom-elements.json` |
| What changed between versions | `node_modules/petal-elements/CHANGELOG.md` |

Read the component's doc before writing markup. Do not guess attribute names:
they follow the docs, which follow Jetpack Compose where a Compose component
exists.

## From material-web

petal-elements is a continuation of material-web (`@material/web`).

| material-web | petal-elements |
| --- | --- |
| `<md-filled-button>`, `MdFilledButton` | `<petal-filled-button>`, `PetalFilledButton` |
| `import '@material/web/button/filled-button.js'` | `import 'petal-elements/button/filled-button.js'` (same paths) |
| `@material/web/all.js` | `petal-elements/all.js` |
| `--md-*` custom properties | the same names |
| Typescale styles `@material/web/typography/md-typescale-styles.js` | `petal-elements/typography/md-typescale-styles.js` (same `md-typescale-*` classes) |
| No system token stylesheet; tokens set by hand or generated | `petal-elements/tokens/css/sys.css`, loaded once |
| `labs/navigationbar`, `labs/navigationtab`, `labs/navigationdrawer` | `petal-navigation-bar`, `petal-navigation-rail`, `petal-navigation-drawer` |
| `labs/segmentedbutton` | `segmentedbutton/` (`petal-segmented-button-set`) |
| `labs/card` | `card/` (`petal-filled-card`, ...) |
| `labs/badge` | `badge/badge.js` (`petal-badge`) |
| `labs/behaviors`, `labs/item` | `behaviors/`, `item/` (the labs paths re-export them until 1.0) |

1.  Replace `md-` with `petal-` in tags and `Md` with `Petal` in class names,
    and `@material/web/` with `petal-elements/` in imports. CSS stays.
2.  Load `tokens/css/sys.css` and set `color-scheme` on `:root` (see
    [Building pages](building-pages.md#page-setup)).
3.  Expect the components to look and move like Jetpack Compose Material 3:
    newer token values (v34), springs, sizes and the Expressive features. See
    [Token update v0.192 → v34](token-update-v34.md) and the list below.
4.  Remove workarounds for things the components now do: press animations,
    custom ripples, menu and dialog animations, badge positioning.

## Steps

1. **Install** `npm install petal-elements`, or copy a packed build into the
   site (for example `public/vendor/petal-elements/`) and map the bare
   specifier with an import map.
2. **Load tokens once** in the page head, before any component renders:

   ```html
   <link rel="stylesheet" href="/node_modules/petal-elements/tokens/css/sys.css">
   <style>:root { color-scheme: light dark; }</style>
   ```

   The springs are expressive (they overshoot a little); add
   `motion-standard.css` after it for calmer ones.
3. **Set fonts and the theme**, see below.
4. **Replace one kind of component at a time** (all buttons, then all
   dialogs, ...). Import only what the page uses:
   `import 'petal-elements/button/filled-button.js'`.
5. **Compare before and after** in light and dark mode. Where petal looks
   different from what the site had, decide whether petal is right (usually
   it is: it follows Compose) before restyling.
6. **Report defects and missing features** to the petal-elements repository
   instead of patching around them in the site.

## Theme and fonts

- Colors, shapes, type and motion are CSS custom properties named
  `--md-sys-*`, `--md-ref-*` and `--md-<component>-*`. A site that already uses
  these names mostly keeps its theme.
- Components do not inherit the page font. Set
  `--md-ref-typeface-brand` (titles) and `--md-ref-typeface-plain` (body and
  labels) on `:root`.
- Icons use the Material Symbols font (`--md-icon-font`); load the font
  yourself. `<petal-icon>` text is the ligature name, for example
  `<petal-icon>search</petal-icon>`.

## Mapping from common hand-written parts

| Site has | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Primary, secondary, tonal, outlined, text buttons | `petal-filled-button`, `petal-filled-tonal-button`, `petal-outlined-button`, `petal-text-button`, `petal-elevated-button`; `size` and `shape` for Expressive sizes, `toggle` for toggle buttons |
| Segmented buttons | `petal-segmented-button-set` with `petal-segmented-button`, or a connected `petal-button-group` for the Expressive look |
| Split button (action plus dropdown arrow) | `petal-split-button` with a `petal-menu` |
| Icon buttons | `petal-icon-button` and the filled, tonal, outlined variants; `size` (`xsmall` to `xlarge`), `width`, `shape` |
| Floating action button | `petal-fab` (`size`, `variant`, `label` for extended, `expanded` to shrink to the icon), `petal-branded-fab` |
| FAB that opens a speed-dial | `petal-fab-menu` with `petal-fab-menu-item` and `petal-toggle-fab` |
| Floating action bar | `petal-floating-toolbar` (horizontal or vertical) |
| Modal | `petal-dialog` |
| Toast or snackbar | `petal-snackbar` (`show()` returns a promise) |
| Bottom sheet or action sheet | `petal-bottom-sheet` (`show()` and `close()` return promises) |
| Hover hint | `petal-tooltip` with `for="<anchor id>"` |
| Dropdown or context menu | `petal-menu` with `petal-menu-item`, `petal-sub-menu`, `petal-menu-group` |
| Sticky header | `petal-top-app-bar` (`size`, `headline`, collapses on scroll) |
| Bottom navigation | `petal-navigation-bar` with `petal-navigation-bar-item` |
| Side navigation | `petal-navigation-rail` with `petal-navigation-rail-item` (collapsed or expanded), or `petal-navigation-drawer` (`type`: `modal`, `dismissible`, `standard`) with `petal-navigation-drawer-item` |
| Search box with suggestions | `petal-search-bar` (full-screen or docked view) |
| Theme switch with a circular reveal | `transitionTheme()` from `theme/theme-transition.js` |
| Pull-to-refresh | `petal-pull-to-refresh` |
| Spinner | `petal-loading-indicator` (Expressive) or `petal-circular-progress` |
| Progress bar | `petal-linear-progress` (`wavy` for the Expressive style) |
| Cards | `petal-filled-card`, `petal-elevated-card`, `petal-outlined-card` |
| Lists and settings rows | `petal-list` and `petal-list-item` (`segmented` for Expressive) |
| Inputs | `petal-filled-text-field`, `petal-outlined-text-field`, `petal-filled-select`, `petal-outlined-select` |
| Checkbox, radio, switch, slider | `petal-checkbox`, `petal-radio`, `petal-switch`, `petal-slider` |
| Tabs | `petal-tabs` with `petal-primary-tab` or `petal-secondary-tab` |
| Chips | `petal-assist-chip`, `petal-filter-chip`, `petal-input-chip`, `petal-suggestion-chip` in a `petal-chip-set` |
| Date input or calendar | `petal-date-picker` (inline) or `petal-date-picker-dialog` opened from a read-only text field; `value` is an ISO date |
| Time input or clock | `petal-time-picker` or `petal-time-picker-dialog`; `value` is `HH:MM` |
| Image slider or featured row | `petal-carousel` (`variant` multi-browse, uncontained or hero) |
| Bottom toolbar with actions | `petal-bottom-app-bar` (`fab` slot, `hide-on-scroll`) |
| Popover with a title and a link | `petal-rich-tooltip` (`persistent` when it has an action) |
| Panel docked at the bottom, page still usable (maps) | `petal-standard-bottom-sheet` |
| Count or dot on an icon | `petal-badge` in the `badge` slot of an icon button or navigation item |
| Hover effects | Built in: components preview their press with a mouse (see [Motion](motion.md#mouse-hover)); remove hand-written hover transforms |

## Things that surprise people

- **Form controls are form-associated.** Text fields, checkboxes, radios,
  switches, sliders and selects take part in `<form>` and `FormData`; use
  `name` and `value` as on native inputs.
- **`role` and `aria-*` attributes move at runtime** to `data-role` and
  `data-aria-*` on the host. Selectors like `[aria-label="..."]` stop
  matching; see `migrations/v2/README.md`.
- **The `hidden` attribute works** on every component.
- **Icons are not filled by inheritance.** `font-variation-settings` on a
  parent no longer reaches `petal-icon`. Use the `filled` attribute, or set
  `--md-icon-fill: 1` on a parent.
- **Menus** open anchored: give the menu an `anchor` (an element id) and call
  `show()` or set `open`. Radio and checkbox items
  (`type="menuitemradio"` / `"menuitemcheckbox"`) keep `checked` themselves and
  fire `change`.
- **Dialog scrim is in the top layer.** Nothing on the page can sit above an
  open dialog; z-index does not apply.
- **Top app bar** headings: set `heading-level="1"` when it is the page title.
  Use `scroll-target="<id>"` when an inner element scrolls, nothing when the
  page does.
- **Pull-to-refresh** needs a height when it is the scroller; with
  `scroll-target="page"` it follows the page scroll. Set `refreshing` back to
  `false` yourself when the work is done.
- **Press ripple** is a circle that grows from the pointer (and starts at
  once on touch), not a fill of the whole element. Each press adds a ripple,
  and the earlier one keeps spreading and fades out. With the system's
  reduce-motion setting on, the press ripple is not shown (hover and focus
  state layers stay). Remove hand-written ripple code when you migrate.
- **Button groups:** pressing a button widens it and squeezes its neighbours,
  in both standard and connected groups. Do not add your own press animation.
- **Menus** scale in from 80% and fade, from the corner next to the anchor,
  not by growing in height. Remove custom open animations. Menu items are
  48px high with 12px side padding and 14px medium text (Compose's
  `DropdownMenuItem`); to keep the old 56px items, set
  `--md-menu-item-one-line-container-height: 56px` and the
  `--md-menu-item-*-space` and `--md-menu-item-label-text-*` tokens.
- **Motion is the expressive spring scheme by default**
  (`--md-sys-motion-spring-*`), as in Compose's `MaterialExpressiveTheme`.
  For the calmer standard springs, load `tokens/css/motion-standard.css`
  after `sys.css`. Components follow `prefers-reduced-motion`, so do not
  add your own motion for them.
- **Theme switching:** to change light and dark with a circle growing from the
  pressed control, call `transitionTheme(apply, event)` from
  `petal-elements/theme/theme-transition.js`. `apply` changes the theme (for
  example sets `document.documentElement.style.colorScheme`); `event` is the
  click, an element, or `{x, y}`. It uses the View Transitions API and just
  applies the change without it or with reduced motion. It returns a promise
  that resolves when it ends. Replace a site's own `startViewTransition` code
  with it instead of stacking both.
- **Dialog** opens by scaling up from 80% and fading, with 16px under the
  headline and stacked buttons when they do not fit. Remove custom open and
  close animations.
- **FAB** sizes follow Compose: `small`, `baseline` (the default, 56px),
  `medium`, `large`; the default `variant` is `primary`. With `label` it is an
  extended FAB.
- **Text fields and selects** follow Compose: at least 280px wide, a 2px
  focused indicator, no hover state. The select menu is as wide as the field
  (`no-clamp-menu-width` for the old behavior) and its options are 48px high.
  Set an explicit `width` or `min-width` if a layout depended on narrower
  fields.
- **Checkbox, radio and switch** follow Compose sizes and spring animations;
  per-state color tokens still work, but hover, focus and press no longer
  recolor the outline or thumb.
- **List items** follow Compose's `ListItem`: use the `selected` property, and
  `three-line` for overline plus two lines of text. Item corners are 4px and
  grow on hover, focus and selection, so do not add your own corner radius.
- **Menus with groups:** groups keep their own shapes when reopened; use
  `no-inactive-shape` to turn off the smaller shape after hover. With
  `single-radio` on the menu, all radio items across groups form one set.
- **Labs navigation is gone.** The old `labs/navigationbar`,
  `labs/navigationtab` and `labs/navigationdrawer` were removed; use
  `petal-navigation-bar`, `-rail` and `-drawer`.
- **Linear progress** has round lines, a 4px gap before the track and a stop
  indicator; the track is secondary-container. Set
  `--md-linear-progress-track-height: 8px` for the thick Expressive look.
- **Circular progress** is 40px, not 48px; set
  `--md-circular-progress-active-indicator-width` as a length (`4px`), not a
  percentage.
- **Sliders** have Compose's bar handle and gapped 16px track. The
  `*-state-layer-*`, `handle-elevation` and `*-track-shape` tokens are gone.
- **`labs/gb` and `labs/aria` are gone** (`petal-gb-*`, `petal-aria-*`).
  Use the stable components: `petal-button`, `petal-menu`, `petal-tabs` and
  so on.
- **Behaviors and `petal-item` left labs:** import
  `petal-elements/behaviors/*.js` and `petal-elements/item/item.js`. The old
  `labs/behaviors/` and `labs/item/` paths re-export them until 1.0.
- **The labs badge moved** to `petal-elements/badge/badge.js`
  (`petal-badge`, still with `value`). Put it in the `badge` slot of an icon
  button or a navigation item instead of positioning it yourself.
- **Tooltips** show on focus only when the anchor shows a focus ring
  (`:focus-visible`), not after a pointer choice.
- **Text fields** forward `enterkeyhint`, `spellcheck` and `autocapitalize`;
  use `no-counter` to hide the character counter.

- **Buttons submit forms.** A `petal-*-button` inside a `<form>` is a submit
  button unless it has `type="button"`, as with `<button>`.
- **Slots tell content apart.** List items, menu items and select options take
  `headline`, `supporting-text`, `start` and `end`; dialogs take `headline`,
  `content` and `actions`. Each component's *Slots* table lists them.
- **Mouse hover previews the press.** With a mouse, sized buttons, icon
  buttons, button groups, switches and clickable cards change toward their
  pressed look while hovered, and icon buttons move their icon by its name
  (`icon-motion="none"` turns that off). Remove hand-written hover transforms.
- **The carousel needs a height.** `petal-carousel` is 221px high by default;
  set `height` (or `--md-carousel-height`). Its children are the items.

## Prompts that work well for coding assistants

> Migrate the buttons in `src/components/` to petal-elements. Read
> `node_modules/petal-elements/llms.txt` and `docs/migrating.md` first, then
> the doc for each component you use. Keep the markup structure; change one
> component kind per commit. List anything petal cannot do instead of working
> around it.

> petal-elements is in `D:\Project\petal-elements`. Pack it into
> `public/vendor/` and use `<petal-...>` for X and Y on the settings page.
> Collect every defect or missing feature as a list for me; do not patch the
> vendor copy.

File: docs/quick-start.md

# Quick start

## CDN

For fast prototyping, we recommend using [esm.run](https://esm.run/),
a CDN that allows you to use `petal-elements` without installing and building
from NPM.

```html
<head>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/petal-elements/tokens/css/sys.css" rel="stylesheet">
  <script type="importmap">
    {
      "imports": {
        "petal-elements/": "https://esm.run/petal-elements/"
      }
    }
  </script>
  <script type="module">
    import 'petal-elements/all.js';
    import {styles as typescaleStyles} from 'petal-elements/typography/md-typescale-styles.js';

    document.adoptedStyleSheets.push(typescaleStyles.styleSheet);
  </script>
</head>
<body>
  <h1 class="md-typescale-display-medium">Hello petal-elements!</h1>
  <form>
    <p class="md-typescale-body-medium">Check out these controls in a form!</p>
    <petal-checkbox></petal-checkbox>
    <div>
      <petal-radio name="group"></petal-radio>
      <petal-radio name="group"></petal-radio>
      <petal-radio name="group"></petal-radio>
    </div>
    <petal-outlined-text-field label="Favorite color" value="Purple"></petal-outlined-text-field>
    <petal-outlined-button type="reset">Reset</petal-outlined-button>
  </form>
  <style>
    form {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
    }
  </style>
</body>
```

For production, follow the [install](#install) and [build](#building) steps
below.

## Install

Install petal-elements with
[npm](https://nodejs.org).

```shell
npm install petal-elements
```

## Import

Import element definitions from
`petal-elements/<component>/<component-variant>.js`.

```js
// index.js
import 'petal-elements/button/filled-button.js';
import 'petal-elements/button/outlined-button.js';
import 'petal-elements/checkbox/checkbox.js';
```

## Tokens

Load `tokens/css/sys.css` for the full set of system tokens: colors for light
and dark mode, typography, shapes, elevation and motion. The components work
without it (they fall back to the light baseline values), but dark mode and
most theming need it.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/petal-elements/tokens/css/sys.css">
<style>
  :root {
    color-scheme: light dark; /* follow the system setting */
  }
</style>
```

Other stylesheets in `tokens/css/`:

-   `sys-medium-contrast.css`, `sys-high-contrast.css`: colors with more
    contrast. They contain only colors; load one after `sys.css`.
-   `motion-standard.css`: switches the motion springs from the expressive
    scheme (the default, with a little bounce) to the calmer standard scheme.
    Load it after `sys.css`. (`motion-expressive.css` switches them back, for
    part of a page.)

Each file is also available as a Lit `CSSResult`
(`tokens/css/sys.cssresult.js` exports `styles`).

### Fonts

Components do not inherit the page's font: their text uses the typescale
tokens, which fall back to Roboto. To use your own font, set the two typefaces
([typography](theming/typography.md)):

```css
:root {
  --md-ref-typeface-brand: 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; /* headlines, titles */
  --md-ref-typeface-plain: 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; /* body, labels */
}
```

Icons use the Material Symbols font (`--md-icon-font`); see
[icons](components/icon.md).

## Usage

Use the `<component-name>` tag in HTML markup. Refer to the
[component docs](components/) for more guidance on using each component.

[Playground](https://lit.dev/playground/#gist=37d28012c5ec6de30809bdf4a6e26cb6)

```html
<script type="module" src="./index.js"></script>

<label>
  Remember me
  <petal-checkbox checked></petal-checkbox>
</label>

<petal-outlined-button>Back</petal-outlined-button>
<petal-filled-button>Next</petal-filled-button>
```

## Building

petal-elements uses bare module specifiers that must be resolved with
tools until [import maps](https://github.com/WICG/import-maps) are
adopted.

We recommend following
[lit.dev's modern build for production](https://lit.dev/docs/tools/production/#modern-only-build)
for a more in-depth build guide.

### Rollup quick start

For a quick start, we recommend using [Rollup](https://rollupjs.org/)
to resolve bare module specifiers into a bundled file.

Install Rollup and a plugin to resolve bare module specifiers.

```shell
npm install rollup @rollup/plugin-node-resolve
```

Create a bundle from an entrypoint `index.js` file and use it in a `<script>`
`"src"` attribute.

```shell
npx rollup -p @rollup/plugin-node-resolve index.js -o bundle.js
```

```html
<script src="./bundle.js"></script>
```

File: docs/expressive.md

# Material 3 Expressive features

Additions on top of the components inherited from material-web. Values come from the
Material Design web tokens v34 (see [tokens.md](tokens.md)); behavior follows
Jetpack Compose Material 3. Where Compose's `*Defaults` deliberately override a
token, the components follow Compose, and this page lists each case.

All additions are opt-in: without the new attributes, components look and
behave as before.

## Buttons: sizes, shapes, toggle

Applies to `petal-filled-button`, `petal-filled-tonal-button`,
`petal-outlined-button`, `petal-elevated-button` and `petal-text-button`
(no toggle for text buttons).

```html
<petal-filled-button size="medium">Save</petal-filled-button>
<petal-filled-button size="small" shape="square">Save</petal-filled-button>
<petal-filled-tonal-button size="small" toggle selected>Bold</petal-filled-tonal-button>
```

| Attribute | Values | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `xsmall`, `small`, `medium`, `large`, `xlarge` | Height 32 / 40 / 56 / 96 / 136px, with the padding, icon size, label typescale, icon spacing and shapes of that size (`md.comp.button.<size>`). The shape morphs while pressed. |
| `shape` | `round` (default), `square` | Container shape of a sized button. |
| `toggle` | boolean | Toggles `selected` on click, sets `aria-pressed`, fires `input` and `change`. Colors from `md.comp.button.{filled,tonal,outlined,elevated}.{unselected,selected}`. A selected round button becomes square-cornered and a selected square one round. |
| `selected` | boolean | Selected state of a toggle button. |

Like the icon button, the toggle happens after other click listeners run;
calling `preventDefault()` on the click keeps the state.

Shape morph: a fully rounded corner is `height / 2` (not 9999px), so the
radius animates smoothly. The outline follows the animated shape; the focus
ring takes the new shape at once.

### Motion

Shape changes use the springs as `linear()` easings
(`--md-sys-motion-spring-*`, see [tokens.md](tokens.md)). These are the
expressive motion scheme by default, like Compose's `MaterialExpressiveTheme`
(`MotionScheme.expressive()`): spatial springs overshoot a little. Load
`tokens/css/motion-standard.css` (after `sys.css`) for the calmer standard
scheme (`MotionScheme.standard()`).

### Deviations from the tokens

| Token value | Used | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Pressed shape of a plain button morphs with `md.sys.motion.spring.fast.spatial` | default effects spring (no bounce) | `Button.kt`: "MotionSchemeKeyTokens.DefaultEffects is intentional here to prevent any bounce" |
| Small toggle button pressed shape `corner.small` (8px) | 6px | `ToggleButtonDefaults.pressedShape`; plain buttons keep 8px (`ButtonDefaults.pressedShape`) |
| Disabled label and icon color `on-surface` | `on-surface-variant` (filled, outlined, elevated, text; tonal keeps `on-surface`) | `ButtonDefaults` colors use `*ButtonTokens.DisabledLabelTextColor` from Compose |
| xsmall icon-label space 8px | 4px | `ButtonDefaults.ExtraSmallIconSpacing` |
| Outlined selected toggle: no tokens for outline | no outline (also disabled) | `OutlinedToggleButton`: no border when checked |

Toggle buttons morph with the fast spatial spring (`ToggleButton.kt`); a
pressed toggle button takes its pressed shape even when selected, like
`shapeByInteraction`. Compose animates each corner with an `Animatable`, which
keeps its velocity when the shape changes mid-way; petal-elements uses a CSS
transition with the same spring curve, so a press released mid-morph restarts
from the current radius without its velocity.

## Button group

```html
<petal-button-group>
  <petal-filled-tonal-button>One</petal-filled-tonal-button>
  <petal-filled-tonal-button>Two</petal-filled-tonal-button>
</petal-button-group>
<petal-button-group connected single-select size="medium">…</petal-button-group>
```

| Attribute | Effect |
|---|---|
| `size` (default `small`) | Spacing and corners from `md.comp.button-group.{standard,connected}.<size>`; buttons without a `size` get this one. |
| `connected` | Buttons 2px apart; outer corners full, inner corners `inner-corner.corner-size`, smaller while pressed, fully rounded when selected (pressed wins), as in Compose's `ButtonGroupDefaults.connected*ButtonShapes`. |
| `single-select` | Selecting a toggle button deselects the others; clicking the selected one keeps it selected. |

Standard and connected groups: a pressed button widens by
`pressed.item.width.multiplier` (15%) of its width at rest, and every other
button in the group gives way in proportion to its width, at most its own
padding. This is a petal-elements choice, as on cny-jpy-rate: Compose's
`ButtonGroup` takes the space from the neighbors only, and its connected
group sample has no width animation. The group's total width does not
change. On
the web the space moves through the buttons' inline padding, so labels are
never cut off.

The press is simulated like Compose's `animateWidth`: a spring from 0 to 1
with the fast spatial spring's damping and stiffness, read from
`--md-sys-motion-spring-fast-spatial-damping` and `-stiffness` (expressive
0.6 / 800 by default, which overshoots; standard 0.9 / 1400 with
`motion-standard.css`), keeping its velocity when released mid-way. A press released
before it is 75% of the way continues to 75% first, as in Compose.
`prefers-reduced-motion` turns the animations off, here and for sized
buttons.

## Filled FAB

```html
<petal-fab variant="filled-primary" aria-label="Edit">…</petal-fab>
<petal-fab variant="filled-tertiary" label="Compose">…</petal-fab>
```

`variant` takes `filled-primary`, `filled-secondary` and `filled-tertiary`
besides the container variants (`primary`, ... keep their
`primary-container`-based colors). Container, icon and state layer come from
`md.comp.fab.{primary,secondary,tertiary}` (for example container `primary`,
icon and state layer `on-primary`), the label from
`md.comp.extended-fab.{primary,secondary,tertiary}`. Only the non-deprecated
`focused.*` / `hovered.*` tokens are used; the deprecated `focus.*` / `hover.*`
ones still point at the container colors. Sizes, shape and elevation are the
same as for the other variants.

Compose has no solid FAB tokens: `FloatingActionButton` takes any
`containerColor` with `contentColorFor()` (`primary` gives `onPrimary`), which
matches these tokens.

## More

*   [Motion](motion.md): the springs, what each component animates, mouse
    hover and reduced motion.
*   Components with their own Expressive styles: [button group](components/button-group.md),
    [FAB menu](components/fab-menu.md), [floating toolbar](components/floating-toolbar.md),
    [split button](components/split-button.md), [loading indicator](components/loading-indicator.md),
    [wavy progress](components/progress.md), [carousel](components/carousel.md),
    [segmented lists](components/list.md) and [Expressive chips](components/chip.md#expressive).
