File: docs/components/fab.md

# Floating action buttons (FAB)

[FAB](https://m3.material.io/components/floating-action-button)
is a button for the main action of a screen. It floats above the content so the
action is always in reach.

[Extended FABs](https://m3.material.io/components/extended-fab)
add a text label to a FAB, which makes them wider and easier to hit.

*   Design articles
    *   [FAB](https://m3.material.io/components/floating-action-button)
        
    *   [Extended FAB](https://m3.material.io/components/extended-fab)
        
*   API Documentation (*coming soon*)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/fab)
    

## Types

1.  [FAB](#fab)
2.  [Small FAB](#sizes)
3.  [Large FAB](#sizes)

### Extended FAB

*   [Extended FAB with both icon and label text](#extended)
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Extended FAB without icon](#without-icon)

## Usage

FABs should have an icon, such as a font `petal-icon`, an `svg`, or an `img`.

```html
<petal-fab aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

### Lowered

FABs can be set to a lower elevation with the `lowered` attribute.

```html
<petal-fab lowered aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

### Following the pointer

`follow-pointer` moves the FAB up to 4px toward a mouse pointer within 28px of
it, on the fast spatial spring, and back on the default spatial one when the
pointer leaves. Use it for the page's main FAB only. This is a petal-elements
addition; touch screens and reduced motion keep the FAB still.

```html
<petal-fab follow-pointer aria-label="Compose">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

## Accessibility

Icon-only FABs must include an `aria-label` that describes its action. Otherwise
if `aria-label` is not provided, the FAB will default to announcing its visible
contents.

```html
<petal-fab aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

Extended FABs use their `label` for accessibility. Add an `aria-label` for
additional context if needed. By supplying the `label` attribute, the extended
FAB will make sure that the icon is not announced.

```html
<petal-fab label="Edit" aria-label="Edit Comment">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

## FAB

FABs should display a clear and understandable icon.

```html
<petal-fab aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

### Extended

FABs may be extended with a label for additional emphasis. Extended FABs can
omit their icon.

```html
<petal-fab label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

#### Without icon

Extended FABs are the only FABs that can be used without an icon.

```html
<petal-fab label="Reroute"></petal-fab>
```

### Colors

FAB colors may be changed with the `variant` attribute. It can be set to
"primary" (default, as in Compose), "secondary", "tertiary", or "surface".
The first three use the container colors (for example `primary-container`). For the solid colors, use
"filled-primary", "filled-secondary", or "filled-tertiary" (see
[Material 3 Expressive features](../expressive.md#filled-fab)).

```html
<petal-fab variant="primary" aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
<petal-fab variant="secondary" aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
<petal-fab variant="tertiary" aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

### Sizes

FABs may be small (40px), baseline (56px, the default), medium (80px), or
large (96px) by setting the `size` attribute, the sizes of Compose's
`SmallFloatingActionButton`, `FloatingActionButton`,
`MediumFloatingActionButton` and `LargeFloatingActionButton`. Small FABs can
optionally further reduce their touch target.

```html
<petal-fab size="small" touch-target="none" aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
<petal-fab size="small" aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
<petal-fab aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
<petal-fab size="medium" aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
<petal-fab size="large" aria-label="Edit">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

### Extended sizes

With a `label`, `size` picks Compose's extended FAB sizes: small (56px high,
title medium text), medium (80px, title large) and large (96px, headline
small). Without a size, the extended FAB is the baseline one (56px, label
large text).

```html
<petal-fab size="small" label="Compose">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
<petal-fab size="medium" label="Compose">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
<petal-fab size="large" label="Compose">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
</petal-fab>
```

### Expanded

Set `expanded` to `false` to shrink an extended FAB to its icon, for example
while a list scrolls down. Like Compose's expandable extended FAB, the width
moves on the fast spatial spring and the label fades on the fast effects
spring; with reduced motion it changes at once. The label still names the
button while collapsed.

```js
const fab = document.querySelector('petal-fab');
list.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  fab.expanded = list.scrollTop === 0;
});
```

## Branded FAB

Branded FABs use a brightly colored logo for their icon. Unlike [FAB](#fab),
branded FABs do not have color variants.

```html
<petal-branded-fab size="small" aria-label="Add">
  <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 36 36">
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="10" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#F48FB1"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="26" cy="18" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#EC407A"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="26" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#F06292"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="10" cy="18" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#F8BBD0"></ellipse>
    <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="4" fill="#FFD54F"></circle>
  </svg>
</petal-branded-fab>
```

### Extended

Branded FABs may be extended with a label for additional emphasis. Unlike
[FAB](#fab), branded FABs should always display their logo icon.

```html
<petal-branded-fab label="Add">
  <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 36 36">
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="10" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#F48FB1"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="26" cy="18" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#EC407A"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="26" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#F06292"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="10" cy="18" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#F8BBD0"></ellipse>
    <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="4" fill="#FFD54F"></circle>
  </svg>
</petal-branded-fab>
```

### Sizes

Branded FABs may be baseline (default) or large by setting the `size` attribute.

```html
<petal-branded-fab aria-label="Add">
  <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 36 36">
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="10" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#F48FB1"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="26" cy="18" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#EC407A"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="26" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#F06292"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="10" cy="18" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#F8BBD0"></ellipse>
    <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="4" fill="#FFD54F"></circle>
  </svg>
</petal-branded-fab>
<petal-branded-fab size="large" aria-label="Add">
  <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 36 36">
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="10" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#F48FB1"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="26" cy="18" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#EC407A"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="26" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#F06292"></ellipse>
    <ellipse cx="10" cy="18" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#F8BBD0"></ellipse>
    <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="4" fill="#FFD54F"></circle>
  </svg>
</petal-branded-fab>
```

## Theming

FAB supports [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized in
terms of color, typography, and shape.

### FAB tokens

Token                              | Default value
---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------
`--md-fab-container-color`         | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-high`
`--md-fab-lowered-container-color` | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-low`
`--md-fab-container-shape`         | `--md-sys-shape-corner-large`
`--md-fab-icon-color`              | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-fab-icon-size`               | `24px`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-fab.scss)
    

### Branded FAB tokens

Token                              | Default value
---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------
`--md-fab-branded-container-color` | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-high`
`--md-fab-branded-container-shape` | `--md-sys-shape-corner-large`
`--md-fab-branded-icon-size`       | `36px`
`--md-fab-branded-label-text-font` | `--md-sys-typescale-label-large-font`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-fab-branded.scss)
    

## API

### PetalFab <code>&lt;petal-fab&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `variant` | `FabVariant` | `'primary'` | The FAB color variant to render. The default, `primary`, is Compose's default FAB color (primary container). |
| `size` | `size` | `FabSize` | `'baseline'` | The size of the FAB.<br>NOTE: Branded FABs cannot be sized to `small` or `medium`. |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | The text to display on the FAB. |
| `lowered` | `lowered` | `boolean` | `false` | Lowers the FAB's elevation. |
| `expanded` | `expanded` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether an extended FAB shows its label. When false, it shrinks to the icon alone with Compose's animation; the label still names the button. |
| `followPointer` | `follow-pointer` | `boolean` | `false` | Moves the FAB up to 4px toward a mouse pointer within 28px of it, and back when the pointer leaves (a petal-elements addition). Meant for the page's main FAB only. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `icon` | The icon (`<petal-icon slot="icon">`). |

### PetalBrandedFab <code>&lt;petal-branded-fab&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `variant` | `FabVariant` | `'primary'` | The FAB color variant to render. The default, `primary`, is Compose's default FAB color (primary container). |
| `size` | `size` | `FabSize` | `'baseline'` | The size of the FAB.<br>NOTE: Branded FABs cannot be sized to `small` or `medium`. |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | The text to display on the FAB. |
| `lowered` | `lowered` | `boolean` | `false` | Lowers the FAB's elevation. |
| `expanded` | `expanded` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether an extended FAB shows its label. When false, it shrinks to the icon alone with Compose's animation; the label still names the button. |
| `followPointer` | `follow-pointer` | `boolean` | `false` | Moves the FAB up to 4px toward a mouse pointer within 28px of it, and back when the pointer leaves (a petal-elements addition). Meant for the page's main FAB only. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `getRenderClasses` | _None_ | `{ primary: boolean; secondary: boolean; tertiary: boolean; small: boolean; 'filled-primary': boolean; 'filled-secondary': boolean; 'filled-tertiary': boolean; lowered: boolean; medium: boolean; large: boolean; extended: boolean; 'extended-small': boolean; 'extended-medium': boolean; 'extended-large': boolean; }` |  |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `icon` | The icon (`<petal-icon slot="icon">`). |

File: docs/components/fab-menu.md

# FAB menu

[FAB menu](https://m3.material.io/components/fab-menu)
opens a short list of related actions from a floating action button. The
button turns into a close button while the list is open.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/fab-menu) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/fabmenu)
    

The values and the motion follow Jetpack Compose Material 3
(`FloatingActionButtonMenu`, `FloatingActionButtonMenuItem`,
`ToggleFloatingActionButton` and `FabMenuBaselineTokens`).

## Usage

`<petal-fab-menu>` holds the items in its default slot and the button in the
`button` slot, usually a `<petal-toggle-fab>`. The menu keeps the button's
`checked` in sync with its own `expanded`, so the button needs no code.
Place the menu yourself, for example `position: fixed` at the bottom end of
the window.

```html
<petal-fab-menu id="menu" items-label="Create">
  <petal-fab-menu-item>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">edit</petal-icon>
    Note
  </petal-fab-menu-item>
  <petal-fab-menu-item>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">checklist</petal-icon>
    List
  </petal-fab-menu-item>
  <petal-toggle-fab slot="button" aria-label="Create"></petal-toggle-fab>
</petal-fab-menu>
<script type="module">
  import 'petal-elements/fabmenu/fab-menu.js';
  import 'petal-elements/fabmenu/fab-menu-item.js';
  import 'petal-elements/fabmenu/toggle-fab.js';
  import 'petal-elements/icon/icon.js';

  const menu = document.querySelector('#menu');
  menu.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target.closest('petal-fab-menu-item')) {
      // Do the action, then close the menu: choosing an item does not.
      menu.expanded = false;
    }
  });
</script>
```

The menu has 16px of padding on both sides. The items are 56px high and 4px
apart, 8px above the button's room, and the room has 16px below it.

### Alignment

`horizontal-alignment` (`end` by default, `start` or `center`) aligns the items
and the button. The toggle FAB shrinks toward its end like Compose's default
`TopEnd`; for a menu at the start set `content-alignment="start"` on the toggle
too.

### Toggle FAB

`<petal-toggle-fab>` can be used alone. Its `size` is `baseline` (56px),
`medium` (80px) or `large` (96px); checked it is always 56px, round, in the
primary color, and keeps the room of its unchecked size, with the container at
the top. The icon is an add and a close icon by default; the `icon` and
`checked-icon` slots replace them. The icon switches halfway through the
animation, and shrinks from the FAB's icon size to 20px.

### Opening and closing

The menu opens and closes when the button is clicked and when `expanded`
changes. Escape and a press outside close it. `open` and `close` fire when it
starts to. Choosing an item does not close the menu, as in Compose.

Opened with the keyboard, focus moves to the first item. With the menu open,
Tab and the down arrow on the button also go to the first item, as in Compose,
and the arrows move between the items.

## Accessibility

Compose has no menu semantics: the items are buttons in a traversal group
before the button. This follows it. The items are native buttons in a
`role="group"` named by `items-label`, not a `role="menu"` (which would need
Tab to leave the menu). The toggle reports `aria-expanded` inside a menu and
`aria-pressed` alone. Closed, the items are `inert`. Set an accessible name on
the toggle with `aria-label`; the icons are hidden from assistive technology.

## Motion

The items follow Compose's stagger: the number of visible items is the
rounded value of an animation on the slow effects spring (damping 1,
stiffness 800), so the item next to the button appears first and, when
closing, the top item goes first. Each item grows its width from 0 on the fast
spatial spring and fades in on the fast effects spring (damping 1, stiffness
3800). The toggle's container, icon and colors follow the checked progress on
the fast spatial spring of the page's [motion scheme](../theming/README.md)
(`--md-sys-motion-spring-fast-spatial-*`), so they overshoot with the expressive
scheme. With reduced motion everything jumps to its end.

## Theming

Token                                              | Default value
-------------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-fab-menu-list-item-container-color`          | `--md-sys-color-primary-container`
`--md-fab-menu-list-item-content-color`            | `--md-sys-color-on-primary-container`
`--md-fab-menu-list-item-container-shape`          | `--md-sys-shape-corner-full`
`--md-fab-menu-list-item-container-height`         | `56px`
`--md-fab-menu-list-item-leading-space`            | `24px`
`--md-fab-menu-list-item-trailing-space`           | `24px`
`--md-fab-menu-list-item-icon-label-space`         | `8px`
`--md-fab-menu-list-item-icon-size`                | `24px`
`--md-toggle-fab-container-color`                  | `--md-sys-color-primary-container`
`--md-toggle-fab-checked-container-color`          | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-toggle-fab-icon-color`                       | `--md-sys-color-on-primary-container`
`--md-toggle-fab-checked-icon-color`               | `--md-sys-color-on-primary`
`--md-toggle-fab-container-elevation`              | `3`
`--md-fab-menu-close-button-container-height`      | `56px`
`--md-fab-menu-close-button-icon-size`             | `20px`

The items have no shadow: `ListItemContainerElevation` is level 3 in the
tokens, but Compose's code does not use it.

*   [FAB menu tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-fab-menu-baseline.scss)
    

## API

### PetalFabMenu <code>&lt;petal-fab-menu&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expanded` | `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the menu is open. A `petal-toggle-fab` in the `button` slot is kept in sync, and its `change` event sets this. |
| `horizontalAlignment` | `horizontal-alignment` | `FabMenuAlignment` | `'end'` | The horizontal alignment of the items and the button, `end` by default. |
| `itemsLabel` | `items-label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the group of items. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `Event` | No | No | The menu started to open. {@type Event} |
| `close` | `Event` | No | No | The menu started to close. {@type Event} |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The `petal-fab-menu-item`s. |
| `button` | The `petal-toggle-fab` that opens and closes the menu. |

### PetalFabMenuItem <code>&lt;petal-fab-menu-item&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `horizontalAlignment` | `horizontal-alignment` | `FabMenuAlignment` | `'end'` | Which side of the menu the item hugs. `petal-fab-menu` sets it, like the `horizontalAlignment` of Compose's `FloatingActionButtonMenuScope`. |
| `isVisible` |  | `boolean` | `undefined` |  |
| `isAnimating` |  | `boolean` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `setShown` | `shown`, `animate` | `void` | Shows or hides the item. The springs move toward the new state with the next `step()`s; without `animate` it is there at once. |
| `step` | `ms` | `void` | Moves the springs `ms` milliseconds forward and lays the item out. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | The leading icon. |

### PetalToggleFab <code>&lt;petal-toggle-fab&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the FAB is checked (a FAB menu is open). |
| `size` | `size` | `ToggleFabSize` | `'baseline'` | The size of the unchecked FAB. The container always keeps this much room and shrinks inside of it. |
| `contentAlignment` | `content-alignment` | `ToggleFabAlignment` | `'end'` | Where the container sits in its room when it is checked and smaller, like Compose's `contentAlignment` (`TopEnd` by default). |
| `popup` | `popup` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the FAB opens a popup (a FAB menu): it then reports `checked` with `aria-expanded` instead of `aria-pressed`. `petal-fab-menu` sets it on its button. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `Event` | No | No | The checked state changed because of a click. {@type Event} |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `icon` | The icon while closed; an add icon by default. |
| `checked-icon` | The icon while open; a close icon by default. |

File: docs/components/floating-toolbar.md

# Floating toolbar

[Floating toolbars](https://m3.material.io/components/toolbars)
hold the actions for the current screen in a container that floats above the
content. They expand and collapse.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/toolbars) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/floatingtoolbar)
    

The values and the motion follow Jetpack Compose Material 3
(`HorizontalFloatingToolbar`, `VerticalFloatingToolbar`,
`FloatingToolbarDefaults`, `FloatingToolbarTokens`).

## Usage

`<petal-floating-toolbar>` is a row of actions. Put icon buttons (or any
elements) in the default slot.

```html
<petal-floating-toolbar expanded aria-label="Text formatting">
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Bold"><petal-icon>format_bold</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Italic"><petal-icon>format_italic</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Underline"><petal-icon>format_underlined</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
</petal-floating-toolbar>
<script type="module">
  import 'petal-elements/floatingtoolbar/floating-toolbar.js';
  import 'petal-elements/iconbutton/icon-button.js';
  import 'petal-elements/icon/icon.js';
</script>
```

The toolbar is 64px high with 8px of padding around the actions, so 48px
touch targets (icon buttons with the default touch target) fit exactly. It is
a pill, as `FloatingToolbarDefaults.ContainerShape`. The toolbar does not
position itself: place it in the page, for example with `position: fixed` and
a 16px offset from the screen edge (`FloatingToolbarDefaults.ScreenOffset`).

### Orientation and colors

`orientation="vertical"` makes `VerticalFloatingToolbar`: a column that is 64px
wide. `colors="vibrant"` is `vibrantFloatingToolbarColors()` (primary
container), `standard` (the default) is `standardFloatingToolbarColors()`
(surface container). Slotted `petal-icon-button`s take the toolbar's content
color. In the vibrant toolbar, selected toggle icon buttons use the
`VibrantButtonSelected*` colors; a selected `petal-filled-icon-button` gets a
surface container.

```html
<petal-floating-toolbar orientation="vertical" colors="vibrant" expanded>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Edit"><petal-icon>edit</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Share"><petal-icon>share</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
</petal-floating-toolbar>
```

### Leading and trailing actions

Without a FAB, the `leading` and `trailing` slots are Compose's
`leadingContent` and `trailingContent`: they show only while the toolbar is
`expanded`, and the default slot is always shown. Set `expanded` to expand or
collapse the toolbar.

```html
<petal-floating-toolbar id="toolbar" expanded>
  <petal-icon-button slot="leading" aria-label="Undo"><petal-icon>undo</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Add"><petal-icon>add</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button slot="trailing" aria-label="Redo"><petal-icon>redo</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
</petal-floating-toolbar>
```

### With a floating action button

An element in the `fab` slot (a `petal-fab` of the default size) makes the
toolbar with a FAB. The whole toolbar then collapses into the FAB: expanded,
the FAB is 56px and the toolbar is next to it (8px apart); collapsed, the
toolbar shrinks to nothing and the FAB grows to 80px. The size of the
component stays the same, so the page does not move. The FAB takes the
toolbar's FAB colors (primary container, or tertiary container when vibrant)
and a level 2 elevation, level 3 when hovered. The toolbar has a level 1
elevation when expanded.

`fab-position` is `end` (the default) or `start`; for a vertical toolbar, use
`bottom` (the default) or `top`. `start` and `end` work for both.

```html
<petal-floating-toolbar id="toolbar" expanded fab-position="end" aria-label="Actions">
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Check"><petal-icon>check_box</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Draw"><petal-icon>brush</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-fab slot="fab" aria-label="Add"><petal-icon slot="icon">add</petal-icon></petal-fab>
</petal-floating-toolbar>
<script>
  const toolbar = document.querySelector('#toolbar');
  toolbar.querySelector('petal-fab').addEventListener('click', () => {
    toolbar.expanded = !toolbar.expanded;
  });
</script>
```

### Expanding when the page scrolls

Compose offers `Modifier.floatingToolbarVerticalNestedScroll` (collapse after
scrolling down 40dp, expand after scrolling up 40dp) and
`FloatingToolbarDefaults.exitAlwaysScrollBehavior` (the toolbar slides off the
screen). The element does not include them: `expanded` is the state. A simple
version of the first one:

```js
// Collapse after scrolling down 40px, expand after scrolling up 40px.
let last = scroller.scrollTop;
let threshold = last;
scroller.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  const offset = scroller.scrollTop;
  if (offset > last && offset >= threshold + 40) {
    toolbar.expanded = false;
    threshold = offset;
  } else if (offset < last && offset <= threshold - 40) {
    toolbar.expanded = true;
    threshold = offset;
  }
  last = offset;
});
```

## Accessibility

The actions are a `toolbar` (the label is the host's `aria-label`) whose
`aria-orientation` follows `orientation`. The arrow keys along the toolbar,
Home and End move focus between the actions, and each action stays in the tab
order (arrow keys do nothing in text fields). The FAB is not part of the
toolbar. Actions that a collapsed toolbar hides are `inert`, so they are
out of reach until it expands. Compose expands the toolbar for touch
exploration and adds a custom action to expand and collapse it; the element
does not detect assistive technology, so keep `expanded` true for people who
cannot see the page's scroll, or give them another way to expand it. The
scroll recipe above has the same issue as Compose's scroll behavior.

## Motion

Expanding and collapsing use Compose's `FloatingToolbarDefaults.animationSpec()`,
`MotionSchemeKeyTokens.FastSpatial`, a spring of the page's
[motion scheme](../theming/README.md) (`--md-sys-motion-spring-fast-spatial-*`;
damping 0.6 and stiffness 800 for the expressive scheme). The toolbar's size, the
FAB's size and the elevation follow the same spring, so it overshoots a little
and an interrupted animation continues from where it is. With reduced motion
the toolbar changes at once.

## Differences from Compose

*   `minimumInteractiveBalancedPadding`, which balances the padding while only
    the middle content shows, is not implemented.
*   `expandedShadowElevation` and `collapsedShadowElevation` are the
    `--md-floating-toolbar-*-elevation` properties (levels).
*   The leading and trailing content grow no larger than their own size when the
    spring overshoots.

## Theming

Floating toolbars support [Material theming](../theming/README.md). The
`--md-floating-toolbar-*` custom properties are Compose's
`FloatingToolbarTokens`. Compose takes the content and FAB colors from
`ColorScheme` (`contentColorFor`), not from tokens, and the elevations and the
gap to the FAB are constants in `FloatingToolbarDefaults`; they have custom
properties here too.

### Tokens

Token                                                      | Default value
---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-floating-toolbar-container-height`                   | `64px`
`--md-floating-toolbar-container-leading-space`            | `8px`
`--md-floating-toolbar-container-trailing-space`           | `8px`
`--md-floating-toolbar-container-shape`                    | `--md-sys-shape-corner-full`
`--md-floating-toolbar-standard-container-color`           | `--md-sys-color-surface-container`
`--md-floating-toolbar-standard-content-color`             | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-floating-toolbar-standard-fab-container-color`       | `--md-sys-color-primary-container`
`--md-floating-toolbar-standard-fab-content-color`         | `--md-sys-color-on-primary-container`
`--md-floating-toolbar-vibrant-container-color`            | `--md-sys-color-primary-container`
`--md-floating-toolbar-vibrant-content-color`              | `--md-sys-color-on-primary-container`
`--md-floating-toolbar-vibrant-fab-container-color`        | `--md-sys-color-tertiary-container`
`--md-floating-toolbar-vibrant-fab-content-color`          | `--md-sys-color-on-tertiary-container`
`--md-floating-toolbar-vibrant-button-selected-container-color` | `--md-sys-color-surface-container`
`--md-floating-toolbar-vibrant-button-selected-icon-color` | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-floating-toolbar-fab-expanded-size`                  | `56px`
`--md-floating-toolbar-fab-collapsed-size`                 | `80px`
`--md-floating-toolbar-fab-gap`                            | `8px`
`--md-floating-toolbar-expanded-elevation`                 | `0`
`--md-floating-toolbar-collapsed-elevation`                | `0`
`--md-floating-toolbar-expanded-elevation-with-fab`        | `1`
`--md-floating-toolbar-collapsed-elevation-with-fab`       | `0`

*   [Floating toolbar tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-floating-toolbar.scss)
    

## API

### PetalFloatingToolbar <code>&lt;petal-floating-toolbar&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `orientation` | `FloatingToolbarOrientation` | `'horizontal'` | `horizontal` (a row) or `vertical` (a column). |
| `expanded` | `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the toolbar is expanded. Collapsed, a toolbar with a FAB shows only the FAB and one without shows only the default slot. |
| `colors` | `colors` | `FloatingToolbarColors` | `'standard'` | `standard` (the default) or `vibrant`. |
| `fabPosition` | `fab-position` | `FloatingToolbarFabPosition` | `'end'` | Where the FAB sits, when there is one. `end` (the default; `bottom` when vertical) or `start` (`top` when vertical). |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The toolbar's content: icon buttons or buttons. |
| `leading` | Content before the main content, shown only while expanded (Compose's `leadingContent`; not with a FAB). |
| `trailing` | Content after the main content, shown only while expanded (Compose's `trailingContent`; not with a FAB). |
| `fab` | A `petal-fab` beside the toolbar (Compose's FAB toolbar). |

---

File: docs/components/chip.md

# Chips

[Chips](https://m3.material.io/components/chips)
are compact elements for entering information, choosing options, filtering
content or starting actions.

While buttons are expected to appear consistently and with familiar calls to
action, chips should appear dynamically as a group of multiple interactive
elements.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/chips) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/chips)
    

## Types

1.  [Assist chip](#assist-chip)
1.  [Filter chip](#filter-chip)
1.  [Input chip](#input-chip)
1.  [Suggestion chip](#suggestion-chip)

## Usage

Choose the type of chip based on its purpose and author.

-   **Assist** chips are common actions, such as adding an event to a calendar.
-   **Filter** chips are tags used to filter content, such as shopping
    categories.
-   **Input** chips are pieces of information entered by a user, such as event
    attendees.
-   **Suggestion** chips represent dynamic suggestions for user input, such as
    text message replies.

```html
<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-assist-chip label="Assist"></petal-assist-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Filter"></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-input-chip label="Input"></petal-input-chip>
  <petal-suggestion-chip label="Suggestion"></petal-suggestion-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

### Chip sets

Chips should always appear in a set. Chip sets are
[toolbars](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Roles/toolbar_role)
that can display any type of chip or other toolbar items.

```html
<h3>New event</h3>
<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-filter-chip label="All day"></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-assist-chip label="Add to calendar"></petal-assist-chip>
  <petal-assist-chip label="Set a reminder"></petal-assist-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

### Icons

All chips may display an optional icon. Input chips can specify if an avatar
picture is displayed.

```html
<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-assist-chip label="Add to calendar">
    <petal-icon slot="icon">event</petal-icon>
  </petal-assist-chip>

  <petal-input-chip label="Ping Qiang" avatar>
    
  </petal-input-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

### Elevated

Assist, filter, and suggestion chips can be elevated if the placement requires
protection, such as on top of an image.

```html
<div>
  
  <petal-chip-set>
    <petal-suggestion-chip label="Share" elevated></petal-suggestion-chip>
    <petal-suggestion-chip label="Favorite" elevated></petal-suggestion-chip>
  </petal-chip-set>
</div>
```

### Selection, removal and links

A filter chip toggles `selected` when clicked; listen for `click` and read
`selected` (calling `preventDefault()` on the click keeps the old state).
Input chips, and filter chips with `removable`, have a remove button: it fires
a cancelable `remove` event, then takes the chip out of the page. Name the
remove button with `aria-label-remove`. Assist and suggestion chips with
`href` (and `target`) are links.

```js
const chips = document.querySelector('petal-chip-set');
chips.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const filters = [...chips.querySelectorAll('petal-filter-chip[selected]')]
      .map((chip) => chip.label);
  console.log(filters);
});
chips.addEventListener('remove', (event) => {
  // event.target is the chip; preventDefault() keeps it.
});
```

## Accessibility

Add an
[`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label)
attribute to chip sets or reference a label with
[`aria-labelledby`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-labelledby).
Add an `aria-label` to chips whose labels need to be more descriptive.

```html
<h3 id="dates-label">Dates</h3>
<petal-chip-set aria-labelledby="dates-label">
  <petal-filter-chip label="Mon" aria-label="Monday"></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Tue" aria-label="Tuesday"></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Wed" aria-label="Wednesday"></petal-filter-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

### Focusable and disabled

By default, disabled chips are not focusable with the keyboard, while
"soft-disabled" chips are. Some use cases encourage focusability of disabled
toolbar items to increase their discoverability.

See the
[ARIA guidelines on focusability of disabled controls](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/keyboard-interface/#kbd_disabled_controls)
for guidance on when this is recommended.

```html
<petal-chip-set aria-label="Actions">
  
  <petal-assist-chip label="Copy" soft-disabled></petal-assist-chip>
  <petal-assist-chip label="Paste" soft-disabled></petal-assist-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
<petal-outlined-text-field type="textarea"></petal-outlined-text-field>
```

## Assist chip

[Assist chips](https://m3.material.io/components/chips/guidelines#5dd1928c-1476-4029-bdc5-fde66fc0dcb1)
offer a related action, such as adding an event to a calendar.

Assist chips function as though the user asked an assistant to complete the
action. They should appear dynamically and contextually in a UI.

```html
<h3>A restaraunt location</h3>
<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-assist-chip label="Add to my itinerary">
    <petal-icon slot="icon">calendar</petal-icon>
  </petal-assist-chip>
  <petal-assist-chip label="12 mins from hotel">
    <petal-icon slot="icon">map</petal-icon>
  </petal-assist-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

## Filter chip

[Filter chips](https://m3.material.io/components/chips/guidelines#8d453d50-8d8e-43aa-9ae3-87ed134d2e64)
narrow down content with tags or keywords. They can replace a row of toggle
buttons or checkboxes.

```html
<h3>Choose where to share</h3>
<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Docs"></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Slides" selected></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Sheets" selected></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Images"></petal-filter-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

### Removable

Filter chips can optionally be removable from the chip set. Removable chips have
a trailing remove icon.

```html
<h3>Colors</h3>
<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Red" removable selected></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Yellow" removable></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Blue" removable></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip label="Green" removable></petal-filter-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

## Input chip

[Input chips](https://m3.material.io/components/chips/guidelines#4d2d5ef5-3fcd-46e9-99f2-067747b2393f)
show pieces of information that the user entered, such as recipients or search
terms.

Input chips whose icons are user images may add the `avatar` attribute to
display the image in a larger circle.

```html
<petal-outlined-text-field label="Attendees" type="email"></petal-outlined-text-field>

<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-input-chip label="Ping Qiang" avatar>
    
  </petal-input-chip>
  <petal-input-chip label="Thea Schröder" avatar>
    
  </petal-input-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

### Remove-only

All input chips are removable. If an input chip does not have an action
associated with clicking on it, it may be marked as `remove-only`.

```html
<h3>Favorite movies</h3>
<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-input-chip label="Star Wars" remove-only></petal-input-chip>
  <petal-input-chip label="Star Trek" remove-only></petal-input-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

## Suggestion chip

[Suggestion chips](https://m3.material.io/components/chips/guidelines#36d7bb16-a9bf-4cf6-a73d-8e05510d66a7)
offer generated suggestions, such as quick replies or search refinements.

```html
<h3>Suggested reply</h3>
<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-suggestion-chip label="I agree"></petal-suggestion-chip>
  <petal-suggestion-chip label="Looks good to me"></petal-suggestion-chip>
  <petal-suggestion-chip label="Thank you"></petal-suggestion-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

## Compose behavior

Chips follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`AssistChip`, `FilterChip`,
`InputChip`, `SuggestionChip`):

*   Chips are 32dp high with corner.small (8dp) corners, also input chips with
    an avatar (only the avatar is round). The label is 16dp from the sides, 8dp
    next to an icon; input chips have 12dp without an icon.
*   The ripple has the content color of the chip's surface: on-surface, or
    on-secondary-container when a filter or input chip is selected.
*   When a filter chip is selected, the checkmark takes its space from the
    start on the fast spatial spring and fades in; when it is deselected, the
    space shrinks on the default effects spring and the checkmark fades out. A
    chip with its own icon swaps the icon for the checkmark.
*   A flat filter chip rises to elevation level 1 while hovered.

### Expressive

`expressive` gives filter and input chips the expressive shapes of Compose's
`FilterChip` and `InputChip` with `shapes`: corner.medium (12dp) when not
selected, fully rounded when selected and corner.small while pressed, morphing
on the fast spatial spring. The space between an icon and the label is 4dp and
the leading icon is on-surface-variant. Assist and suggestion chips have no
expressive shapes in Compose, so mixing them with expressive chips mixes
corner sizes.

```html
<petal-chip-set>
  <petal-filter-chip expressive label="Nearby" selected></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip expressive label="Open now"></petal-filter-chip>
  <petal-filter-chip expressive label="Pet friendly"></petal-filter-chip>
</petal-chip-set>
```

## Theming

Chips support [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized in
terms of color, typography, and shape.

### PetalAssistChip <code>&lt;petal-assist-chip&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `elevated` | `elevated` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `download` | `download` | `string` | `''` | The filename to use when downloading the linked resource. If not specified, the browser will determine a filename. This is only applicable when the chip is used as a link (`href` is set). |
| `target` | `target` | `"" \| "_blank" \| "_parent" \| "_self" \| "_top"` | `''` |  |
| `rel` | `rel` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `rel` attribute when `href` is set. |
| `referrerPolicy` | `referrerpolicy` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `referrerpolicy` attribute when `href` is set. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the chip is disabled.<br>Disabled chips are not focusable, unless `always-focusable` is set. |
| `softDisabled` | `soft-disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the chip is "soft-disabled" (disabled but still focusable).<br>Use this when a chip needs increased visibility when disabled. See https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/keyboard-interface/#kbd_disabled_controls for more guidance on when this is needed. |
| `alwaysFocusable` | `always-focusable` | `boolean` | `false` | When true, allow disabled chips to be focused with arrow keys.<br>Add this when a chip needs increased visibility when disabled. See https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/keyboard-interface/#kbd_disabled_controls for more guidance on when this is needed. |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | The label of the chip. |
| `hasIcon` | `has-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | Only needed for SSR.<br>Add this attribute when a chip has a `slot="icon"` to avoid a Flash Of Unstyled Content. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `update-focus` | `Event` | Yes | No | Dispatched when `disabled` is toggled. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | A leading icon (`<petal-icon slot="icon">`) or, for input chips, an avatar image. |

### PetalFilterChip <code>&lt;petal-filter-chip&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `elevated` | `elevated` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `removable` | `removable` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `expressive` | `expressive` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the chip has the expressive shapes of Compose's FilterChip with `shapes`: rounder while not selected, fully rounded when selected and less round while pressed, morphing on a spring. The spacing next to the icons is tighter and the leading icon is on-surface-variant. |
| `hasSelectedIcon` | `has-selected-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | Only needed for SSR.<br>Add this attribute when a filter chip has a `slot="selected-icon"` to avoid a Flash Of Unstyled Content. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the chip is disabled.<br>Disabled chips are not focusable, unless `always-focusable` is set. |

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `remove` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the remove button is clicked. |
| `update-focus` | `Event` | Yes | No | Dispatched when `disabled` is toggled. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `selected-icon` | The icon shown while selected, instead of the check mark. |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | A leading icon (`<petal-icon slot="icon">`) or, for input chips, an avatar image. |

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `remove` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the remove button is clicked. |
| `update-focus` | `Event` | Yes | No | Dispatched when `disabled` is toggled. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | A leading icon (`<petal-icon slot="icon">`) or, for input chips, an avatar image. |

### PetalSuggestionChip <code>&lt;petal-suggestion-chip&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `elevated` | `elevated` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `download` | `download` | `string` | `''` | The filename to use when downloading the linked resource. If not specified, the browser will determine a filename. This is only applicable when the chip is used as a link (`href` is set). |
| `target` | `target` | `"" \| "_blank" \| "_parent" \| "_self" \| "_top"` | `''` |  |
| `rel` | `rel` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `rel` attribute when `href` is set. |
| `referrerPolicy` | `referrerpolicy` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `referrerpolicy` attribute when `href` is set. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the chip is disabled.<br>Disabled chips are not focusable, unless `always-focusable` is set. |
| `softDisabled` | `soft-disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the chip is "soft-disabled" (disabled but still focusable).<br>Use this when a chip needs increased visibility when disabled. See https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/keyboard-interface/#kbd_disabled_controls for more guidance on when this is needed. |
| `alwaysFocusable` | `always-focusable` | `boolean` | `false` | When true, allow disabled chips to be focused with arrow keys.<br>Add this when a chip needs increased visibility when disabled. See https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/keyboard-interface/#kbd_disabled_controls for more guidance on when this is needed. |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | The label of the chip. |
| `hasIcon` | `has-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | Only needed for SSR.<br>Add this attribute when a chip has a `slot="icon"` to avoid a Flash Of Unstyled Content. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `update-focus` | `Event` | Yes | No | Dispatched when `disabled` is toggled. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | A leading icon (`<petal-icon slot="icon">`) or, for input chips, an avatar image. |

File: docs/components/top-app-bar.md

# Top app bar

[Top app bars](https://m3.material.io/components/app-bars)
show the title of a screen with navigation and actions at the top of the page.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/app-bars) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/appbar)
    

The values follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`AppBarTokens`,
`AppBarSmallTokens`, `AppBarMediumFlexibleTokens`,
`AppBarLargeFlexibleTokens`, and the layout in `AppBar.kt`).

## Usage

Set the title with `headline`, and put icon buttons in the `navigation` and
`actions` slots. The bar sticks to the top of the page. When content scrolls
under it, a small bar takes the scrolled container color.

```html
<petal-top-app-bar headline="Inbox">
  <petal-icon-button slot="navigation" aria-label="Menu">
    <petal-icon>menu</petal-icon>
  </petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button slot="actions" aria-label="Search">
    <petal-icon>search</petal-icon>
  </petal-icon-button>
</petal-top-app-bar>
```

`subtitle` adds a line below the title.

### Medium and large

`size="medium"` and `size="large"` are Compose's `MediumFlexibleTopAppBar`
and `LargeFlexibleTopAppBar`: a large title below the bar, 112px and 120px tall
(136px and 152px with a subtitle). As the page scrolls, the large title scrolls
away and fades out, the small title fades in, and the container takes the
scrolled color, like Compose's `exitUntilCollapsed` scroll behavior.

```html
<petal-top-app-bar size="medium" headline="Inbox" subtitle="12 unread">
  ...
</petal-top-app-bar>
```

### Centered title

`centered` centers the title, as Compose's `titleHorizontalAlignment`.

### Title content

For a title with more than text, such as an icon, use the `headline` and
`subtitle` slots instead of the properties. A slotted title can only appear
once, so medium and large bars also take `collapsed-headline` and
`collapsed-subtitle` slots for the collapsed row:

```html
<petal-top-app-bar size="medium">
  <span slot="headline">JPY <petal-icon>sync_alt</petal-icon> CNY</span>
  <span slot="collapsed-headline">JPY <petal-icon>sync_alt</petal-icon> CNY</span>
</petal-top-app-bar>
```

### Collapsed title

Like Compose, the collapsed row of a medium or large bar shows the same title
and subtitle as the expanded one. Set `collapsed-headline` or
`collapsed-subtitle` to show something else there (Compose's `smallTitle` and
`smallSubtitle`); `collapsed-subtitle=""` shows no subtitle when collapsed.

```html
<petal-top-app-bar
    size="medium"
    headline="Inbox"
    subtitle="12 unread"
    collapsed-subtitle="">
</petal-top-app-bar>
```

### Scrolling container

By default the bar follows the page scroll. When the content scrolls in an
element instead, give that element an id and set `scroll-target`:

```html
<div id="list" style="overflow: auto; height: 100vh">
  <petal-top-app-bar size="medium" headline="Inbox" scroll-target="list">
  </petal-top-app-bar>
  ...
</div>
```

The bar updates during the scroll event, so `collapsedFraction` is current
in scroll listeners that run after the bar's. Listen to `collapse-change` to
react to every change of the collapsed fraction.

## Accessibility

Only one title is exposed to assistive technology at a time: the large title
while the bar is mostly expanded, the small one when it is mostly collapsed,
like Compose. Give icon buttons an `aria-label`.

The title is plain text by default. When it is the page's main heading, set
`heading-level="1"` (or another level) to make it a heading.

## Theming

Top app bars support [Material theming](../theming/README.md). Every token of
Compose's `AppBarTokens` is a `--md-top-app-bar-*` custom property.

### Tokens

Token                                         | Default value
--------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-top-app-bar-container-color`            | `--md-sys-color-surface`
`--md-top-app-bar-on-scroll-container-color`  | `--md-sys-color-surface-container`
`--md-top-app-bar-title-color`                | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-top-app-bar-subtitle-color`             | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-top-app-bar-leading-icon-color`         | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-top-app-bar-trailing-icon-color`        | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-app-bar.scss)
    

## API

### PetalTopAppBar <code>&lt;petal-top-app-bar&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `size` | `TopAppBarSize` | `'small'` | `small`, `medium` or `large`. |
| `headline` | `headline` | `string` | `''` | The title. |
| `subtitle` | `subtitle` | `string` | `''` | An optional subtitle below the title. |
| `collapsedHeadline` | `collapsed-headline` | `string` | `undefined` | The title in the collapsed row of medium and large bars (Compose's `smallTitle`). When not set, the collapsed row shows `headline`. |
| `collapsedSubtitle` | `collapsed-subtitle` | `string` | `undefined` | The subtitle in the collapsed row of medium and large bars (Compose's `smallSubtitle`). When not set, the collapsed row shows `subtitle`; set it to an empty string to show no subtitle there. |
| `headingLevel` | `heading-level` | `number` | `0` | Makes the title a heading of this level (`role="heading"`), for example 1 when it is the page title. 0, the default, leaves it plain text. |
| `centered` | `centered` | `boolean` | `false` | Centers the title (`titleHorizontalAlignment`). |
| `scrollTarget` | `scroll-target` | `string` | `''` | The id of the scrolling element under the bar. Without it, the page scrolls. |
| `collapsedFraction` |  | `number` | `undefined` |  |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapse-change` | `Event` | No | No | The collapsed fraction changed (on scroll, resize or a size change). Read it from `collapsedFraction`. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `navigation` | A navigation icon button, at the start. |
| `actions` | Action icon buttons, at the end. |
| `headline` | The title, instead of `headline`, for content other than text (an icon, for example). |
| `subtitle` | The subtitle, instead of `subtitle`. |
| `collapsed-headline` | The title in the collapsed row of medium and large bars. Defaults to `collapsed-headline` or `headline` (text only: a slotted title cannot be shown twice). |
| `collapsed-subtitle` | The subtitle in the collapsed row. |

File: docs/components/bottom-app-bar.md

# Bottom app bar

[Bottom app bars](https://m3.material.io/components/bottom-app-bar)
show navigation and key actions at the bottom of the screen.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/bottom-app-bar) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/appbar)
    

This follows Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`BottomAppBar`,
`FlexibleBottomAppBar`, `BottomAppBarDefaults`, `BottomAppBarTokens`,
`DockedToolbarTokens`).

## Usage

Put icon buttons in `petal-bottom-app-bar` for the actions, and a floating
action button in its `fab` slot. Place the bar at the bottom of the page, for
example with `position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0`, and leave room for it under
the content.

```html
<petal-bottom-app-bar style="position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0">
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Mark as done"><petal-icon>check_box</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Edit"><petal-icon>edit</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Record"><petal-icon>mic</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Add an image"><petal-icon>image</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-fab slot="fab" variant="secondary" aria-label="New note">
    <petal-icon slot="icon">add</petal-icon>
  </petal-fab>
</petal-bottom-app-bar>
```

Compose's samples use a secondary FAB; the bar takes its shadow away
(`bottomAppBarFabElevation`).

### Flexible

`flexible` is the Material 3 Expressive bottom app bar: lower, with its content
spread across it. It has no `fab` slot.

```html
<petal-bottom-app-bar flexible style="position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0">
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Back"><petal-icon>arrow_back</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Forward"><petal-icon>arrow_forward</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="New tab"><petal-icon>add</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="Share"><petal-icon>share</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button aria-label="More"><petal-icon>more_vert</petal-icon></petal-icon-button>
</petal-bottom-app-bar>
```

### Hiding on scroll

With `hide-on-scroll`, the bar moves down out of the way as the content
scrolls down, by as much as it scrolls, and comes back as it scrolls up
(Compose's `exitAlwaysScrollBehavior`). Left part way when scrolling stops, it
slides to the closer end. A touch drag on the bar moves it too. The page
scrolls by default; set `scroll-target` to the id of another scrolling
element. `hiddenFraction` reads how far it is hidden, `hide-change` reports
changes, and `show()` brings it back.

```html
<petal-bottom-app-bar hide-on-scroll style="position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0">
  ...
</petal-bottom-app-bar>
```

## Accessibility

Name every icon button with `aria-label`. The bar has no role of its own; to
make it a landmark, wrap it in `<nav>` or give it `role="toolbar"` and an
`aria-label`.

## Compose behavior

*   The bar is 80dp high on surface-container, with no shadow. The actions sit
    4dp from the start and the top (16dp minus the icon buttons' 12dp), and the
    floating action button 12dp from the top and 16dp from the end.
*   The flexible bar is 64dp high with 16dp at the ends and its content spread
    out (`Arrangement.SpaceBetween`).
*   The bottom safe area of the page adds to the height.
*   A bar left part way hidden goes to the closer end on the fast spatial
    spring.

## Theming

Token                                   | Default value
--------------------------------------- | -----------------------------------
`--md-bottom-app-bar-container-color`   | `--md-sys-color-surface-container`
`--md-bottom-app-bar-container-height`  | `80px` (`64px` when flexible)
`--md-bottom-app-bar-container-shape`   | `--md-sys-shape-corner-none`
`--md-bottom-app-bar-content-color`     | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`

## API

### PetalBottomAppBar <code>&lt;petal-bottom-app-bar&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `flexible` | `flexible` | `boolean` | `false` | The Material 3 Expressive flexible bottom app bar: 64px high, its content spread with 16px at the ends, and no floating action button slot. |
| `hideOnScroll` | `hide-on-scroll` | `boolean` | `false` | Slides the bar away while the page scrolls down. |
| `scrollTarget` | `scroll-target` | `string` | `''` | The id of the scrolling element under the bar. Without it, the page scrolls. |
| `hiddenFraction` |  | `number` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | _None_ | `void` | Shows the bar again, sliding. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hide-change` | `Event` | No | No | The hidden fraction changed. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The actions: icon buttons, at the start (spread out when `flexible`). |
| `fab` | A floating action button at the end (not with `flexible`). |

# Navigation bar

[Navigation bars](https://m3.material.io/components/navigation-bar)
let people switch between a few primary destinations, usually at the bottom of
the screen.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/navigation-bar) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/navigationbar)
    

This is the Material 3 Expressive "short" navigation bar. The values follow
Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`ShortNavigationBar`, `ShortNavigationBarItem`,
`NavigationBarTokens`).

## Usage

Put `petal-navigation-bar-item` elements in a `petal-navigation-bar`. The
icon goes in the `icon` slot and the label is the content. Mark the current
destination with `selected`.

```html
<petal-navigation-bar>
  <petal-navigation-bar-item selected>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">home</petal-icon>
    Home
  </petal-navigation-bar-item>
  <petal-navigation-bar-item>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">search</petal-icon>
    Search
  </petal-navigation-bar-item>
  <petal-navigation-bar-item>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">bookmark</petal-icon>
    Saved
  </petal-navigation-bar-item>
</petal-navigation-bar>
```

The bar is 64px high and gives each item the same width. The selected item's
indicator grows from its center with the default spatial spring, as in Compose,
and its icon is filled: the item sets `--md-icon-fill` to 1, which
`petal-icon` uses for Material Symbols. For icons that are not variable fonts,
add a `selected-icon` slot, which replaces the `icon` slot when the item is
selected.

### Selection

The bar keeps one item selected. When the user picks another, it selects that
item and fires a `change` event. Read `selectedIndex` or `selectedItem` in
the handler, and cancel the event to keep the previous item selected.
Setting `selectedIndex` or an item's `selected` changes the selection without
an event.

```js
bar.addEventListener('change', () => {
  showPage(bar.selectedIndex);
});
```

### Links

An item with `href` is a link (add `target` for a new tab). The bar still
selects it when it is clicked; with a router, set `selected` from the current
URL.

```html
<petal-navigation-bar-item href="/search">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">search</petal-icon>
  Search
</petal-navigation-bar-item>
```

### Icon before the label

`icon-position="start"` puts the icon before the label inside a 40px high
indicator, for wide screens.

```html
<petal-navigation-bar-item selected icon-position="start">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">home</petal-icon>
  Home
</petal-navigation-bar-item>
```

### Items without a label

An item without a label shows only the icon. Give it an `aria-label`.

### Arrangement

`arrangement="centered"` groups the items in the middle, with a padding on both
sides that depends on how many items there are (Compose's
`ShortNavigationBarArrangement.Centered`). The default is `equal-weight`.

### Badges

Put a [badge](badge.md) in the `badge` slot of an item. It sits at the end
of the icon's top edge. Say what it means in the item's `aria-label`.

```html
<petal-navigation-bar-item aria-label="Inbox, 12 unread">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">inbox</petal-icon>
  <petal-badge slot="badge" value="12"></petal-badge>
  Inbox
</petal-navigation-bar-item>
```

## Accessibility

As in Compose, the bar is a `tablist` (`selectableGroup`) and its items are
`tab`s (`Role.Tab`) with `aria-selected`. Only the selected item is in the tab
order; the left and right arrow keys (reversed in right-to-left text) and Home
and End move the focus between items, skipping disabled ones, and Enter or
Space selects the focused item. Moving the focus does not select, so keyboard
users can browse the destinations first.

Labels are the accessible names; give icon-only items an `aria-label`. Put
the bar in a `<nav>` element to make it a navigation landmark.

## Theming

Navigation bars support [Material theming](../theming/README.md). Every token of
Compose's `NavigationBarTokens` is a `--md-navigation-bar-*` custom property;
the sizes of the items come from `NavigationBarVerticalItemTokens` and
`NavigationBarHorizontalItemTokens` as `--md-navigation-bar-vertical-item-*` and
`--md-navigation-bar-horizontal-item-*`.

### Tokens

Token                                                 | Default value
----------------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-navigation-bar-container-color`                 | `--md-sys-color-surface-container`
`--md-navigation-bar-container-height`                | `64px`
`--md-navigation-bar-item-active-indicator-color`     | `--md-sys-color-secondary-container`
`--md-navigation-bar-item-active-icon-color`          | `--md-sys-color-on-secondary-container`
`--md-navigation-bar-item-active-label-text-color`    | `--md-sys-color-secondary`
`--md-navigation-bar-item-inactive-icon-color`        | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-navigation-bar-item-inactive-label-text-color`  | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-navigation-bar-item-active-indicator-icon-label-space` | `4px`
`--md-navigation-bar-label-text-*`                    | `--md-sys-typescale-label-medium-*`
`--md-navigation-bar-vertical-item-active-indicator-width` | `56px`
`--md-navigation-bar-vertical-item-active-indicator-height` | `32px`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-navigation-bar.scss)
    

## API

### PetalNavigationBar <code>&lt;petal-navigation-bar&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `arrangement` | `arrangement` | `NavigationBarArrangement` | `'equal-weight'` | `equal-weight` gives every item the same width. `centered` groups the items in the middle, with a side padding that depends on how many there are. |
| `selectedIndex` | `selected-index` | `number` | `undefined` |  |
| `items` |  | `NavigationItem[]` | `undefined` | The items, in the default slot. |
| `selectedItem` |  | `NavigationItem` | `undefined` |  |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | The user selected another item. The target's `selectedIndex` and `selectedItem` tell which. Cancel it to keep the previous item selected. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The `petal-navigation-bar-item`s (three to five). |

### PetalNavigationBarItem <code>&lt;petal-navigation-bar-item&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the item is the current destination. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the item. |
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` | Makes the item a link to this URL. |
| `target` | `target` | `string` | `''` | Where a link opens (`_blank`, ...). |
| `iconPosition` | `icon-position` | `NavigationIconPosition` | `undefined` | Where the icon sits. Defaults to `top` in a navigation bar; a rail picks it from whether it is expanded. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | The icon (`<petal-icon slot="icon">`). |
| `selected-icon` | The icon while selected, for example a filled one; the `icon` slot's icon when empty. |
| `badge` | A `petal-badge` on the icon. |

---

File: docs/components/navigation-rail.md

# Navigation rail

[Navigation rails](https://m3.material.io/components/navigation-rail)
let people switch between a few primary destinations at the side of the
screen, and expand to show labels beside the icons.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/navigation-rail) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/navigationrail)
    

This is the Material 3 Expressive wide navigation rail. The values follow
Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`WideNavigationRail`, `WideNavigationRailItem`,
`NavigationRailCollapsedTokens`, `NavigationRailExpandedTokens`).

## Usage

Put `petal-navigation-rail-item` elements in a `petal-navigation-rail`. The
icon goes in the `icon` slot and the label is the content. Mark the current
destination with `selected`. A collapsed rail is 96px wide with the icon above
each label.

```html
<petal-navigation-rail>
  <petal-icon-button slot="header" aria-label="Menu" style="margin-inline-start: 24px">
    <petal-icon>menu</petal-icon>
  </petal-icon-button>
  <petal-navigation-rail-item selected>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">home</petal-icon>
    Home
  </petal-navigation-rail-item>
  <petal-navigation-rail-item>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">search</petal-icon>
    Search
  </petal-navigation-rail-item>
</petal-navigation-rail>
```

The `header` slot holds a menu button or a floating action button. As in
Compose, the header is not indented: give it the margin that centers it on the
icons (24px for a 48px icon button, which puts its center on the center of the
item icons).

The icon fills when the item is selected, as in the
[navigation bar](navigation-bar.md#usage).

### Expanded

Set `expanded` to widen the rail. It is as wide as its widest item plus 20px,
but at least 220px and at most 360px, and the items show the icon before a
larger label.

```html
<petal-navigation-rail expanded>
  ...
</petal-navigation-rail>
```

Changing `expanded` animates, as in Compose, with the default spatial spring:
the width of the rail, the space between the items (4px to 0), the size of each
item, the movement of the icon, and the label, which fades out as the icon
moves and fades in at its new place. Items hug their content, so the indicator
of the selected item is as wide as its label rather than the whole rail.

Modal rails (`ModalWideNavigationRail`) are not implemented. Put the rail in
a dialog or a drawer of your own for that.

### Selection

The rail keeps one item selected. When the user picks another, it selects that
item and fires a `change` event. Read `selectedIndex` or `selectedItem` in the
handler, and cancel the event to keep the previous item selected. Items can be
links with `href` (and `target`).

A `selected-icon` slot gives the selected item another icon, for example a
filled one. The icon sits above the label in a collapsed rail and before it in
an expanded one; `icon-position` (`top` or `start`) on an item fixes it.

```html
<petal-navigation-rail-item selected href="/inbox">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">inbox</petal-icon>
  <petal-icon slot="selected-icon" filled>inbox</petal-icon>
  Inbox
</petal-navigation-rail-item>
```

### Badges

Put a [badge](badge.md) in the `badge` slot of an item. It sits at the end
of the icon's top edge. Say what it means in the item's `aria-label`.

```html
<petal-navigation-rail-item aria-label="Inbox, 12 unread">
  <petal-icon slot="icon">inbox</petal-icon>
  <petal-badge slot="badge" value="12"></petal-badge>
  Inbox
</petal-navigation-rail-item>
```

## Accessibility

As in Compose, the rail is a `tablist` (`selectableGroup`, vertical) and its
items are `tab`s (`Role.Tab`) with `aria-selected`. Only the selected item is in
the tab order; the up and down arrow keys, Home and End move the focus between
items, skipping disabled ones, and Enter or Space selects the focused item.
Moving the focus does not select.

Labels are the accessible names; give icon-only items an `aria-label`. Put the
rail in a `<nav>` element to make it a navigation landmark.

## Theming

Navigation rails support [Material theming](../theming/README.md). The
container is `--md-navigation-rail-collapsed-*` (color, shape, width, top
space, space between items) and `--md-navigation-rail-expanded-*` (widths).
Items use `--md-navigation-rail-color-*` for colors, and
`--md-navigation-rail-baseline-item-*`, `--md-navigation-rail-vertical-item-*`
and `--md-navigation-rail-horizontal-item-*` for sizes and type, after Compose's
token objects of the same names.

### Tokens

Token                                                  | Default value
------------------------------------------------------ | -------------
`--md-navigation-rail-collapsed-container-color`       | `--md-sys-color-surface`
`--md-navigation-rail-collapsed-container-width`       | `96px`
`--md-navigation-rail-collapsed-item-vertical-space`   | `4px`
`--md-navigation-rail-collapsed-top-space`             | `44px`
`--md-navigation-rail-expanded-container-width-minimum` | `220px`
`--md-navigation-rail-expanded-container-width-maximum` | `360px`
`--md-navigation-rail-color-item-active-indicator`     | `--md-sys-color-secondary-container`
`--md-navigation-rail-color-item-active-icon`          | `--md-sys-color-on-secondary-container`
`--md-navigation-rail-color-item-active-label-text`    | `--md-sys-color-secondary`
`--md-navigation-rail-color-item-inactive-icon`        | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-navigation-rail-color-item-inactive-label-text`  | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-navigation-rail-vertical-item-label-text-*`      | `--md-sys-typescale-label-medium-*`
`--md-navigation-rail-horizontal-item-label-text-*`    | `--md-sys-typescale-label-large-*`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-navigation-rail-collapsed.scss)
    

## API

### PetalNavigationRail <code>&lt;petal-navigation-rail&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expanded` | `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the rail is expanded: wider, with the icons before the labels. |
| `selectedIndex` | `selected-index` | `number` | `undefined` |  |
| `items` |  | `NavigationItem[]` | `undefined` | The items, in the default slot. |
| `selectedItem` |  | `NavigationItem` | `undefined` |  |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | The user selected another item. The target's `selectedIndex` and `selectedItem` tell which. Cancel it to keep the previous item selected. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The `petal-navigation-rail-item`s. |
| `header` | Content above the items: a menu icon button that expands the rail, and a FAB. |

### PetalNavigationRailItem <code>&lt;petal-navigation-rail-item&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `railExpanded` |  | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the rail is expanded; set by the rail. |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the item is the current destination. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the item. |
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` | Makes the item a link to this URL. |
| `target` | `target` | `string` | `''` | Where a link opens (`_blank`, ...). |
| `iconPosition` | `icon-position` | `NavigationIconPosition` | `undefined` | Where the icon sits. Defaults to `top` in a navigation bar; a rail picks it from whether it is expanded. |
| `startWidth` |  | `number` | `undefined` |  |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | The icon (`<petal-icon slot="icon">`). |
| `selected-icon` | The icon while selected, for example a filled one; the `icon` slot's icon when empty. |
| `badge` | A `petal-badge` on the icon. |
