File: docs/components/navigation-drawer.md

# Navigation drawer

[Navigation drawers](https://m3.material.io/components/navigation-drawer)
give access to destinations in a side panel: over the page, beside it, or
always shown.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/navigation-drawer) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/navigationdrawer)
    

The values and motion follow Jetpack Compose Material 3
(`ModalNavigationDrawer`, `DismissibleNavigationDrawer`,
`PermanentNavigationDrawer`, `NavigationDrawerItem`, `NavigationDrawerTokens`).

## Usage

Put `petal-navigation-drawer-item` elements in a `petal-navigation-drawer`.
The icon goes in the `icon` slot, the label is the content, and a badge such
as a count goes in the `badge` slot. Mark the current destination with
`selected`, and give links an `href`. Headings (`h1` to `h6`) in the drawer get
the headline style; use `petal-divider` between groups.

By default the drawer is modal: `show()`, `close()` or the `open` property
open it over the page with a scrim. Clicking the scrim, pressing Escape or
dragging the drawer toward its edge closes it. Keyboard focus moves into the
drawer while it is open and goes back when it closes.

```html
<petal-filled-button id="opener">Open drawer</petal-filled-button>
<petal-navigation-drawer id="drawer" aria-label="Mail">
  <h2>Mail</h2>
  <petal-navigation-drawer-item selected>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">inbox</petal-icon>
    Inbox
    <span slot="badge">24</span>
  </petal-navigation-drawer-item>
  <petal-navigation-drawer-item>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">send</petal-icon>
    Sent
  </petal-navigation-drawer-item>
</petal-navigation-drawer>

<script type="module">
  const drawer = document.querySelector('#drawer');
  document.querySelector('#opener').addEventListener('click', () => drawer.show());
  // Close it once the user picks a destination.
  drawer.addEventListener('change', () => drawer.close());
</script>
```

### Dismissible and standard

With `type="dismissible"`, the drawer sits beside the page content and
pushes it aside as it opens; put both in a row (`display: flex`). With
`type="standard"`, the drawer is always shown, for wide screens. Both use the
surface color and square corners; the modal drawer is the surface container
low color with rounded end corners.

```html
<div style="display: flex; height: 100vh">
  <petal-navigation-drawer id="drawer" type="dismissible" open>
    <petal-navigation-drawer-item selected>
      <petal-icon slot="icon">inbox</petal-icon>
      Inbox
    </petal-navigation-drawer-item>
  </petal-navigation-drawer>
  <main style="flex: 1">
    <petal-icon-button id="toggle" aria-label="Menu">
      <petal-icon>menu</petal-icon>
    </petal-icon-button>
  </main>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const drawer = document.querySelector('#drawer');
  document.querySelector('#toggle').addEventListener('click', () => {
    drawer.open = !drawer.open;
  });
</script>
```

### Motion

As in Compose, the drawer opens on the default spatial spring and closes on
the fast effects spring of the page's motion scheme
(`--md-sys-motion-spring-*`). With the expressive scheme it overshoots a
little when it opens; the surface stretches so no gap shows at the edge. A
drag settles on the default spatial spring: past half of the way, or faster
than 400px/s, it goes the way it was dragged. With
`prefers-reduced-motion` or `quick`, it opens and closes at once.

### Selection

Clicking an item selects it, deselects the others and fires `change`, which
can be canceled. Setting `selected` on an item from a script deselects the
others without an event.

Items with `href` are links (`target` sets where they open). A modal drawer
stays open when an item is clicked; close it in the `change` handler if the
page does not navigate away. A `selected-icon` slot gives the selected item
another icon.

### Opening and closing

Open a modal or dismissible drawer with `show()` or `open = true`, and close
it with `close()` or `open = false`; both methods return a promise that
resolves after the animation. The drawer fires `open` and `close` (both
cancelable) before the animation, and `opened` and `closed` after it. A modal
or dismissible drawer closes on Escape; a modal one also on a click on the
scrim and when dragged toward its edge.

```js
const drawer = document.querySelector('petal-navigation-drawer');
menuButton.addEventListener('click', () => drawer.show());
drawer.addEventListener('closed', () => menuButton.focus());
```

## Accessibility

A modal drawer is a modal dialog, labeled by `aria-label` ("Navigation menu"
by default, Compose's pane title); the page behind it is inert. Dismissible and
standard drawers are a `nav` landmark with that label.

Items are links (with `href`) or buttons, all in the tab order, and the
selected one is the current page (`aria-current="page"`). Compose gives them
`Role.Tab`; on the web the drawer mixes items with headlines and dividers, so
it is not a tab list.

## Theming

Navigation drawers support [Material theming](../theming/README.md) with the
`--md-navigation-drawer-*` tokens, after Compose's `NavigationDrawerTokens`,
and the scrim with `--md-navigation-drawer-scrim-color` and
`--md-navigation-drawer-scrim-opacity` (`ScrimTokens`).

### Tokens

Token                                                 | Default value
----------------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-navigation-drawer-container-width`              | `360px`
`--md-navigation-drawer-container-shape`              | `--md-sys-shape-corner-large`
`--md-navigation-drawer-modal-container-color`        | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-low`
`--md-navigation-drawer-standard-container-color`     | `--md-sys-color-surface`
`--md-navigation-drawer-active-indicator-color`       | `--md-sys-color-secondary-container`
`--md-navigation-drawer-active-indicator-height`      | `56px`
`--md-navigation-drawer-active-icon-color`            | `--md-sys-color-on-secondary-container`
`--md-navigation-drawer-active-label-text-color`      | `--md-sys-color-on-secondary-container`
`--md-navigation-drawer-inactive-icon-color`          | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-navigation-drawer-inactive-label-text-color`    | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-navigation-drawer-headline-color`               | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-navigation-drawer-scrim-color`                  | `--md-sys-color-scrim`
`--md-navigation-drawer-scrim-opacity`                | `0.32`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-navigation-drawer.scss)
    

## API

### PetalNavigationDrawer <code>&lt;petal-navigation-drawer&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `type` | `NavigationDrawerType` | `'modal'` | How the drawer shows. |
| `quick` | `quick` | `boolean` | `false` | Opens and closes without animations. |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `undefined` |  |
| `items` |  | `HTMLElement[]` | `undefined` | The items, in the default slot. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Opens the drawer and fires a cancelable `open` event. After the animation, an `opened` event is fired. |
| `close` | `velocity` | `Promise<void>` | Closes the drawer and fires a cancelable `close` event. After the animation, a `closed` event is fired. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the drawer is opening, before any animations. Cancelable. |
| `opened` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the drawer has opened, after any animations. |
| `close` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the drawer is closing, before any animations. Cancelable. |
| `closed` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the drawer has closed, after any animations. |
| `change` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the user selects an item. Cancelable. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The drawer's content: `petal-navigation-drawer-item`s, headings and `petal-divider`s. |

### PetalNavigationDrawerItem <code>&lt;petal-navigation-drawer-item&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the item is the current destination. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the item. |
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` | Makes the item a link to this URL. |
| `target` | `target` | `string` | `''` | Where a link opens (`_blank`, ...). |
| `iconPosition` | `icon-position` | `NavigationIconPosition` | `undefined` | Where the icon sits. Defaults to `top` in a navigation bar; a rail picks it from whether it is expanded. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `badge` | Text at the end of the item, such as an unread count. |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | The icon (`<petal-icon slot="icon">`). |
| `selected-icon` | The icon while selected, for example a filled one; the `icon` slot's icon when empty. |

File: docs/components/tabs.md

# Tabs

[Tabs](https://m3.material.io/components/tabs)
switch between related views at the same level of a page.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/tabs) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/tabs)
    

## Types

1.  [Primary tabs](#primary-tabs)
1.  [Secondary tabs](#secondary-tabs)

## Usage

Tabs contain multiple primary or secondary tab children. Use the same type of
tab in a tab bar.

```html
<petal-tabs>
  <petal-primary-tab>Video</petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab>Photos</petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab>Audio</petal-primary-tab>
</petal-tabs>

<petal-tabs>
  <petal-secondary-tab>Birds</petal-secondary-tab>
  <petal-secondary-tab>Cats</petal-secondary-tab>
  <petal-secondary-tab>Dogs</petal-secondary-tab>
</petal-tabs>
```

### Selection

Add an `active` attribute to change which tab is selected.

```html
<petal-tabs>
  <petal-primary-tab>Video</petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab active>Photos</petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab>Audio</petal-primary-tab>
</petal-tabs>
```

To observe changes to tab selections, add an event listener to `<petal-tabs>`,
listening for the `change` event.

```ts
tabs.addEventListener('change', (event: Event) => {
  if (event.target.activeTabIndex === 2) {
    // ... perform logic only if index of selected item is 2.
  }
});
```

Read or set `activeTabIndex` or `activeTab` on `<petal-tabs>`. Arrow keys move
the focus between tabs and Enter or Space selects; with `auto-activate`, a tab
is selected as soon as it gets the focus. `scrollToTab(tab)` scrolls a tab of
a scrollable row into view (the selected tab scrolls into view by itself).

Tabs only switch the selection; show the matching content yourself, for
example by hiding the other panels:

```js
const tabs = document.querySelector('petal-tabs');
const panels = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"]');
tabs.addEventListener('change', () => {
  panels.forEach((panel, i) => (panel.hidden = i !== tabs.activeTabIndex));
});
```

### Icons

Tabs may optionally show an icon.

Icons communicate the type of content within a tab. Icons should be simple and
recognizable.

```html
<petal-tabs>
  <petal-primary-tab>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">piano</petal-icon>
    Keyboard
  </petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">tune</petal-icon>
    Guitar
  </petal-primary-tab>
</petal-tabs>
```

Tabs may optionally show icons without a label.

```html
<petal-tabs>
  <petal-primary-tab>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">piano</petal-icon>
  </petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">tune</petal-icon>
  </petal-primary-tab>
</petal-tabs>
```

## Primary tabs

Primary tabs are placed at the top of the content pane under a top app bar. They
display the main content destinations.

```html
<petal-tabs>
  <petal-primary-tab>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">piano</petal-icon>
    Keyboard
  </petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">tune</petal-icon>
    Guitar
  </petal-primary-tab>
</petal-tabs>
```

### Inline icons

Primary tabs can show their icons inline, like secondary tabs.

```html
<petal-tabs>
  <petal-primary-tab inline-icon>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">piano</petal-icon>
    Keyboard
  </petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab inline-icon>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">tune</petal-icon>
    Guitar
  </petal-primary-tab>
</petal-tabs>
```

## Secondary tabs

Secondary tabs are used within a content area to further separate related
content and establish hierarchy.

```html
<petal-tabs>
  <petal-secondary-tab>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">flight</petal-icon>
    Travel
  </petal-secondary-tab>
  <petal-secondary-tab>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">hotel</petal-icon>
    Hotel
  </petal-secondary-tab>
  <petal-secondary-tab>
    <petal-icon slot="icon">hiking</petal-icon>
    Activities
  </petal-secondary-tab>
</petal-tabs>
```

## Compose behavior

Tabs follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 Expressive (`PrimaryTabRow`,
`SecondaryTabRow`, `Tab`, `LeadingIconTab`):

*   Tabs share the width of the row equally and are 48dp high, 72dp with an
    icon above the label (the label and icon are 16dp from the sides). The
    divider is drawn over the bottom of the row, under the indicator.
*   The primary indicator is 3dp high, rounded, as wide as the label (24dp at
    least) and centered; the secondary indicator is as wide as the tab. Both
    move to the selected tab on the default spatial spring, offset and width
    together.
*   The selected tab has the color of the row (primary for primary tabs,
    on-surface for secondary tabs) and the others are on-surface-variant, as
    in the Material 3 specification (Compose's code gives unselected tabs the
    selected color; set `--md-primary-tab-label-text-color` and
    `--md-primary-tab-icon-color` to the selected color for that). The color
    does not change on hover, focus or press, only the ripple does, and it
    fades on the effects springs when the selection changes.
*   A scrollable row has the row's container color in its edge space too
    (`--md-tabs-container-color`, surface).
*   `scrollable` makes the row like Compose's scrollable tab rows: tabs as
    wide as their content (90dp at least) with 52dp of space at the start and
    the end. Change them with `--md-tabs-scrollable-min-tab-width` and
    `--md-tabs-scrollable-edge-padding`. The selected tab scrolls to the center
    of the row on the default spatial spring.

```html
<petal-tabs scrollable>
  <petal-primary-tab>Video</petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab>Photos</petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab>Audio</petal-primary-tab>
  
</petal-tabs>
```

## Accessibility

Add an
[`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label)
attribute to `<petal-tabs>` and any individual tab whose label needs to be more
descriptive, such as icon-only tabs.

```html
<petal-tabs aria-label="Content to view">
  <petal-primary-tab aria-label="Photos">
    <petal-icon slot="icon">photo</petal-icon>
  </petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab aria-label="Videos">
    <petal-icon slot="icon">videocam</petal-icon>
  </petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab aria-label="Music">
    <petal-icon slot="icon">audiotrack</petal-icon>
  </petal-primary-tab>
</petal-tabs>
```

### Tab panels

Every tab must reference a
[`role="tabpanel"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Roles/tabpanel_role)
element with `aria-controls`. Tab panels must be labelled with `aria-label` or
`aria-labelledby`.

It's common to reference the panel's tab with `aria-labelledby`.

```html
<petal-tabs aria-label="Content to view">
  <petal-primary-tab id="photos-tab" aria-controls="photos-panel">
    Photos
  </petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab id="videos-tab" aria-controls="videos-panel">
    Videos
  </petal-primary-tab>
  <petal-primary-tab id="music-tab" aria-controls="music-panel">
    Music
  </petal-primary-tab>
</petal-tabs>

<div id="photos-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="photos-tab">
  ...
</div>
<div id="videos-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="videos-tab" hidden>
  ...
</div>
<div id="music-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="music-tab" hidden>
  ...
</div>
```

## Theming

Tabs supports [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized in
terms of color, typography, and shape.

### Primary tab tokens

Token                                     | Default value
----------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-primary-tab-container-color`        | `--md-sys-color-surface`
`--md-primary-tab-label-text-font`        | `--md-sys-typescale-title-small-font`
`--md-primary-tab-active-indicator-color` | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-primary-tab-label-text-color`       | `--md-primary-tab-active-label-text-color` (`--md-sys-color-primary`)
`--md-primary-tab-icon-color`             | `--md-primary-tab-active-icon-color` (`--md-sys-color-primary`)
`--md-primary-tab-container-shape`        | `--md-sys-shape-corner-none`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-primary-tab.scss)
    

### Secondary tab tokens

Token                                       | Default value
------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-secondary-tab-container-color`        | `--md-sys-color-surface`
`--md-secondary-tab-label-text-font`        | `--md-sys-typescale-title-small-font`
`--md-secondary-tab-active-indicator-color` | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-secondary-tab-label-text-color`       | `--md-secondary-tab-active-label-text-color` (`--md-sys-color-on-surface`)
`--md-secondary-tab-icon-color`             | `--md-secondary-tab-active-icon-color` (`--md-sys-color-on-surface`)
`--md-secondary-tab-container-shape`        | `--md-sys-shape-corner-none`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-secondary-tab.scss)
    

## API

### PetalTabs <code>&lt;petal-tabs&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `autoActivate` | `auto-activate` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not to automatically select a tab when it is focused. |
| `scrollable` | `scrollable` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the tabs are as wide as their content (90px at least) with 52px of space at the start and the end, and the row scrolls, like Compose's scrollable tab rows. Otherwise the tabs share the width equally. The selected tab scrolls to the center of the row either way, if the row overflows. |
| `activeTabIndex` | `active-tab-index` | `number` | `undefined` |  |
| `tabs` |  | `Tab[]` | `undefined` | The tabs of this tab bar. |
| `activeTab` |  | `Tab` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scrollToTab` | `tabToScrollTo` | `Promise<void>` | Scrolls the toolbar, if overflowing, to the active tab, or the provided tab. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | Fired when the selected tab changes. The target's `activeTabIndex` or `activeTab` provide information about the selection change. The change event is fired when a user interaction like a space/enter key or click cause a selection change. The tab selection based on these actions can be cancelled by calling preventDefault on the triggering `keydown` or `click` event. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The `petal-primary-tab`s or `petal-secondary-tab`s. |

### PetalPrimaryTab <code>&lt;petal-primary-tab&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inlineIcon` | `inline-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the icon renders inline with label or stacked vertically. |
| `isTab` | `md-tab` | `boolean` | `true` | The attribute `md-tab` indicates that the element is a tab for the parent element, `<petal-tabs>`. Make sure if you're implementing your own `md-tab` component that you have an `md-tab` attribute set. |
| `active` | `active` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the tab is selected. |
| `hasIcon` | `has-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | In SSR, set this to true when an icon is present. |
| `iconOnly` | `icon-only` | `boolean` | `false` | In SSR, set this to true when there is no label and only an icon. |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `undefined` |  |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | An icon, above the label or beside it with `inline-icon`. |

### PetalSecondaryTab <code>&lt;petal-secondary-tab&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `isTab` | `md-tab` | `boolean` | `true` | The attribute `md-tab` indicates that the element is a tab for the parent element, `<petal-tabs>`. Make sure if you're implementing your own `md-tab` component that you have an `md-tab` attribute set. |
| `active` | `active` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the tab is selected. |
| `hasIcon` | `has-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | In SSR, set this to true when an icon is present. |
| `iconOnly` | `icon-only` | `boolean` | `false` | In SSR, set this to true when there is no label and only an icon. |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `undefined` |  |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The label text. |
| `icon` | An icon, above the label or beside it with `inline-icon`. |

# Search

[Search](https://m3.material.io/components/search)
lets people enter a keyword or phrase and get relevant suggestions or results.
A search bar expands into a search view that shows them.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/search) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/search)
    

The values and the motion follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`SearchBar`,
`ExpandedFullScreenSearchBar`, `ExpandedDockedSearchBar`, `SearchBarDefaults`,
`SearchBarTokens`, `SearchViewTokens`).

## Usage

`<petal-search-bar>` is the collapsed bar: a search icon, an input and an
optional trailing element. The suggestions or results go inside it. It opens
when it is clicked, when someone types in it or presses the down arrow, and
when `expand()` is called.

```html
<petal-search-bar placeholder="Search apps">
  <petal-list>
    <petal-list-item type="button">Calendar</petal-list-item>
    <petal-list-item type="button">Camera</petal-list-item>
  </petal-list>
</petal-search-bar>
<script type="module">
  import 'petal-elements/search/search-bar.js';
  import 'petal-elements/list/list.js';
  import 'petal-elements/list/list-item.js';
</script>
```

The bar is 56px high and as wide as its container, between 360px and 720px,
like Compose's `SearchBarDefaults.InputField`. It keeps its space in the page
while the view is open.

### Layout

`layout` chooses how the view opens, like the two Compose composables:

*   `full-screen` (the default, for phones) is
    `ExpandedFullScreenSearchBar`. The bar grows to cover the window, its
    corners straighten, and the input moves to the top with 8px above and
    below it.
*   `docked` (for tablets and desktops) is `ExpandedDockedSearchBar`. The
    view grows under the bar, with its width, up to two thirds of the window
    height and at least 240px, and a press outside closes it.

The full screen view is a manual popover in the browser's top layer while it is
open, so it covers the whole window, over other content (also a docked search
bar after it) and also inside an ancestor with a `transform`, `filter` or
`contain`. A docked view stays in the page with a `z-index` of 1000
(`--md-search-bar-z-index`).

### Suggestions

Any elements can be the results. For suggestions, use `petal-list` with
`petal-list-item type="button"`, and make them transparent so the view's color
shows. The down arrow moves focus from the input to the first item, and the
list handles the arrow keys from there. Put the chosen text in `value` and
close the view.

```html
<style>
  petal-list {
    --md-list-container-color: transparent;
    --md-list-item-container-color: transparent;
  }
</style>
<petal-search-bar id="search" layout="docked" placeholder="Search apps">
  <petal-list>
    <petal-list-item type="button">
      weather today
      <petal-icon slot="start">history</petal-icon>
    </petal-list-item>
    <petal-list-item type="button">
      weather tomorrow
      <petal-icon slot="start">history</petal-icon>
    </petal-list-item>
  </petal-list>
</petal-search-bar>
<script type="module">
  const search = document.querySelector('#search');
  search.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    const item = event.target.closest('petal-list-item');
    if (!item) return;
    search.value = item.textContent.trim();
    search.collapse();
  });
  search.addEventListener('search', () => {
    // Run the search for search.value.
    search.collapse();
  });
  search.addEventListener('input', () => {
    // Update the suggestions for search.value.
  });
</script>
```

### Leading and trailing elements

The `leading` slot replaces the search icon of the collapsed bar, for a menu
button for example. The `trailing` slot sits at the end, for an avatar: an
`img` there is 30px and round, as `SearchBarTokens.AvatarSize` and
`AvatarShape`. Clicks on slotted elements do not open the view.

While the view is open, the leading element is a back button and, when there
is text, a clear button comes before the trailing element, as in Compose's
samples.

```html
<petal-search-bar placeholder="Search apps">
  <petal-icon-button slot="leading" aria-label="Menu">
    <petal-icon>menu</petal-icon>
  </petal-icon-button>
  
</petal-search-bar>
```

### Opening and closing

`expanded` reflects whether the view is open. `expand()` and `collapse()` set
it and resolve when the animation has finished. The view closes with the back
button, Escape, a press outside when docked, and `collapse()`. `open` and
`close` fire when it starts to open or close.

Focus moves to the input when the view opens, and back to the input when it
closes (if it was in the bar). Typing in the closed bar, or the down arrow,
opens it. Focusing the bar does not, so keyboard users can tab through the
page, unlike Compose, which also opens it on focus from touch.

### Forms

The search bar is form associated: `name` is the input's name and `value` is
submitted. `autocomplete` defaults to `off` so the browser's suggestions do not
cover yours, and the input has `enterkeyhint="search"`. Enter fires `search`;
it does not submit the form.

## Accessibility

The input is a `combobox`: `aria-expanded` follows the view and
`aria-controls` points to the results. Set an accessible name with
`aria-label`; the placeholder is the fallback.

The results are a labelled `region` (`results-label`), not a `listbox`,
because the search bar does not manage an active descendant: focus moves into
the results with the down arrow and the results handle their own keys. A
custom results element can use `role="listbox"` itself when it does manage
focus that way.

`back-label` and `clear-label` name the two buttons that appear in the open
view. The full screen view is not modal: Tab can leave it, which does not
change what is visible but is worth handling if your page needs it to.

## Motion

The view animates like Compose's `SearchBarState`: it opens on the slow
spatial spring and closes on the default spatial spring of the page's
[motion scheme](../theming/README.md) (`--md-sys-motion-spring-*`, expressive
by default, `motion-standard.css` for the standard one). The full screen
surface moves from the bar's bounds to the window's and its corners straighten
with it, and the results fade in with the same spring. A transition that is
interrupted continues from where it is. With reduced motion the view just
opens.

## Theming

Search bars support [Material theming](../theming/README.md). The
`--md-search-bar-*` custom properties are Compose's `SearchBarTokens` (the
collapsed bar), the `--md-search-view-*` ones `SearchViewTokens` (the view),
and `--md-search-view-divider-thickness` is the divider's
`DividerTokens.Thickness`.

### Tokens

Token                                          | Default value
---------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-search-bar-container-color`              | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-high`
`--md-search-bar-container-height`             | `56px`
`--md-search-bar-container-shape`              | `--md-sys-shape-corner-full`
`--md-search-bar-input-text-color`             | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-search-bar-supporting-text-color`        | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-search-bar-leading-icon-color`           | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-search-bar-trailing-icon-color`          | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-search-bar-avatar-size`                  | `30px`
`--md-search-bar-caret-color`                  | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-search-view-container-color`             | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-high`
`--md-search-view-docked-container-shape`      | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-large`
`--md-search-view-full-screen-container-shape` | `--md-sys-shape-corner-none`
`--md-search-view-divider-color`               | `--md-sys-color-outline`
`--md-search-view-divider-thickness`           | `1px`

*   [Search bar tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-search-bar.scss)
    
*   [Search view tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-search-view.scss)
    

## API

### PetalSearchBar <code>&lt;petal-search-bar&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` | The text in the input. |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | The placeholder of the input, which is also its accessible name. |
| `expanded` | `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the search view is open. Use `expand()` and `collapse()` to wait for the animation. |
| `layout` | `layout` | `SearchBarLayout` | `'full-screen'` | `full-screen` (the default, for phones) or `docked` (a dropdown under the bar, for tablets and desktops). |
| `autocomplete` | `autocomplete` | `string` | `'off'` | The input's `autocomplete`. `off` by default, so the browser's own suggestions do not cover yours. |
| `resultsLabel` | `results-label` | `string` | `'Search suggestions'` | Accessible name of the region that holds the results. |
| `backLabel` | `back-label` | `string` | `'Back'` | Accessible label of the button that closes the view. |
| `clearLabel` | `clear-label` | `string` | `'Clear'` | Accessible label of the button that clears the input. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `undefined` | The HTML name to use in form submission. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Whether or not the element is disabled. |
| `form` |  | `HTMLFormElement` | `undefined` | The associated form element with which this element's value will submit. |
| `labels` |  | `NodeList` | `undefined` | The labels this element is associated with. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expand` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Opens the search view. Resolves when the animation has finished. Does nothing when disabled. |
| `collapse` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Closes the search view. Resolves when the animation has finished. |
| `formResetCallback` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `formStateRestoreCallback` | `state` | `void` |  |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `InputEvent` | Yes | Yes | The native `input` event on the input |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | The native `change` event on the input |
| `search` | `Event` | Yes | Yes | The Enter key was pressed in the input. Read `value`. |
| `open` | `Event` | No | No | The view started to open. |
| `close` | `Event` | No | No | The view started to close. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The suggestions or results shown in the open view, for example a `petal-list`. |
| `leading` | Replaces the search icon of the closed bar, for example a menu button. |
| `trailing` | An element at the end, such as an avatar image (30px, round). |

# Card

[Cards](https://m3.material.io/components/cards) hold
content and actions about one subject.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/cards) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/card)
    

The values follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`FilledCardTokens`,
`ElevatedCardTokens`, `OutlinedCardTokens` and `CardDefaults`).

## Types

There are three cards: filled, elevated and outlined. Content goes in the
default slot; the card is a column and does not add padding.

```html
<petal-filled-card>...</petal-filled-card>
<petal-elevated-card>...</petal-elevated-card>
<petal-outlined-card>...</petal-outlined-card>
```

## Clickable cards

With `href`, the whole card is a link; with `clickable`, a button (listen for
`click`). It gets a state layer, a focus ring and Compose's elevation for
hover, focus and press. Outlined cards keep their elevation, as in
`CardDefaults.outlinedCardElevation`. Give clickable cards an `aria-label`.

`disabled` uses the disabled container and content colors. `dragged` shows the
dragged elevation, for drag and drop.

```html
<petal-elevated-card href="/articles/1" aria-label="Open article">
  ...
</petal-elevated-card>
<petal-filled-card clickable disabled aria-label="Unavailable">
  ...
</petal-filled-card>
```

A clickable card is one target: links and buttons inside it cannot be
clicked. Use a plain card with its own buttons when the card has several
actions.

### Mouse hover

With a mouse or trackpad, a clickable card lifts 3px while hovered, and its
hover layer is a soft light around the pointer (10% at the pointer, 2% at
180px) instead of an even one. Its elevation follows Compose (an elevated card
goes from level 1 to 2). These are petal-elements additions; with reduced
motion, the card lights without lifting.

### Moved from labs

The cards used to be in `petal-elements/labs/card/`. Those modules now
re-export these; import from `petal-elements/card/` instead.

## Accessibility

A plain card has no role. A clickable card is a link or a button named by its
`aria-label`; the content is not read as part of the name.

## Theming

Cards support [Material theming](../theming/README.md). Every token of the
Compose card tokens is a custom property: `--md-filled-card-*`,
`--md-elevated-card-*` and `--md-outlined-card-*`.

### Tokens

Token                                   | Default value
--------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-filled-card-container-color`      | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-highest`
`--md-elevated-card-container-color`    | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-low`
`--md-outlined-card-container-color`    | `--md-sys-color-surface`
`--md-outlined-card-outline-color`      | `--md-sys-color-outline-variant`
`--md-filled-card-container-shape`      | `--md-sys-shape-corner-medium`
`--md-elevated-card-container-elevation` | `1`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/tokens/versions/compose/values)
    

## API

### PetalFilledCard <code>&lt;petal-filled-card&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` | Makes the whole card a link. |
| `target` | `target` | `string` | `''` | Where to open the link, as `<a target>`. |
| `clickable` | `clickable` | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the whole card a button. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables a clickable card. |
| `dragged` | `dragged` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the dragged elevation, while the card is being dragged. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The card's content. Put your own padding inside it. |

### PetalElevatedCard <code>&lt;petal-elevated-card&gt;</code>


The same properties, methods, events and slots as PetalFilledCard.

### PetalOutlinedCard <code>&lt;petal-outlined-card&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` | Makes the whole card a link. |
| `target` | `target` | `string` | `''` | Where to open the link, as `<a target>`. |
| `clickable` | `clickable` | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the whole card a button. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables a clickable card. |
| `dragged` | `dragged` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the dragged elevation, while the card is being dragged. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The card's content. Put your own padding inside it. |

# Carousel

[Carousels](https://m3.material.io/components/carousel)
show a collection of items that scroll on and off the screen.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/carousel) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/carousel)
    

This follows Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`HorizontalMultiBrowseCarousel`,
`HorizontalUncontainedCarousel`, `HorizontalCenteredHeroCarousel`,
`CarouselDefaults`, and the keylines, arrangements and snapping of the
carousel package).

## Usage

The children of `petal-carousel` are its items. Give the carousel a width and
a height (221px by default, the height of Compose's samples); each item fills
the height. Items are usually images, or blocks with an image background.

```html
<petal-carousel item-width="186" item-spacing="8" style="height: 200px">
  
  
  
  ...
</petal-carousel>
```

### Multi-browse

The default `multi-browse` carousel shows large items of about `item-width`,
with medium and small ones after them, so more items are in view. As an item
scrolls toward the start it grows to the large size; leaving, it shrinks. The
large size is changed so that the items fit the width exactly, between
`min-small-item-width` (40px) and `max-small-item-width` (56px) for the small
ones. Scrolling stops at one item at a time.

### Uncontained

`uncontained` items all have one width, `item-width` plus `item-spacing` (as
in Compose), and the one at the end is cut by the edge. Scrolling does not
snap.

```html
<petal-carousel variant="uncontained" item-width="150" item-spacing="8">
  ...
</petal-carousel>
```

### Hero

`hero` puts one large item in the middle, with small items at its sides
(Compose's centered hero carousel). Without `item-width`, the large item fills
the width less the small items.

```html
<petal-carousel variant="hero" item-spacing="8">
  ...
</petal-carousel>
```

### Item content

Each item is as wide as the large size and is clipped to its shown width, in
the middle. Content that should follow the clip, such as a label, can use the
custom properties the carousel sets on each item:

*   `--carousel-item-mask-width`: the shown width, in px.
*   `--carousel-item-mask-fraction`: from 0 at the smallest size to 1 at the
    large size, for fading content in.

```css
petal-carousel > figure figcaption {
  opacity: calc((var(--carousel-item-mask-fraction) - 0.5) * 2);
}
```

`currentIndex` is the item at rest nearest the scroll position;
`scrollToItem(index)` scrolls an item to its resting place.

## Accessibility

The carousel is a region named "carousel" (`aria-roledescription`); give it an
`aria-label`. Items without a role become groups named "slide", labeled "1 of
5" and so on unless they have a label. The carousel can be focused and
scrolled with the arrow keys, and an item that takes focus scrolls to its
resting place. Name image items with `alt`.

## Compose behavior

*   Items scroll by the large size and spacing; each is moved to the keyline
    it is at and clipped to its size there, so the shown items fit the width
    without gaps of their own.
*   The arrangement of large, medium and small items is the lowest cost one
    Compose finds for the width (`Arrangement.findLowestCostArrangement`).
*   Near the ends, the keylines shift so that the first and last items rest
    at the edges.
*   The item nearest the current one is drawn above the others.
*   Items are clipped with the extra large corner, as in Compose's samples
    (`maskClip(MaterialTheme.shapes.extraLarge)`).

## Theming

Token                     | Default value
------------------------- | -------------------------------------
`--md-carousel-height`    | `221px`
`--md-carousel-item-shape` | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-large`

## API

### PetalCarousel <code>&lt;petal-carousel&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `variant` | `CarouselVariant` | `'multi-browse'` | `multi-browse`, `uncontained` or `hero` (centered). |
| `itemWidth` | `item-width` | `number` | `0` | The large items' width in px (`preferredItemWidth`, or `itemWidth` for `uncontained`). A hero carousel without it fills the width less its small items. |
| `itemSpacing` | `item-spacing` | `number` | `0` | The space between items in px (`itemSpacing`). |
| `minSmallItemWidth` | `min-small-item-width` | `number` | `40` | The small items' smallest width in px (CarouselDefaults.MinSmallItemSize). |
| `maxSmallItemWidth` | `max-small-item-width` | `number` | `56` | The small items' largest width in px (CarouselDefaults.MaxSmallItemSize). |
| `currentIndex` |  | `number` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scrollToItem` | `index`, `behavior` | `void` | Scrolls item `index` to its resting place. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The items, one element each: images or blocks with a background. Each fills the carousel's height and is masked to its keyline. |

File: docs/components/dialog.md

# Dialogs

[Dialogs](https://m3.material.io/components/dialogs)
ask the user for a decision or show important information on top of the page.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/dialogs) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/dialog)
    

## Usage

Dialogs behave like
[`<dialog>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLDialogElement)
elements, and can be closed with a `<form method="dialog">` element.

Dialogs have three optional sections: the headline title, the main content, and
action buttons.

```html
<petal-dialog>
  <div slot="headline">
    Dialog title
  </div>
  <form slot="content" id="form-id" method="dialog">
    A simple dialog with free-form content.
  </form>
  <div slot="actions">
    <petal-text-button form="form-id">Ok</petal-text-button>
  </div>
</petal-dialog>
```

> Tip: use `margin`, `height`, and `width` CSS properties to control the
> dialog's size and position.

### Opening and closing

Dialogs are opened and closed by setting the `open` attribute or property.

```html
<petal-dialog open>
  <div slot="content">
    A dialog that is opened by default.
  </div>
</petal-dialog>
```

Dialogs are also opened and closed by calling `dialog.show()` and
`dialog.close()`.

Both return a Promise that resolves after the dialog's animation finishes.

```ts
closeButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
  await dialog.close();
});
```

The dialog fires `open` and `close` before its animations (both cancelable:
`preventDefault()` keeps it as it is) and `opened` and `closed` after them.
Escape and a click on the scrim cancel it: it fires `cancel` (cancelable),
then closes with an empty `returnValue`. Focus stays inside the open dialog;
`no-focus-trap` lets Tab leave it, which is rarely right.

`type="alert"` gives the dialog the `alertdialog` role, for urgent messages
that need a response (see [Alerts](#alerts)).

A form in the dialog with `method="dialog"` closes it when submitted, after
the browser has checked its fields (`required`, `pattern` and so on). For
other checks, cancel the `close` event:

```js
dialog.addEventListener('close', (event) => {
  if (dialog.returnValue === 'save' && !isAvailable(nameField.value)) {
    event.preventDefault();
    nameField.error = true;
    nameField.errorText = 'This name is taken';
  }
});
```

### Layout and motion

The layout follows Jetpack Compose's `AlertDialog`: 24px around the content,
16px under the headline (and under the icon), 24px above the buttons, and
buttons 8px apart at the end. When the buttons do not fit on one line they
stack, the last one (the confirm button) on top.

Compose leaves the dialog's motion to the platform, so the dialog moves like
the menu: it opens by scaling up from 80% on the default spatial spring and
fading in on the default effects spring, and closes on the fast effects spring
of the page's motion scheme (`--md-sys-motion-spring-*`). With
`prefers-reduced-motion` or `quick` it opens and closes at once. To use the
material-web animation instead, set `getOpenAnimation` and `getCloseAnimation`
to return `DIALOG_DEFAULT_OPEN_ANIMATION` and `DIALOG_DEFAULT_CLOSE_ANIMATION`
from `dialog/internal/animations.js`.

### Return value

A button's value attribute will set the dialog's `returnValue` property to
identify which button closed it.

```html
<petal-dialog open>
  <form slot="content" id="form-id" method="dialog">...</form>
  <div slot="actions">
    <petal-text-button form="form-id" value="cancel">Cancel</petal-text-button>
    <petal-text-button form="form-id" value="ok">Ok</petal-text-button>
  </div>
</petal-dialog>
```

```ts
dialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
  const cancelClicked = dialog.returnValue === 'cancel';
  const okClicked = dialog.returnValue === 'ok';
});
```

## Accessibility

Dialogs are labelled by their headlines. Add an
[`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label)
attribute to dialogs without a headline.

```html
<petal-dialog aria-label="Error message">
  <div slot="content">An error occurred, details ...</div>
</petal-dialog>
```

### Alerts

Add a
[`type="alert"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Roles/alertdialog_role)
attribute to dialogs that need to communicate an important message and require a
user's response.

Common examples include error messages that require confirmation and other
action confirmation prompts.

```html
<petal-dialog type="alert">
  <div slot="headline">Confirm deletion</div>
  <form slot="content" id="form-id" method="dialog">
    Are you sure you wish to delete this item?
  </form>
  <div slot="actions">
    <petal-text-button form="form-id" value="cancel">Cancel</petal-text-button>
    <petal-text-button form="form-id" value="delete">Delete</petal-text-button>
  </div>
</petal-dialog>
```

## Theming

Dialogs supports [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized
in terms of color, typography, and shape.

### Tokens

Token                               | Default value
----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------
`--md-dialog-container-color`       | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-high`
`--md-dialog-headline-color`        | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-dialog-headline-font`         | `--md-sys-typescale-headline-small-font`
`--md-dialog-supporting-text-color` | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-dialog-supporting-text-font`  | `--md-sys-typescale-body-medium-font`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-dialog.scss)
    

## API

### PetalDialog <code>&lt;petal-dialog&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `quick` | `quick` | `boolean` | `false` | Skips the opening and closing animations. |
| `returnValue` |  | `string` | `''` | Gets or sets the dialog's return value, usually to indicate which button a user pressed to close it. |
| `type` | `type` | `string` | `undefined` | The type of dialog for accessibility. Set this to `alert` to announce a dialog as an alert dialog. |
| `noFocusTrap` | `no-focus-trap` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables focus trapping, which by default keeps keyboard Tab navigation within the dialog.<br>When disabled, after focusing the last element of a dialog, pressing Tab again will release focus from the window back to the browser (such as the URL bar).<br>Focus trapping is recommended for accessibility, and should not typically be disabled. Only turn this off if the use case of a dialog is more accessible without focus trapping. |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `undefined` |  |
| `getOpenAnimation` |  | `() => DialogAnimation` | `function { ... }` | Gets the opening animation for a dialog. Set to a new function to customize the animation. By default the dialog scales up from 80% and fades in on the page's motion scheme springs; `DIALOG_DEFAULT_OPEN_ANIMATION` is the material-web animation. |
| `getCloseAnimation` |  | `() => DialogAnimation` | `function { ... }` | Gets the closing animation for a dialog. Set to a new function to customize the animation. `DIALOG_DEFAULT_CLOSE_ANIMATION` is the material-web animation. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Opens the dialog and fires a cancelable `open` event. After a dialog's animation, an `opened` event is fired.<br>Add an `autofocus` attribute to a child of the dialog that should receive focus after opening. |
| `close` | `returnValue` | `Promise<void>` | Closes the dialog and fires a cancelable `close` event. After a dialog's animation, a `closed` event is fired. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the dialog is opening before any animations. |
| `opened` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the dialog has opened after any animations. |
| `close` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the dialog is closing before any animations. |
| `closed` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the dialog has closed after any animations. |
| `cancel` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the dialog has been canceled by clicking on the scrim or pressing Escape. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `icon` | An optional icon above the headline, centered. |
| `headline` | The title of the dialog. |
| `content` | The body: text, or a `<form method="dialog">` whose buttons close the dialog with their `value` as `returnValue`. |
| `actions` | The buttons at the bottom, at the end; they stack when they do not fit. |

---

File: docs/components/bottom-sheet.md

# Bottom sheet

[Bottom sheets](https://m3.material.io/components/bottom-sheets)
show secondary content anchored to the bottom of the screen.
`petal-bottom-sheet` is modal: it sits above a scrim and the page behind it is
inert until the sheet is dismissed. `petal-standard-bottom-sheet` stays docked
next to the page, which remains usable (see
[Standard bottom sheet](#standard-bottom-sheet)).

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/bottom-sheets) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/sheet)
    

The values and the behavior follow Jetpack Compose Material 3
(`ModalBottomSheet`, `BottomSheetDefaults`, `SheetState`, `SheetBottomTokens`
and `ScrimTokens`). Compose has no stable side sheet component and no side
sheet tokens, so there is no `petal-side-sheet`.

## Usage

Put the content in the sheet and call `show()`. The sheet slides up from the
bottom, over a scrim, to half of the page, or to its own height when that is
smaller. It is as wide as the page up to 640px.

```html
<petal-bottom-sheet id="share" aria-label="Share">
  <div style="padding: 0 24px 24px">
    <h2>Share</h2>
    <petal-text-button>Copy link</petal-text-button>
    <petal-text-button>Send by email</petal-text-button>
  </div>
</petal-bottom-sheet>
<script type="module">
  import 'petal-elements/sheet/bottom-sheet.js';
  document.querySelector('#share').show();
</script>
```

`show()` and `close()` return promises that resolve when the animation is
finished. The sheet can also be opened and closed with the `open` attribute
and property.

### Moving the sheet

A sheet rests in one of three places, like Compose's `SheetValue`: `hidden`,
`partially-expanded` and `expanded`. `state` tells where it is.

*   Drag the sheet, with a finger or the mouse, from the drag handle or from
    the content. It follows the pointer and, when let go, settles on the
    closest place in the direction it was thrown: a fast fling (more than
    125px per second) goes to the next place that way, a slower drag goes
    there once it has moved 56px away from where it started. A sheet that
    settles on `hidden` closes.
*   `expand()` and `partialExpand()` move it by script.
*   The drag handle is a button: it expands a partially expanded sheet and
    dismisses an expanded one. With the keyboard, the arrow up key on it
    expands the sheet, and the arrow down key collapses it to its partial
    height, or dismisses it.
*   When the content is taller than an expanded sheet, the content scrolls.
    Drag the handle to move the sheet then.

### Dismissing

Clicking the scrim closes the sheet. Pressing Escape collapses an expanded
sheet to its partial height, as Compose's back handling does, and closes it
when it is partially expanded or has no partial height. Both fire a
cancelable `cancel` event first.

### Skipping the partial height

`skip-partially-expanded` opens the sheet at its full height, and dragging it
moves it between expanded and hidden, like Compose's
`skipPartiallyExpanded`.

```html
<petal-bottom-sheet skip-partially-expanded>...</petal-bottom-sheet>
```

### Drag handle

The default drag handle is a 32px by 4px bar. Put your own in the
`drag-handle` slot, or remove it with `no-drag-handle`. The handle's button
is named by `dismiss-label` while the sheet is expanded and by `expand-label`
while it is partially expanded.

```html
<petal-bottom-sheet>
  <div slot="drag-handle" style="width: 64px; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: gray"></div>
  ...
</petal-bottom-sheet>
```

### Events

`open` and `close` fire before the animation, and can be canceled. A sheet that
is dragged away and has its `close` event canceled springs back to where it
was. `opened` and `closed` fire after the animation.

```js
sheet.addEventListener('close', (event) => {
  if (hasUnsavedChanges) event.preventDefault();
});
```

### Motion

The sheet is moved by springs from the motion scheme, as in Compose: it opens
and settles on the default spatial spring, which bounces a little, and hides
on the fast effects spring. The scrim fades on the default effects spring. A
dragged sheet carries the velocity of the pointer into its spring. The
springs follow `--md-sys-motion-spring-*`, so
[`motion-standard.css`](../expressive.md) switches the sheet to the standard
scheme. `quick` and `prefers-reduced-motion` move the sheet without animation.

## Standard bottom sheet

`petal-standard-bottom-sheet` follows Compose's `BottomSheetScaffold`. It is
always on screen, docked at the bottom of the viewport, showing its
`peek-height` (56px) until it is dragged up or expanded; there is no scrim, and
the page stays usable. Give the page room for the peek at its bottom, as
`BottomSheetScaffold` pads its content.

```html
<petal-standard-bottom-sheet aria-label="Nearby places">
  <div style="padding: 0 24px 24px">
    <h2>Nearby places</h2>
    
  </div>
</petal-standard-bottom-sheet>
```

*   `value` is where the sheet rests: `partially-expanded` (the default) or
    `expanded`. Setting it moves the sheet; a `change` event fires when it
    comes to rest somewhere else. `expand()` and `partialExpand()` move it
    too.
*   With `hideable`, the sheet can also be `hidden` below the page:
    `hide()`, `show()`, or dragging it down.
*   `contained` docks the sheet at the bottom of its positioned parent instead
    of the viewport.
*   `no-swipe` stops dragging, and `no-drag-handle` removes the handle.
*   The drag handle expands a peeking sheet and collapses an expanded one (or
    hides it when `hideable`); the arrow keys do the same.

The sheet is at most 640px wide and centered, with a level 1 shadow. Expanding
and showing use the default spatial spring, collapsing and hiding the fast
effects spring, and a released drag goes to the anchor Compose picks (56dp
positional and 125dp/s velocity thresholds) on the default spatial spring.
The sheet is a `region` named by `aria-label`. Its drag handle is a button
named by `expand-label`, `collapse-label` or `show-label`, for what pressing it
does.

## Accessibility

The sheet is a modal `<dialog>` with `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"`.
Set `aria-label` to name it; without one it is "Bottom Sheet", the pane title
Compose gives it. Focus moves into the sheet when it opens (to the drag
handle, or to the child with `autofocus`), stays in it while it is open, and
returns to where it was when it closes. Disable the focus trap with
`no-focus-trap` only when the sheet is more accessible without it.

The drag handle is the keyboard and screen reader route to everything dragging
does: it is a button whose name says what activating it does (expand or
dismiss), and it handles the arrow keys. Do not remove it (`no-drag-handle`)
without another way to dismiss the sheet; Escape and the scrim still work.

## Theming

Bottom sheets support [Material theming](../theming/README.md). Every token of
Compose's `SheetBottomTokens` and `ScrimTokens` used by `ModalBottomSheet` is
a `--md-bottom-sheet-*` custom property.

### Tokens

Token                                   | Default value
--------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-bottom-sheet-container-color`     | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-low`
`--md-bottom-sheet-container-shape`     | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-large-top`
`--md-bottom-sheet-content-color`       | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-bottom-sheet-drag-handle-color`   | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-bottom-sheet-drag-handle-width`   | `32px`
`--md-bottom-sheet-drag-handle-height`  | `4px`
`--md-bottom-sheet-focus-indicator-color` | `--md-sys-color-secondary`
`--md-bottom-sheet-max-width`           | `640px`
`--md-bottom-sheet-scrim-color`         | `--md-sys-color-scrim`
`--md-bottom-sheet-scrim-opacity`       | `0.32`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-sheet-bottom.scss)
    

## API

### PetalBottomSheet <code>&lt;petal-bottom-sheet&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `skipPartiallyExpanded` | `skip-partially-expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Skips the partially expanded state: the sheet opens expanded, and dragging it moves it between expanded and hidden (Compose's `skipPartiallyExpanded`). |
| `quick` | `quick` | `boolean` | `false` | Moves the sheet without animations. |
| `noDragHandle` | `no-drag-handle` | `boolean` | `false` | Removes the drag handle (Compose's `dragHandle = null`). The sheet can still be dragged. |
| `noFocusTrap` | `no-focus-trap` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables focus trapping, which by default keeps keyboard Tab navigation within the sheet. |
| `dismissLabel` | `dismiss-label` | `string` | `'Dismiss bottom sheet'` | The accessible name of the drag handle while the sheet is expanded, where it dismisses the sheet (Compose's `BottomSheetDismissDescription`). |
| `expandLabel` | `expand-label` | `string` | `'Expand bottom sheet'` | The accessible name of the drag handle while the sheet is partially expanded, where it expands the sheet (Compose's `BottomSheetExpandDescription`). |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `undefined` |  |
| `state` |  | `SheetValue` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Opens the sheet and fires a cancelable `open` event. After the sheet's animation, an `opened` event is fired.<br>Add an `autofocus` attribute to a child of the sheet that should receive focus after opening. |
| `close` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Closes the sheet and fires a cancelable `close` event. After the sheet's animation, a `closed` event is fired. |
| `expand` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Expands the sheet to its full height (SheetState.expand()). |
| `partialExpand` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Collapses the sheet to its partially expanded height (SheetState.partialExpand()). |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the sheet is opening before any animations. Cancelable. |
| `opened` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the sheet has opened after any animations. |
| `close` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the sheet is closing before any animations. Cancelable; a sheet dragged away springs back. |
| `closed` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the sheet has closed after any animations. |
| `cancel` | `Event` | No | No | Dispatched when the user asks to dismiss the sheet with Escape or the scrim. Cancelable. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The sheet's content. |
| `drag-handle` | Replaces the default 32px by 4px drag handle. |

### PetalStandardBottomSheet <code>&lt;petal-standard-bottom-sheet&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `value` | `SheetValue` | `'partially-expanded'` | Where the sheet rests: `partially-expanded`, `expanded`, or `hidden` when `hideable`. Setting it moves the sheet there. |
| `peekHeight` | `peek-height` | `number` | `56` | How much of the sheet shows when partially expanded, in px. |
| `hideable` | `hideable` | `boolean` | `false` | Lets the sheet hide below the page (Compose's `skipHiddenState = false`). |
| `noSwipe` | `no-swipe` | `boolean` | `false` | Stops dragging the sheet (Compose's `sheetSwipeEnabled = false`). |
| `noDragHandle` | `no-drag-handle` | `boolean` | `false` | Removes the drag handle (Compose's `sheetDragHandle = null`). |
| `contained` | `contained` | `boolean` | `false` | Places the sheet at the bottom of its positioned parent instead of the viewport. |
| `quick` | `quick` | `boolean` | `false` | Moves the sheet without animations. |
| `expandLabel` | `expand-label` | `string` | `'Expand bottom sheet'` | The drag handle's name while it expands the sheet. |
| `collapseLabel` | `collapse-label` | `string` | `'Collapse bottom sheet'` | The drag handle's name while it collapses the sheet. |
| `showLabel` | `show-label` | `string` | `'Show bottom sheet'` | The drag handle's name while it shows a hidden sheet. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expand` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Expands the sheet fully (SheetState.expand(): the default spatial spring). |
| `partialExpand` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Collapses the sheet to its peek height (SheetState.partialExpand(): the fast effects spring). |
| `show` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Shows a hidden sheet: partially expanded if it can be, else expanded (SheetState.show()). |
| `hide` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Hides a `hideable` sheet (SheetState.hide(): the fast effects spring). |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | The sheet came to rest at another value. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The sheet's content. |
| `drag-handle` | Replaces the default 32px by 4px drag handle. |
