# Menus

[Menus](https://m3.material.io/components/menus)
show a list of choices on a temporary surface.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/menus) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/menu)
    

## Usage

When opened, menus position themselves to an anchor. Thus, either `anchor` or
`anchorElement` must be supplied to `petal-menu` before opening. Additionally, a
shared parent of `position:relative` should be present around the menu and it's
anchor, because the default menu is positioned relative to the anchor element.

Menus also render menu items such as `petal-menu-item` and handle keyboard
navigation between `petal-menu-item`s as well as typeahead functionality.
Additionally, `petal-menu` interacts with `petal-menu-item`s to help you determine how
a menu was closed. Listen for and inspect the `close-menu` custom event's
`details` to determine what action and items closed the menu.

```html

<span style="position: relative">
  <petal-filled-button id="usage-anchor">Set with idref</petal-filled-button>
  <petal-menu id="usage-menu" anchor="usage-anchor">
    <petal-menu-item>
      <div slot="headline">Apple</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
    <petal-menu-item>
      <div slot="headline">Banana</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
    <petal-menu-item>
      <div slot="headline">Cucumber</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
  </petal-menu>
</span>

<script type="module">
  // This example uses anchor as an ID reference
  const anchorEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-anchor');
  const menuEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-menu');

  anchorEl.addEventListener('click', () => { menuEl.open = !menuEl.open; });
</script>

<span style="position: relative">
  <petal-filled-button id="usage-anchor-2">Set with element ref</petal-filled-button>
  <petal-menu id="usage-menu-2">
    <petal-menu-item>
      <div slot="headline">Apple</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
    <petal-menu-item>
      <div slot="headline">Banana</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
    <petal-menu-item>
      <div slot="headline">Cucumber</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
  </petal-menu>
</span>

<script type="module">
  // This example uses PetalMenu.prototype.anchorElement to set the anchor as an
  // HTMLElement reference.
  const anchorEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-anchor-2');
  const menuEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-menu-2');
  menuEl.anchorElement = anchorEl;

  anchorEl.addEventListener('click', () => { menuEl.open = !menuEl.open; });
</script>
```

### Submenus

You can compose `<petal-menu>`s inside of an `<petal-sub-menu>`'s `menu` slot, but
first the `has-overflow` attribute must be set on the root `<petal-menu>` to
disable overflow scrolling and display the nested submenus.

```html

<span style="position: relative">
  <petal-filled-button id="usage-submenu-anchor">
    Menu with Submenus
  </petal-filled-button>
  
  <petal-menu has-overflow id="usage-submenu" anchor="usage-submenu-anchor">
    <petal-sub-menu>
      <petal-menu-item slot="item">
      <div slot="headline">Fruits with A</div>
        
        <petal-icon slot="end">arrow_right</petal-icon>
      </petal-menu-item>
      
      <petal-menu slot="menu">
        <petal-menu-item>
          <div slot="headline">Apricot</div>
        </petal-menu-item>
        <petal-menu-item>
          <div slot="headline">Avocado</div>
        </petal-menu-item>

        
        <petal-sub-menu
            menu-corner="start-end"
            anchor-corner="start-start">
          <petal-menu-item slot="item">
            <div slot="headline">Apples</div>
            
            <petal-icon slot="start">
              arrow_left
            </petal-icon>
          </petal-menu-item>
          <petal-menu slot="menu">
            <petal-menu-item>
              <div slot="headline">Fuji</div>
            </petal-menu-item>
            <petal-menu-item>
              <div slot="headline" style="white-space: nowrap;">Granny Smith</div>
            </petal-menu-item>
            <petal-menu-item>
              <div slot="headline" style="white-space: nowrap;">Red Delicious</div>
            </petal-menu-item>
          </petal-menu>

        </petal-sub-menu>
      </petal-menu>
    </petal-sub-menu>

    <petal-menu-item>
      <div slot="headline">Banana</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
    <petal-menu-item>
      <div slot="headline">Cucumber</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
  </petal-menu>
</span>

<script type="module">
  const anchorEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-submenu-anchor');
  const menuEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-submenu');

  anchorEl.addEventListener('click', () => { menuEl.open = !menuEl.open; });
</script>
```

### Motion

Like Jetpack Compose's `DropdownMenu`, a menu opens by scaling from 80% and
fading in, from the corner next to its anchor, on the fast spatial and fast
effects springs (expressive by default). Closing reverses
it. `quick` skips the animation.

### Groups

`<petal-menu-group>` puts menu items on separate surfaces, as in Material 3
Expressive menus (Jetpack Compose `DropdownMenuGroup`). Groups are 2px apart,
the outer corners of the first and last groups are rounder, and items follow
the selectable menu items of Compose: 44px high.

Items follow their group's corners, a petal-elements choice: the group is
padded by 4px on all sides (Compose's `GroupPadding` token), the items next to
the menu's 16px outer corners have 12px corners there, the items next to the
8px corners where groups meet have 8px corners there, and the corners between
items are 4px. Compose's own code pads groups by 2px vertically and gives every
group's first and last items 12px corners, so its items do not follow the
group's corners.

Set `type="menuitemradio"` or `type="menuitemcheckbox"` on items that can be
checked, and `checked` on the checked ones. Choosing a radio item, by pointer or
with Enter or Space, checks it and unchecks the other radio items of its group
(or of the menu, outside groups); choosing a checkbox item toggles it. Both fire
`change`. Checked items are tertiary container colored with rounder corners.

To mark the checked item with an icon, such as a checkmark, put it in the
`checked-icon` slot of each item (Compose's `checkedLeadingIcon`). An item
without a `start` icon shows it only while checked: it grows in from the start
and fades in, and goes away the same way; the space before the label stays. An
item with a `start` icon shows the checked icon instead of it while checked.

```html
<petal-menu-item type="menuitemradio" checked>
  <petal-icon slot="checked-icon">check</petal-icon>
  <div slot="headline">Follow the device</div>
</petal-menu-item>
```

Each `<petal-menu-group>` is its own set of radio items: choosing a radio item
does not uncheck radio items in other groups. If one choice spans groups, such
as "Follow the device" in one group and the languages in another, set
`single-radio` on the menu to make all of its radio items one set:

```html
<petal-menu single-radio>
  <petal-menu-group>
    <petal-menu-item type="menuitemradio" checked>
      <div slot="headline">Follow the device</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
  </petal-menu-group>
  <petal-menu-group>
    <petal-menu-item type="menuitemradio">
      <div slot="headline">English</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
    <petal-menu-item type="menuitemradio">
      <div slot="headline">日本語</div>
    </petal-menu-item>
  </petal-menu-group>
</petal-menu>
```

Like Compose's `DropdownMenuGroup`, a group that a mouse has hovered and left
takes the smaller inactive shape (`--md-menu-group-inactive-container-shape`,
8px on all four corners, the outer corners of the first and last groups too),
so the group under the pointer stands out. It lasts while the menu is open:
the menu opens again with every group in its own shape. To keep the shapes
fixed, set `no-inactive-shape` on the group or on the menu.

```html
<span style="position: relative">
  <petal-filled-button id="usage-groups-anchor">Text size</petal-filled-button>
  <petal-menu id="usage-groups" anchor="usage-groups-anchor">
    <petal-menu-group>
      <petal-menu-item type="menuitemradio" keep-open>
        <div slot="headline">Small</div>
      </petal-menu-item>
      <petal-menu-item type="menuitemradio" keep-open checked>
        <div slot="headline">Medium</div>
      </petal-menu-item>
      <petal-menu-item type="menuitemradio" keep-open>
        <div slot="headline">Large</div>
      </petal-menu-item>
    </petal-menu-group>
    <petal-menu-group>
      <petal-menu-item>
        <petal-icon slot="start">settings</petal-icon>
        <div slot="headline">Settings</div>
      </petal-menu-item>
      <petal-menu-item>
        <petal-icon slot="start">help</petal-icon>
        <div slot="headline">Help</div>
      </petal-menu-item>
    </petal-menu-group>
  </petal-menu>
</span>

<script type="module">
  const menuEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-groups');
  menuEl.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
    console.log(event.target.textContent.trim(), event.target.checked);
  });
</script>
```

Group tokens are `--md-menu-group-*` custom properties, from Compose's
`SegmentedMenuTokens` and `StandardMenuTokens`
([source](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/menu/internal/menugroup/_menu-group.scss)).
Checked items use `--md-menu-item-checked-container-color` and
`--md-menu-item-checked-label-text-color`.

### Popover-positioned menus

Internally menu uses `position: absolute` by default. Though there are cases
when the anchor and the node cannot share a common ancestor that is `position:
relative`, or sometimes, menu will render below another item due to limitations
with `position: absolute`.

Popover-positioned menus use the native
[Popover API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Popover_API)
to render above all other content. This may fix most issues where the default
menu positioning (`positioning="absolute"`) is not positioning as expected by
rendering into the
[top layer](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Top_layer).

> Warning: Popover API support was added in Chrome 114 and Safari 17. At the
> time of writing, Firefox does not support the Popover API
> ([see latest browser compatibility](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Popover_API#browser_compatibility)).
>
> For browsers that do not support the Popover API, `petal-menu` will fall back to
> using [fixed-positioned menus](#fixed-positioned-menus).

```html

<div style="margin: 16px;">
  <petal-filled-button id="usage-popover-anchor">Open popover menu</petal-filled-button>
</div>

<petal-menu positioning="popover" id="usage-popover" anchor="usage-popover-anchor">
  <petal-menu-item>
    <div slot="headline">Apple</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
  <petal-menu-item>
    <div slot="headline">Banana</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
  <petal-menu-item>
    <div slot="headline">Cucumber</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
</petal-menu>

<script type="module">
  const anchorEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-popover-anchor');
  const menuEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-popover');

  anchorEl.addEventListener('click', () => { menuEl.open = !menuEl.open; });
</script>
```

### Fixed-positioned menus

This is the fallback implementation of
[popover-positioned menus](#popover-positioned-menus) and uses `position: fixed`
rather than the default `position: absolute` which calculates its position
relative to the window rather than the element.

> Note: Fixed menu positions are positioned relative to the window and not the
> document. This means that the menu will not scroll with the anchor as the page
> is scrolled.

```html

<div style="margin: 16px;">
  <petal-filled-button id="usage-fixed-anchor">Open fixed menu</petal-filled-button>
</div>

<petal-menu positioning="fixed" id="usage-fixed" anchor="usage-fixed-anchor">
  <petal-menu-item>
    <div slot="headline">Apple</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
  <petal-menu-item>
    <div slot="headline">Banana</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
  <petal-menu-item>
    <div slot="headline">Cucumber</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
</petal-menu>

<script type="module">
  const anchorEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-fixed-anchor');
  const menuEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-fixed');

  anchorEl.addEventListener('click', () => { menuEl.open = !menuEl.open; });
</script>
```

### Document-positioned menus

When set to `positioning="document"`, `petal-menu` will position itself relative to
the document as opposed to the element or the window from `"absolute"` and
`"fixed"` values respectively.

Document level positioning is useful for the following cases:

-   There are no ancestor elements that produce a `relative` positioning
    context.
    -   `position: relative`
    -   `position: absolute`
    -   `position: fixed`
    -   `transform: translate(x, y)`
    -   etc.
-   The menu is hoisted to the top of the DOM
    -   The last child of `<body>`
    -   [Top layer](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Top_layer)
        
-   The same `petal-menu` is being reused and the contents and anchors are being
    dynamically changed

```html

<div style="margin: 16px;">
  <petal-filled-button id="usage-document-anchor">Open document menu</petal-filled-button>
</div>

<petal-menu positioning="document" id="usage-document" anchor="usage-document-anchor">
  <petal-menu-item>
    <div slot="headline">Apple</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
  <petal-menu-item>
    <div slot="headline">Banana</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
  <petal-menu-item>
    <div slot="headline">Cucumber</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
</petal-menu>

<script type="module">
  const anchorEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-document-anchor');
  const menuEl = document.body.querySelector('#usage-document');

  anchorEl.addEventListener('click', () => { menuEl.open = !menuEl.open; });
</script>
```

### Items: actions, links, checkboxes and radios

`petal-menu-item` is an action by default: clicking it closes the menu and the
menu fires `close-menu`. Handle the item's `click`, or read
`event.detail.initiator` (the item) and `event.detail.reason` on the menu.

*   `href` (with `target`, `rel`) makes the item a link.
*   `type="menuitemcheckbox"` and `type="menuitemradio"` items toggle
    `checked` themselves and fire `change`. Radio items in one menu (or one
    `petal-menu-group`; across groups with `single-radio` on the menu) form
    one set.
*   `keep-open` keeps the menu open after the item is chosen, for checkboxes
    and radios that are changed several at a time.
*   `disabled` items cannot be chosen; `selected` marks the item whose
    sub-menu is open.

```html
<petal-menu id="view-menu" anchor="view-button" single-radio>
  <petal-menu-item type="menuitemradio" checked keep-open>
    <div slot="headline">List</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
  <petal-menu-item type="menuitemradio" keep-open>
    <div slot="headline">Grid</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
  <petal-divider role="separator"></petal-divider>
  <petal-menu-item href="/help" target="_blank">
    <petal-icon slot="start">help</petal-icon>
    <div slot="headline">Help</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
</petal-menu>
```

### Placement

The menu puts its `menu-corner` on the anchor's `anchor-corner`. Both are
`<block>-<inline>` pairs of `start` and `end`; the default puts the menu's
top start corner on the anchor's bottom start corner (`anchor-corner="end-start"`,
`menu-corner="start-start"`). `x-offset` and `y-offset` move it by pixels
(`x-offset` follows the text direction). A menu that would leave the viewport
flips to the other side; `no-horizontal-flip` and `no-vertical-flip` turn that
off. See the positioning modes below for where the menu lives in the page.

```html

<petal-menu anchor="more" anchor-corner="end-end" menu-corner="start-end" positioning="popover">
  ...
</petal-menu>
```

### Opening, closing and focus

Open the menu with `open = true` or `show()`, and close it with `close()`. It
fires `opening`, `opened`, `closing` and `closed`. It closes when an item is
chosen, on Escape, on a click outside it and when focus leaves it;
`stay-open-on-outside-click` and `stay-open-on-focusout` keep it open. On open
it focuses its first item (`default-focus`: `first-item`, `last-item`,
`list-root` or `none`); on close it gives focus back to where it was, unless
`skip-restore-focus` is set. Arrow keys move between items (wrapping, unless
`no-navigation-wrap`), and typing a letter jumps to an item
(`typeahead-delay`). `quick` skips the animations.

## Accessibility

By default Menu is set up to function as a `role="menu"` with children as
`role="menuitem"`. A common use case for this is the menu button example, where
you would need to add keyboard interactions to the button to open the menu
([see W3C example](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu-button/examples/menu-button-actions/)).

Menu can also be adapted for other use cases.

The role of the `petal-list` inside the menu can be set with the `type` attribute.
The role of each individual `petal-menu-item` can also be set with the `type`
attribute. Anything else slotted into the menu that is not a list item in most
cases should be set to `role="none"`, and `petal-divider` should have
`role="separator"` and `tabindex="-1"`.

```html

<petal-filled-text-field
    id="textfield"
    type="combobox"
    aria-controls="menu"
    aria-autocomplete="list"
    aria-expanded="true"
    aria-activedescendant="1"
    value="Ala">
</petal-filled-text-field>
<petal-menu
    id="menu"
    anchor="textfield"
    role="listbox"
    aria-label="states"
    open>
  <petal-menu-item type="option" id="0">
    <div slot="headline">Alabama</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
  <petal-divider role="separator" tabindex="-1"></petal-divider>
  <petal-menu-item type="option" id="1" selected aria-selected="true">
    <div slot="headline">Alabama</div>
  </petal-menu-item>
</petal-menu>
```

## Theming

Menus support [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized in
terms of color. Additionally, `petal-menu` composes `petal-list`, and each menu item
extends `petal-list-item` ([see theming documentation](list.md#theming)), so most
the tokens for those components can also be used for Menu.

### Menu Tokens

Token                                     | Default value
----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------
`--md-menu-container-color`               | `--md-sys-color-surface-container`
`--md-menu-container-shape`               | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small`
`--md-menu-item-container-color`          | `--md-sys-color-surface-container`
`--md-menu-item-selected-container-color` | `--md-sys-color-secondary-container`
`--md-menu-item-leading-icon-size`        | `24px` (`20px` in a group)
`--md-menu-item-trailing-icon-size`       | `24px` (`20px` in a group)

*   [Menu tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-menu.scss)
    
*   [Menu item tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-menu-item.scss)
    
*   [List tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-list.scss)
    
*   [List item tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-list-item.scss)
    

## API

### PetalMenu <code>&lt;petal-menu&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anchor` | `anchor` | `string` | `''` | The ID of the element in the same root node in which the menu should align to. Overrides setting `anchorElement = elementReference`.<br>__NOTE__: anchor or anchorElement must either be an HTMLElement or resolve to an HTMLElement in order for menu to open. |
| `positioning` | `positioning` | `"absolute" \| "fixed" \| "document" \| "popover"` | `'absolute'` | Whether the positioning algorithm should calculate relative to the parent of the anchor element (`absolute`), relative to the window (`fixed`), or relative to the document (`document`). `popover` will use the popover API to render the menu in the top-layer. If your browser does not support the popover API, it will fall back to `fixed`.<br>__Examples for `position = 'fixed'`:__<br>- If there is no `position:relative` in the given parent tree and the surface is `position:absolute` - If the surface is `position:fixed` - If the surface is in the "top layer" - The anchor and the surface do not share a common `position:relative` ancestor<br>When using `positioning=fixed`, in most cases, the menu should position itself above most other `position:absolute` or `position:fixed` elements when placed inside of them. e.g. using a menu inside of an `petal-dialog`.<br>__NOTE__: Fixed menus will not scroll with the page and will be fixed to the window instead.<br>__Examples for `position = 'document'`:__<br>- There is no parent that creates a relative positioning context e.g. `position: relative`, `position: absolute`, `transform: translate(x, y)`, etc. - You put the effort into hoisting the menu to the top of the DOM like the end of the `<body>` to render over everything or in a top-layer. - You are reusing a single `petal-menu` element that dynamically renders content.<br>__Examples for `position = 'popover'`:__<br>- Your browser supports `popover`. - Most cases. Once popover is in browsers, this will become the default. |
| `quick` | `quick` | `boolean` | `false` | Skips the opening and closing animations. |
| `hasOverflow` | `has-overflow` | `boolean` | `false` | Displays overflow content like a submenu. Not required in most cases when using `positioning="popover"`.<br>__NOTE__: This may cause adverse effects if you set `petal-menu {max-height:...}` and have items overflowing items in the "y" direction. |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Opens the menu and makes it visible. Alternative to the `.show()` and `.close()` methods |
| `xOffset` | `x-offset` | `number` | `0` | Offsets the menu's inline alignment from the anchor by the given number in pixels. This value is direction aware and will follow the LTR / RTL direction.<br>e.g. LTR: positive -> right, negative -> left RTL: positive -> left, negative -> right |
| `yOffset` | `y-offset` | `number` | `0` | Offsets the menu's block alignment from the anchor by the given number in pixels.<br>e.g. positive -> down, negative -> up |
| `noHorizontalFlip` | `no-horizontal-flip` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the `flip` behavior that usually happens on the horizontal axis when the surface would render outside the viewport. |
| `noVerticalFlip` | `no-vertical-flip` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the `flip` behavior that usually happens on the vertical axis when the surface would render outside the viewport. |
| `typeaheadDelay` | `typeahead-delay` | `number` | `200` | The max time between the keystrokes of the typeahead menu behavior before it clears the typeahead buffer. |
| `anchorCorner` | `anchor-corner` | `Corner` | `Corner.END_START` | The corner of the anchor which to align the menu in the standard logical property style of <block>-<inline> e.g. `'end-start'`.<br>NOTE: This value may not be respected by the menu positioning algorithm if the menu would render outisde the viewport. Use `no-horizontal-flip` or `no-vertical-flip` to force the usage of the value |
| `menuCorner` | `menu-corner` | `Corner` | `Corner.START_START` | The corner of the menu which to align the anchor in the standard logical property style of <block>-<inline> e.g. `'start-start'`.<br>NOTE: This value may not be respected by the menu positioning algorithm if the menu would render outisde the viewport. Use `no-horizontal-flip` or `no-vertical-flip` to force the usage of the value |
| `stayOpenOnOutsideClick` | `stay-open-on-outside-click` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the user clicks outside the menu.<br>NOTE: clicking outside may still cause focusout to close the menu so see `stayOpenOnFocusout`. |
| `stayOpenOnFocusout` | `stay-open-on-focusout` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the menu open when focus leaves the menu's composed subtree.<br>NOTE: Focusout behavior will stop propagation of the focusout event. Set this property to true to opt-out of menu's focusout handling altogether. |
| `skipRestoreFocus` | `skip-restore-focus` | `boolean` | `false` | After closing, does not restore focus to the last focused element before the menu was opened. |
| `defaultFocus` | `default-focus` | `FocusState` | `FocusState.FIRST_ITEM` | The element that should be focused by default once opened.<br>NOTE: When setting default focus to 'LIST_ROOT', remember to change `tabindex` to `0` and change petal-menu's display to something other than `display: contents` when necessary. |
| `noNavigationWrap` | `no-navigation-wrap` | `boolean` | `false` | Turns off navigation wrapping. By default, navigating past the end of the menu items will wrap focus back to the beginning and vice versa. Use this for ARIA patterns that do not wrap focus, like combobox. |
| `singleRadio` | `single-radio` | `boolean` | `false` | Makes all of the menu's radio items one set, across its groups: choosing one unchecks the others. By default each group is its own set. |
| `isSubmenu` |  | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the current menu is a submenu and should not handle specific navigation keys. |
| `typeaheadController` |  | `TypeaheadController` | `function { ... }` | Handles typeahead navigation through the menu. |
| `anchorElement` |  | `HTMLElement & Partial<SurfacePositionTarget>` | `undefined` |  |
| `items` |  | `MenuItem[]` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `getBoundingClientRect` | _None_ | `DOMRect` |  |
| `getClientRects` | _None_ | `DOMRectList` |  |
| `close` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `show` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `activateNextItem` | _None_ | `MenuItem` | Activates the next item in the menu. If at the end of the menu, the first item will be activated. |
| `activatePreviousItem` | _None_ | `MenuItem` | Activates the previous item in the menu. If at the start of the menu, the last item will be activated. |
| `reposition` | _None_ | `void` | Repositions the menu if it is open.<br>Useful for the case where document or window-positioned menus have their anchors moved while open. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opening` | `Event` | No | No | Fired before the opening animation begins |
| `opened` | `Event` | No | No | Fired once the menu is open, after any animations |
| `closing` | `Event` | No | No | Fired before the closing animation begins |
| `closed` | `Event` | No | No | Fired once the menu is closed, after any animations |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The `petal-menu-item`s, `petal-sub-menu`s, `petal-menu-group`s and `petal-divider`s. |

### PetalMenuGroup <code>&lt;petal-menu-group&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `noInactiveShape` | `no-inactive-shape` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the group's shape when the pointer leaves it, instead of the smaller inactive shape. Also applies when set on the menu. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resetHover` | _None_ | `void` | Forgets the hover, back to the group's own shape at once. The menu calls this when it opens, as Compose starts a new DropdownMenuGroup each time. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The group's `petal-menu-item`s. |

### PetalMenuItem <code>&lt;petal-menu-item&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the item and makes it non-selectable and non-interactive. |
| `type` | `type` | `MenuItemType` | `'menuitem'` | Sets the behavior and role of the menu item, defaults to "menuitem". |
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `href` resource attribute. |
| `target` | `target` | `"" \| "_blank" \| "_parent" \| "_self" \| "_top"` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `target` attribute when `href` is set. |
| `rel` | `rel` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `rel` attribute when `href` is set. |
| `referrerPolicy` | `referrerpolicy` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `referrerpolicy` attribute when `href` is set. |
| `keepOpen` | `keep-open` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the menu open if clicked or keyboard selected. |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the item in the selected visual state when a submenu is opened. |
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `false` | Checks the item. With `type="menuitemcheckbox"` or `"menuitemradio"` it sets `aria-checked`, and the item shows the selected colors and shape of Compose's selectable menu items. Choosing a checkbox item toggles it; choosing a radio item checks it and unchecks the other radio items of its group (or menu), and fires `change`. |
| `typeaheadText` |  | `string` | `undefined` |  |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `close-menu` | `CustomEvent<{initiator: SelectOption, reason: Reason, itemPath: SelectOption[]}>` | Yes | Yes | Closes the encapsulating menu on closable interaction. |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | A checkbox or radio item was checked or unchecked by the user. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The headline, as text (the same as the `headline` slot). |
| `headline` | The main line of text. |
| `overline` | A short line above the headline. |
| `supporting-text` | Lines below the headline. |
| `trailing-supporting-text` | Short text at the end, such as a count or a time. |
| `start` | Content at the start: an icon, an avatar, an image or a control. |
| `end` | Content at the end: an icon or a control. |
| `checked-icon` | The icon of a checked `menuitemcheckbox` or `menuitemradio`, instead of the check mark. |

### PetalSubMenu <code>&lt;petal-sub-menu&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anchorCorner` | `anchor-corner` | `Corner` | `Corner.START_END` | The anchorCorner to set on the submenu. |
| `menuCorner` | `menu-corner` | `Corner` | `Corner.START_START` | The menuCorner to set on the submenu. |
| `hoverOpenDelay` | `hover-open-delay` | `number` | `400` | The delay between mouseenter and submenu opening. |
| `hoverCloseDelay` | `hover-close-delay` | `number` | `400` | The delay between ponterleave and the submenu closing. |
| `isSubMenu` | `petal-sub-menu` | `boolean` | `true` | READONLY: self-identifies as a menu item and sets its identifying attribute |
| `item` |  | `MenuItem` | `undefined` |  |
| `menu` |  | `Menu` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Shows the submenu. |
| `close` | _None_ | `Promise<void>` | Closes the submenu. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deactivate-items` | `Event` | Yes | Yes | Requests the parent menu to deselect other items when a submenu opens. |
| `request-activation` | `Event` | Yes | Yes | Requests the parent to make the slotted item focusable and focus the item. Used internally for menu keyboard navigation; most applications do not need to listen for this event. It is exposed for authors building their own menu-item replacements, or for advanced cases where you want to call `preventDefault`/`stopPropagation` on it to override default focus handling. |
| `deactivate-typeahead` | `Event` | Yes | Yes | Requests the parent menu to deactivate the typeahead functionality when a submenu opens. |
| `activate-typeahead` | `Event` | Yes | Yes | Requests the parent menu to activate the typeahead functionality when a submenu closes. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `item` | The `petal-menu-item` that opens the sub-menu. |
| `menu` | The `petal-menu` of the sub-menu. |

File: docs/components/tooltip.md

# Tooltip

[Tooltips](https://m3.material.io/components/tooltips)
briefly describe an element, such as the action of an icon button.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/tooltips) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/tooltip)
    

The values follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`PlainTooltipTokens`,
`PlainTooltip`).

## Usage

Give the anchor an id and point the tooltip at it with `for`. The tooltip shows
while the anchor is hovered or has keyboard focus, and for 1.5 seconds after a
touch long press. It sits 4px above the anchor, or below it when there is no
room above.

```html
<petal-icon-button id="bookmark" aria-label="Bookmark">
  <petal-icon>bookmark</petal-icon>
</petal-icon-button>
<petal-tooltip for="bookmark">Bookmark</petal-tooltip>
```

The anchor can also be set from script with the `anchor` property, for an
element in another shadow root.

`show()` and `hide()` show and hide it from a script; it fires `open` when it
shows and `close` when it hides.

### Long text

Text wraps at 200px. Keep tooltips to a few words; use a dialog or the page for
longer content.

## Rich tooltip

`petal-rich-tooltip` follows Compose's `RichTooltip`: a card with a title (the
`title` slot), supporting text (the default slot) and an action (the `action`
slot), for more context than a few words.

```html
<petal-icon-button id="camera-info" aria-label="About camera settings">
  <petal-icon>info</petal-icon>
</petal-icon-button>
<petal-rich-tooltip for="camera-info" persistent caret>
  <span slot="title">Camera settings</span>
  Choose the resolution and frame rate for new videos.
  <petal-text-button slot="action">Learn more</petal-text-button>
</petal-rich-tooltip>
```

*   It shows like a plain tooltip, or with `show()`. Without `persistent` it
    hides when the pointer leaves the anchor and the tooltip, or focus leaves
    them.
*   With `persistent` (Compose's `isPersistent`) it stays until something
    outside it is pressed, Escape is pressed, an action is clicked, or `hide()`
    is called. Use it when the tooltip has an action. Compose dismisses even a
    persistent tooltip when the mouse leaves the anchor; here it stays, so the
    action can be reached with a mouse.
*   It is 320px wide at most, on surface-container with the medium shape and
    a level 2 shadow. The title's first baseline is 28px from the top, the
    text's 24px below the title, with 16px under the text; the action row is
    at least 36px with 8px under it.
*   It sits centered above the anchor, aligned with the anchor's start or end
    at the viewport's edges, and below the anchor when there is no room above.
    `caret` draws a 16 by 8px caret pointing at the anchor.
*   A persistent rich tooltip has `role="dialog"`, since a tooltip cannot hold
    controls; otherwise `role="tooltip"`.

Rich tooltip tokens are `--md-rich-tooltip-*`: `container-color`,
`container-shape`, `subhead-color`, `supporting-text-color`,
`action-label-text-color` and the type tokens of `RichTooltipTokens`.

## Accessibility

The tooltip has `role="tooltip"` and is added to the anchor's
`aria-describedby`. Escape hides it, and it stays while the anchor is hovered
or focused, so it can be read (WCAG 1.4.13).

A tooltip only describes its anchor; it is not its name. Icon buttons still
need an `aria-label`.

### Differences from Compose

Compose hides a plain tooltip 1.5 seconds after it appears, also on hover. On
the web that would hide it while the pointer is still on the anchor, so here
only a touch long press uses the 1.5-second timeout. Compose also does not show
tooltips on keyboard focus; here they do.

## Theming

Tooltips support [Material theming](../theming/README.md). Every token of
Compose's `PlainTooltipTokens` is a `--md-tooltip-*` custom property.

### Tokens

Token                                 | Default value
------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-tooltip-container-color`        | `--md-sys-color-inverse-surface`
`--md-tooltip-container-shape`        | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small`
`--md-tooltip-supporting-text-color`  | `--md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface`
`--md-tooltip-supporting-text-font`   | `--md-sys-typescale-body-small-font`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-plain-tooltip.scss)
    

## API

### PetalTooltip <code>&lt;petal-tooltip&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `for` | `for` | `string` | `''` | The id of the anchor element, in the same document or shadow root. |
| `anchor` |  | `HTMLElement` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | _None_ | `void` | Shows the tooltip next to its anchor. |
| `hide` | _None_ | `void` | Hides the tooltip. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `Event` | No | No | The tooltip was shown. |
| `close` | `Event` | No | No | The tooltip was hidden. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The tooltip text. |

### PetalRichTooltip <code>&lt;petal-rich-tooltip&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `persistent` | `persistent` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the tooltip shown until it is dismissed (Compose's `isPersistent`). |
| `caret` | `caret` | `boolean` | `false` | Draws a caret pointing at the anchor (TooltipDefaults.caretShape()). |
| `for` | `for` | `string` | `''` | The id of the anchor element, in the same document or shadow root. |
| `anchor` |  | `HTMLElement` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | _None_ | `void` | Shows the tooltip next to its anchor. |
| `hide` | _None_ | `void` | Hides the tooltip. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `Event` | No | No | The tooltip was shown. |
| `close` | `Event` | No | No | The tooltip was hidden. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The supporting text. |
| `title` | An optional title. |
| `action` | Text buttons at the bottom; clicking one closes the tooltip. |

File: docs/components/snackbar.md

# Snackbar

[Snackbars](https://m3.material.io/components/snackbar)
show a short message about a process at the bottom of the screen, with an
optional action.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/snackbar) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/snackbar)
    

The values follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`SnackbarTokens`, `Snackbar`,
`SnackbarHost`).

## Usage

Put the message in the snackbar and call `show()`. It is fixed to the bottom
of the page, up to 600px wide, and closes after 4 seconds.

```html
<petal-snackbar id="sent">Message sent</petal-snackbar>
<script type="module">
  import 'petal-elements/snackbar/snackbar.js';
  document.querySelector('#sent').show();
</script>
```

`show()` returns a promise with the reason the snackbar closed: `timeout`,
`action`, `dismiss` or `close`. Calling `show()` again while the snackbar is
open (to show a new message in it) restarts its timer and resolves the earlier
promise with `replace`, so each call gets its own result.

### Action

`action` adds a text button. A snackbar with an action stays open until it is
closed, like Compose's `SnackbarHostState.showSnackbar()`; set `duration` to
close it anyway.

```html
<petal-snackbar action="Undo" duration="long">Message sent</petal-snackbar>
<script type="module">
  const snackbar = document.querySelector('petal-snackbar');
  if (await snackbar.show() === 'action') {
    // Undo.
  }
</script>
```

### Duration

`duration` is `short` (4 s), `long` (10 s) or `indefinite`, the same as
Compose's `SnackbarDuration`. Without it, the snackbar is `short`, or
`indefinite` with an action.

### Close button

`dismissible` adds a close button. Set its accessible label with
`dismiss-label`.

```html
<petal-snackbar action="Undo" dismissible>Message sent</petal-snackbar>
```

### Action on a new line

For a long action label, `action-on-new-line` places the buttons below the
message.

```html
<petal-snackbar action="Open settings" action-on-new-line dismissible>
  Storage is almost full.
</petal-snackbar>
```

## Accessibility

The snackbar is a polite live region (`role="status"`), so screen readers
announce the message without moving focus. Its buttons can be reached with the
keyboard. Keep messages short, and do not put the only way to do something in
a snackbar: it closes by itself.

## Theming

Snackbars support [Material theming](../theming/README.md). Every token of
Compose's `SnackbarTokens` is a `--md-snackbar-*` custom property.

### Tokens

Token                                   | Default value
--------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-snackbar-container-color`         | `--md-sys-color-inverse-surface`
`--md-snackbar-container-shape`         | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small`
`--md-snackbar-supporting-text-color`   | `--md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface`
`--md-snackbar-action-label-text-color` | `--md-sys-color-inverse-primary`
`--md-snackbar-icon-color`              | `--md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface`
`--md-snackbar-single-line-container-height` | `48px`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/versions/compose/values/_md-comp-snackbar.scss)
    

## API

### PetalSnackbar <code>&lt;petal-snackbar&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the snackbar is shown. |
| `action` | `action` | `string` | `''` | Label of the action button; no button when empty. |
| `dismissible` | `dismissible` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a close button. |
| `dismissLabel` | `dismiss-label` | `string` | `'Dismiss'` | Accessible label of the close button. |
| `duration` | `duration` | `SnackbarDuration` | `undefined` | How long the snackbar stays open. Defaults to `short`, or `indefinite` with an action, like Compose's `SnackbarHostState.showSnackbar`. |
| `actionOnNewLine` | `action-on-new-line` | `boolean` | `false` | Places the action below the message, for long action labels. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | _None_ | `Promise<SnackbarCloseReason>` | Shows the snackbar. Resolves with the close reason when it closes. If it is already open (with new content, for example), its timer starts again and the promise of the previous `show()` resolves with `replace`. |
| `close` | `reason` | `void` | Closes the snackbar. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `Event` | No | No | The snackbar opened. |
| `close` | `CustomEvent<{reason: SnackbarCloseReason}>` | No | No | The snackbar is closing: `timeout`, `action` (the action button was clicked), `dismiss` (the close button) or `close` (`close()` was called). |
| `action` | `Event` | No | No | The action button was clicked. Cancel it to keep the snackbar open. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The message text. |

---

File: docs/components/badge.md

# Badge

[Badges](https://m3.material.io/components/badges)
show notifications, counts or status on navigation items and icons.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/badges) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/badge)
    

This follows Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`Badge`, `BadgedBox`,
`BadgeTokens`).

## Usage

Without `value`, a badge is a small dot that says there is something new. With
a short `value`, such as a count, it is a pill around the value. Format large
counts yourself, for example as `999+`.

```html
<petal-badge></petal-badge>
<petal-badge value="3"></petal-badge>
<petal-badge value="999+"></petal-badge>
```

### On an icon

Put the badge in the `badge` slot of an icon button or a navigation bar or
rail item. It sits at the end of the icon's top edge, as `BadgedBox` places
it.

```html
<petal-icon-button aria-label="Notifications, new">
  <petal-icon>notifications</petal-icon>
  <petal-badge slot="badge"></petal-badge>
</petal-icon-button>
<petal-icon-button aria-label="Mail, 3 unread">
  <petal-icon>mail</petal-icon>
  <petal-badge slot="badge" value="3"></petal-badge>
</petal-icon-button>
```

```html
<petal-navigation-bar>
  <petal-navigation-bar-item selected aria-label="Inbox, 12 unread">
    <petal-icon slot="icon">inbox</petal-icon>
    <petal-badge slot="badge" value="12"></petal-badge>
    Inbox
  </petal-navigation-bar-item>
  <petal-navigation-bar-item aria-label="Chat, new messages">
    <petal-icon slot="icon">chat</petal-icon>
    <petal-badge slot="badge"></petal-badge>
    Chat
  </petal-navigation-bar-item>
</petal-navigation-bar>
```

On your own element, give the element a position (for example
`position: relative`) and the badge `slot="badge"`.

```html
<span style="position: relative; display: inline-flex">
  <petal-icon>shopping_cart</petal-icon>
  <petal-badge slot="badge" value="2"></petal-badge>
</span>
```

## Accessibility

A dot has no text. Say what the badge means in the label of the element it is
on, for example `aria-label="Mail, 3 unread"`.

## Compose behavior

*   A dot is 6dp and fully rounded; with a value the badge is 16dp high, at
    least 16dp wide, with 4dp on the sides, the LabelSmall type, on-error on
    error.
*   On an icon (`slot="badge"`), a dot is 6dp from the end of the icon and its
    bottom 6dp below the top; a badge with a value is 12dp from the end and its
    bottom 14dp below the top (`BadgedBox`).

## Theming

Badges support [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized
in terms of color, typography and shape.

### Tokens

Token                                    | Default value
---------------------------------------- | -----------------------------------
`--md-badge-color`                       | `--md-sys-color-error`
`--md-badge-size`                        | `6px`
`--md-badge-shape`                       | `--md-sys-shape-corner-full`
`--md-badge-large-color`                 | `--md-sys-color-error`
`--md-badge-large-label-text-color`      | `--md-sys-color-on-error`
`--md-badge-large-label-text-font`       | `--md-sys-typescale-label-small-font`
`--md-badge-large-size`                  | `16px`
`--md-badge-large-shape`                 | `--md-sys-shape-corner-full`

## API

### PetalBadge <code>&lt;petal-badge&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` | The text of the badge, for example a count. Without it the badge is a small dot. |

---

File: docs/components/divider.md

# Divider

A [divider](https://m3.material.io/components/divider)
is a thin line that separates content in lists and containers.

Dividers can reinforce tapability, such as when used to separate list items or
define tappable regions in an accordion.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/divider) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/divider)
    

## Usage

Use full width dividers to separate larger sections of unrelated content.

```html
<section>
  <p>Lorem ipsum...</p>
  <petal-divider></petal-divider>
  <p>Lorem ipsum...</p>
</section>
```

### Inset dividers

Use inset dividers to separate related content within a section.

```html
<section>
  <p>Material 2</p>
  <petal-divider inset></petal-divider>
  <p>Material 3</p>
</section>
```

Inset dividers are equally indented from both sides of the screen by default.
Use `inset-start` or `inset-end` to change this.

```html
<section>
  <p>Material 2</p>
  <petal-divider inset-start></petal-divider>
  <p>Material 3</p>
</section>
```

## Accessibility

Dividers are decorative by default and not announced by assistive technology.

Add a
[`role="separator"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Roles/separator_role)
attribute to non-decorative dividers that should be announced.

```html
<ul>
  <li>Item one</li>
  <petal-divider inset></petal-divider>
  <li>Item two</li>
  <petal-divider role="separator"></petal-divider>
  <li>Item three</li>
  <petal-divider inset></petal-divider>
  <li>Item four</li>
</ul>
```

## Theming

Divider supports [theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized with CSS
custom property tokens.

### Tokens

Token                    | Default value
------------------------ | --------------------------------
`--md-divider-color`     | `--md-sys-color-outline-variant`
`--md-divider-thickness` | `1px`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-divider.scss)
    

## API

### PetalDivider <code>&lt;petal-divider&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inset` | `inset` | `boolean` | `false` | Indents the divider with equal padding on both sides. |
| `insetStart` | `inset-start` | `boolean` | `false` | Indents the divider with padding on the leading side. |
| `insetEnd` | `inset-end` | `boolean` | `false` | Indents the divider with padding on the trailing side. |

---

File: docs/components/list.md

# Lists

[Lists](https://m3.material.io/components/lists)
show items of text and images in a vertical column.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/lists) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/list)
    

## Usage

`<petal-list>` is a container composed of `<petal-list-item>`s of different types.

```html
<petal-list style="max-width: 300px;">
  <petal-list-item>
    Fruits
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-divider></petal-divider>
  <petal-list-item>
    Apple
</petal-list-item>
  <petal-list-item>
    Banana
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-list-item>
    <div slot="headline">Cucumber</div>
    <div slot="supporting-text">Cucumbers are long green fruits that are just as long as this multi-line description</div>
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-list-item
      type="link"
      href="https://google.com/search?q=buy+kiwis&tbm=shop"
      target="_blank">
    <div slot="headline">Shop for Kiwis</div>
    <div slot="supporting-text">This will link you out in a new tab</div>
    <petal-icon slot="end">open_in_new</petal-icon>
  </petal-list-item>
</petal-list>
```

## Icon Items

Icons can be slotted into list-items' `start` or `end` slot.

```html
<petal-list style="max-width: 300px">
  <petal-list-item>
    Rose
    <petal-icon slot="start">local_florist</petal-icon>
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-divider></petal-divider>
  <petal-list-item>
    Tulip
    <petal-icon slot="start">filter_vintage</petal-icon>
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-divider></petal-divider>
  <petal-list-item>
    Daisy
    <petal-icon slot="start">spa</petal-icon>
  </petal-list-item>
</petal-list>
```

## Segmented

`segmented` makes each item its own surface, 2px apart, as in Material 3
Expressive lists (Jetpack Compose `SegmentedListItem`). Items have 4px
corners and the ends of the list 16px. Hovered items round to 12px, pressed
and focused items to 16px. Place segmented lists on a container color, such
as `surface-container`, since the items use `surface`.

```html
<petal-list segmented style="max-width: 300px">
  <petal-list-item type="button">
    Rose
    <petal-icon slot="start">local_florist</petal-icon>
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-list-item type="button">
    Tulip
    <petal-icon slot="start">filter_vintage</petal-icon>
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-list-item type="button">
    Daisy
    <petal-icon slot="start">spa</petal-icon>
  </petal-list-item>
</petal-list>
```

Segmented token                                   | Default value
------------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-list-segmented-item-container-color`        | `--md-sys-color-surface`
`--md-list-segmented-item-shape`                  | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small`
`--md-list-segmented-container-shape`             | `--md-sys-shape-corner-large`

## Image Items

Images should be slotted into list-items' `start` slot.

```html
<petal-list style="max-width: 300px;">
  <petal-list-item>
    Rose
    
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-divider></petal-divider>
  <petal-list-item>
    Tulip
    
  </petal-list-item>
  <petal-divider></petal-divider>
  <petal-list-item>
    Daisy
    
  </petal-list-item>
</petal-list>
```

## Compose

List items follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`ListItem`, `ListItemDefaults`
and `ListTokens`):

*   Heights: 56px for one line, 72px for two lines (an overline or supporting
    text), 88px for three lines (overline and supporting text, or supporting
    text on two lines). One and two lines are centered; three lines are aligned
    to the top. The item sets `three-line` itself; add it to items rendered on
    the server to avoid a flash of the one line height.
*   Padding: 16px at the sides, 10px above and below (Compose uses 12px for a
    mouse pointer on desktop). The leading and trailing content are 12px from
    the text.
*   Texts: body large headline, body medium supporting text, label small
    overline and trailing text, all with their letter spacing. Slotted leading
    text, such as the initials of an avatar, is title medium. Compose does not
    size avatars, images or videos, and neither does the list item; set the
    size of what you slot.
*   Shape: 4px corners. An interactive item (`type="button"` or `"link"`)
    changes to 12px when hovered and 16px when focused or pressed; a `selected`
    item is 16px. The shape changes on the fast spatial spring.
*   `selected` draws the secondary container with `on-secondary-container`
    texts and icons. It is a visual state (set it from your selection logic).
    It sets `aria-selected`, but items have no selection behavior of their own.
*   Disabled: texts and icons are `on-surface` at 38%; the container does not
    fade. A disabled item shows no state layer.
*   State layers are drawn in the color of the text (`on-surface`, or
    `on-secondary-container` when selected): hover 8%, pressed 10%.
*   The item is transparent, so the `petal-list` container color shows;
    Compose draws `surface`, which is also the color of the list. In a
    [segmented](#segmented) list each item draws its own surface.
*   Compose's `SegmentedListItem` is the [segmented](#segmented) list; it
    shares these values.

Compose's dragged state (for reorderable lists) has no counterpart here, so
its tokens are not used.

## Accessibility

List can have its `role` and `tabindex` set via the `role` and `tabindex`
attributes, and list items can have their `role` and `tabindex` set via the
`type` and `tabindex` attributes respectively.

> NOTE: List item has a limited set of `type`s that can be set on it. This is to
> ensure that your list remains accessible with all other properties and options
> presented to it. See the `ListItemType` TypeScript type exported by list item
> for the current accepted values.

By default these values are set to
[`role="list"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Roles/list_role)
and `tabindex="-1"` for list, and
[`role="listitem"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Roles/listitem_role)
and `tabindex="0"` for list items.

## Theming

List and List Item supports
[Material theming](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/docs/theming/README.md)
and can be customized in terms of color, typography, and shape.

### List & List Item

Token                                           | Default value
----------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-list-container-color`                     | `--md-sys-color-surface`
`--md-list-item-container-shape`                | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small`
`--md-list-item-hovered-container-shape`        | `--md-sys-shape-corner-medium`
`--md-list-item-focused-container-shape`        | `--md-sys-shape-corner-large`
`--md-list-item-pressed-container-shape`        | `--md-sys-shape-corner-large`
`--md-list-item-selected-container-shape`       | `--md-sys-shape-corner-large`
`--md-list-item-container-color`                | `transparent`
`--md-list-item-label-text-color`               | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-list-item-overline-color`                 | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-list-item-supporting-text-color`          | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-list-item-trailing-supporting-text-color` | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-list-item-label-text-font`                | `--md-sys-typescale-body-large-font`
`--md-list-item-overline-font`                  | `--md-sys-typescale-label-small-font`
`--md-list-item-supporting-text-font`           | `--md-sys-typescale-body-medium-font`
`--md-list-item-trailing-supporting-text-font`  | `--md-sys-typescale-label-small-font`
`--md-list-item-one-line-container-height`      | `56px`
`--md-list-item-two-line-container-height`      | `72px`
`--md-list-item-three-line-container-height`    | `88px`
`--md-list-item-top-space`, `-bottom-space`     | `10px`
`--md-list-item-leading-space`, `-trailing-space` | `16px`
