`--md-list-item-selected-leading-icon-color`    | `--md-sys-color-on-secondary-container`

*   [All List tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-list.scss)
    
*   [All List Item tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-list-item.scss)
    

### Icon List Item

Token                                | Default value
------------------------------------ | -----------------------------------
`--md-list-item-leading-icon-color`  | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-list-item-trailing-icon-color` | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`

Icons are as big as the icon you slot (24px for `petal-icon`); set
`--md-icon-size` on them to change it.

*   [All List Item tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-list-item.scss)
    

### Avatar and Image List Items

Like Compose's `ListItem`, the list item does not size or shape what you put in
the `start` slot; style your avatar, image or video yourself (Compose's avatar
is 40px and round, its image 56px, its video 100px by 56px with 8px corners).
Text in the `start` slot is title medium, which can be changed with
`--md-list-item-leading-avatar-label-font`, `-size`, `-line-height`, `-weight`
and `-tracking`.

## API

### PetalList <code>&lt;petal-list&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `segmented` | `segmented` | `boolean` | `false` | Segmented list (Material 3 Expressive): items are separate surfaces 2px apart, with rounder corners at the ends of the list. |
| `items` |  | `ListItem[]` | `undefined` |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activateNextItem` | _None_ | `ListItem` | Activates the next item in the list. If at the end of the list, the first item will be activated. |
| `activatePreviousItem` | _None_ | `ListItem` | Activates the previous item in the list. If at the start of the list, the last item will be activated. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The `petal-list-item`s, and `petal-divider`s between them. |

### PetalListItem <code>&lt;petal-list-item&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the item and makes it non-selectable and non-interactive. |
| `type` | `type` | `ListItemType` | `'text'` | Sets the behavior of the list item, defaults to "text". Change to "link" or "button" for interactive items. |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the item as selected (Compose's `ListItem(selected = ...)`): the secondary container color, on-secondary-container texts and icons, and rounded corners. It does not change by itself; set it from your selection logic. |
| `threeLine` | `three-line` | `boolean` | `false` | Only needed for SSR.<br>Set automatically on items of three lines: with both overline and supporting text, or with supporting text on more than one line. Such an item is 88px high and its content is aligned to the top. Add this attribute to avoid a flash of unstyled content when rendering on the server. |
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `href` resource attribute. |
| `target` | `target` | `"" \| "_blank" \| "_parent" \| "_self" \| "_top"` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `target` attribute when `href` is set. |
| `rel` | `rel` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `rel` attribute when `href` is set. |
| `referrerPolicy` | `referrerpolicy` | `string` | `''` | Sets the underlying `HTMLAnchorElement`'s `referrerpolicy` attribute when `href` is set. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `click` | _None_ | `void` |  |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request-activation` | `Event` | Yes | Yes | Requests the list to set `tabindex=0` on the item and focus it. Used internally for list keyboard navigation; most applications do not need to listen for this event. It is exposed for authors building their own list-item replacements or wrapping items in a custom controller. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The headline, as text (the same as the `headline` slot). |
| `headline` | The main line of text. |
| `overline` | A short line above the headline. |
| `supporting-text` | Lines below the headline. |
| `trailing-supporting-text` | Short text at the end, such as a count or a time. |
| `start` | Content at the start: an icon, an avatar, an image or a control. |
| `end` | Content at the end: an icon or a control. |

---

File: docs/components/text-field.md

# Text field

[Text fields](https://m3.material.io/components/text-fields)
let users type text.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/text-fields) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/textfield)
    

## Types

1.  [Filled text field](#filled-text-field)
1.  [Outlined text field](#outlined-text-field)

## Usage

Text fields behave like
[`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input)
elements. They provide a container with labels for user input.

```html
<petal-filled-text-field label="Label" value="Value">
</petal-filled-text-field>

<petal-outlined-text-field label="Label" value="Value">
</petal-outlined-text-field>
```

### Input type

A text field's `type` attribute changes how the text field works, such as
displaying a different keyboard or providing default validation.

-   [`type="text"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/text)
    (default)
-   [`type="email"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/email)
    
-   [`type="number"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/number)
    
-   [`type="password"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/password)
    
-   [`type="search"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/search)
    
-   [`type="tel"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/tel)
    
-   [`type="url"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/url)
    
-   [`type="textarea"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/textarea)
    
-   [`type="date"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/date),
    `datetime-local`, `month`, `time` and `week`. The browser shows a format
    hint, so the label always floats. Without a trailing icon, the browser's
    picker icon is shown; with one, open the picker with `showPicker()`.

```html
<petal-filled-text-field label="Username" type="email">
</petal-filled-text-field>

<petal-filled-text-field label="Password" type="password">
</petal-filled-text-field>
```

> Tip: use the
> [`inputmode`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/inputmode)
> attribute for more control over the displayed keyboard. `enterkeyhint`,
> `spellcheck` and `autocapitalize` set on the text field are passed to the
> input too.

### Labels

Text fields should label their value with a floating `label`, a `placeholder`,
or an external label. Labels help the user understand what value to input.

```html
<petal-outlined-text-field label="Favorite food">
</petal-outlined-text-field>

<petal-outlined-text-field placeholder="email@domain.com">
</petal-outlined-text-field>

<div>First name</div>
<petal-outlined-text-field aria-label="First name">
</petal-outlined-text-field>
```

> Note: text fields do not currently support `aria-labelledby`. External labels
> must provide an `aria-label`. See b/276484803.

### Textarea

Multi-line text fields behave like
[`<textarea>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/textarea)
elements.

Textareas can specify the initial number of `rows`. Use CSS `width`, `height`,
and `resize` to control the resize behavior of a textarea.

```html
<style>
  petal-filled-text-field {
    resize: vertical;
  }
</style>
<petal-filled-text-field
    type="textarea"
    label="Vertical resize"
    rows="3">
</petal-filled-text-field>
```

### Icons

Text fields may display optional icons. Use icons to describe the input method
(such as a search icon), provide additional functionality (such as a clear
icon), or to express errors.

```html
<petal-outlined-text-field placeholder="Search for messages">
  <petal-icon slot="leading-icon">search</petal-icon>
</petal-outlined-text-field>

<petal-outlined-text-field label="Password" type="password">
  <petal-icon-button toggle slot="trailing-icon">
    <petal-icon>visibility</petal-icon>
    <petal-icon slot="selected">visibility_off</petal-icon>
  </petal-icon-button>
</petal-outlined-text-field>

<petal-outlined-text-field
    label="Username"
    error
    error-text="Username not available">
  <petal-icon slot="trailing-icon">error</petal-icon>
</petal-outlined-text-field>
```

A slot can hold several icons or icon buttons. As in Compose, each one is
centered in a 48px box and the boxes sit side by side.

```html
<petal-outlined-text-field label="Amount" type="number">
  <petal-icon-button slot="trailing-icon" aria-label="Clear">
    <petal-icon>close</petal-icon>
  </petal-icon-button>
  <petal-icon-button slot="trailing-icon" aria-label="Save">
    <petal-icon>bookmark_add</petal-icon>
  </petal-icon-button>
</petal-outlined-text-field>
```

### Prefix and suffix

Add `prefix-text` and `suffix-text` attributes to text fields to display
additional context for the value.

```html
<petal-outlined-text-field
    label="Dollar amount"
    type="number"
    value="0"
    prefix-text="$"
    suffix-text=".00">
</petal-outlined-text-field>
```

### Supporting text

Supporting text conveys additional information about the input field, such as
how it will be used. Supporting text can be replaced with error text when
[validating](#validation).

```html
<petal-filled-text-field
    label="Comments"
    supporting-text="Provide comments for the issue">
</petal-filled-text-field>

<petal-filled-text-field
    label="Name"
    required
    supporting-text="*required"
    error-text="Please fill out this field">
</petal-filled-text-field>
```

### Character counter

Text fields with a `maxlength` attribute will display a character counter.

```html
<petal-outlined-text-field label="Title" value="Short" maxlength="10">
</petal-outlined-text-field>
```

Add `no-counter` to limit the length without showing the counter.

### Validation

Text fields that validate can use
[constraint validation](#constraint-validation) or
[manual validation](#manual-validation).

#### Constraint validation

Text fields may validate using the browser's
[constraint validation](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Constraint_validation)
API. Each [input type](#input-type) above links to an article that describes how
to validate it.

Text fields in a `<form>` will validate on submission, or by calling
`textField.reportValidity()`.

```html
<form>
  <petal-filled-text-field
      name="name"
      label="Name"
      required>
  </petal-filled-text-field>
  <petal-filled-text-field
      name="email"
      label="Email"
      pattern="[\w\d-]+"
      suffix-text="@gmail.com">
  </petal-filled-text-field>
</form>
```

Use the following properties and methods to check and report validation errors.

-   `validity` is the text field's current
    [`ValidityState`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ValidityState).
-   [`setCustomValidity()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/setCustomValidity)
    sets a custom error message.
-   [`checkValidity()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/checkValidity)
    dispatches an
    [`invalid` event](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/invalid_event).
-   [`reportValidity()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/reportValidity)
    dispatches an
    [`invalid` event](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/invalid_event)
    and displays the error in the text field's supporting text.

#### Manual validation

Alternatively, text fields can manually control their error state and error
message. Use manual validation if the text fields are driven by application
state logic.

```html
<petal-outlined-text-field
    label="Username"
    value="jdoe"
    error
    error-text="Username is not available">
</petal-outlined-text-field>
```

> Tip: Prefer [constraint validation](#constraint-validation) when possible for
> more platform features, such as `<form>` validation and listening to `invalid`
> events.

### Native input attributes

The text field passes these on to its `<input>` (or `<textarea>`), so they
work as on native inputs: `name`, `value`, `placeholder`, `required`,
`disabled`, `readonly`, `autocomplete`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `minlength`,
`maxlength`, `pattern`, `multiple`, `inputmode`, `enterkeyhint`,
`spellcheck`, `autocapitalize`, and `rows` and `cols` for a textarea.
`text-direction` sets the input's `dir`. `no-spinner` hides the arrows of a
`type="number"` field.

It is form-associated: with a `name`, its `value` is submitted with its form,
and `type="reset"` buttons reset it. Enter in a single-line field submits the
form, as in a native input (not while an IME composition ends, and not when a
`keydown` listener cancels the key). It fires `input` while typing, `change`
when the value is committed, and `select` when text is selected.

The input's methods and properties are on the element too: `select()`,
`setSelectionRange()`, `setRangeText()`, `selectionStart`, `selectionEnd`,
`selectionDirection`, `stepUp()`, `stepDown()`, `valueAsNumber`,
`valueAsDate` and `showPicker()`.

```html
<form>
  <petal-outlined-text-field
      label="Email"
      name="email"
      type="email"
      autocomplete="email"
      required></petal-outlined-text-field>
  <petal-outlined-text-field
      label="Guests"
      name="guests"
      type="number"
      min="1"
      max="8"
      value="2"></petal-outlined-text-field>
</form>
```

## Accessibility

Add an
[`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label)
attribute to text fields with external labels or text fields whose labels need
to be more descriptive.

```html
<div>Username</div>
<petal-filled-text-field aria-label="Username"></petal-filled-text-field>

<petal-filled-text-field label="First" aria-label="First name"></petal-filled-text-field>
```

## Filled text field

Filled and outlined text fields are functionally identical. See
[choosing a text field](https://m3.material.io/components/text-fields/guidelines#83956188-4d8f-4c11-9389-aaba30b10214)
for guidance on which one to use.

```html
<petal-filled-text-field label="Filled" value="Value"></petal-filled-text-field>
```

## Outlined text field

Filled and outlined text fields are functionally identical. See
[choosing a text field](https://m3.material.io/components/text-fields/guidelines#83956188-4d8f-4c11-9389-aaba30b10214)
for guidance on which one to use.

```html
<petal-outlined-text-field label="Outlined" value="Value"></petal-outlined-text-field>
```

## Compose

The text fields follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 (`TextField`,
`OutlinedTextField` and `TextFieldDefaults`), and every `--md-*` token stays:

*   The size is at least 280px by 56px; the focused indicator and outline are
    2px (the web tokens say 3px); text has the letter spacing of its type scale
    (body large 0.5px, body small 0.4px).
*   There is no hover state, as in Compose: the hover tokens default to the
    resting values and the hover state layer to 0. Set the hover tokens (for
    example `--md-filled-text-field-hover-state-layer-opacity: 0.08`) to bring
    it back.
*   A disabled filled text field keeps its container color (it is not on-surface
    at 4%).
*   The label floats on the fast spatial spring (a small overshoot with the
    default expressive motion scheme) and changes color on the fast effects
    spring. The filled indicator grows from 1px to 2px on the fast spatial
    spring and changes color on the fast effects spring. The outline changes
    color on the fast effects spring, the focused outline fades in on the fast
    spatial spring, and the cut in the outline grows with the label. The
    placeholder fades in on the slow effects spring. With reduced motion the
    label does not move and nothing animates. Pages switch the motion scheme
    with `motion-standard.css`.

## Theming

Text fields support [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be
customized in terms of color, typography, and shape.

### Filled text field tokens

Token                                                 | Default value
----------------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-filled-text-field-container-shape`              | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small`
`--md-filled-text-field-container-color`              | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-highest`
`--md-filled-text-field-focus-active-indicator-color` | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-filled-text-field-input-text-font`              | `--md-sys-typescale-body-large-font`
`--md-filled-text-field-label-text-font`              | `--md-sys-typescale-body-large-font`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-filled-text-field.scss)
    

### Outlined text field tokens

Token                                          | Default value
---------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-outlined-text-field-container-shape`     | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small`
`--md-outlined-text-field-focus-outline-color` | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-outlined-text-field-input-text-font`     | `--md-sys-typescale-body-large-font`
`--md-outlined-text-field-label-text-font`     | `--md-sys-typescale-body-large-font`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-outlined-text-field.scss)
    

## API

### PetalFilledTextField <code>&lt;petal-filled-text-field&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Gets or sets whether or not the text field is in a visually invalid state.<br>This error state overrides the error state controlled by `reportValidity()`. |
| `errorText` | `error-text` | `string` | `''` | The error message that replaces supporting text when `error` is true. If `errorText` is an empty string, then the supporting text will continue to show.<br>This error message overrides the error message displayed by `reportValidity()`. |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | The floating Material label of the textfield component. It informs the user about what information is requested for a text field. It is aligned with the input text, is always visible, and it floats when focused or when text is entered into the textfield. This label also sets accessibilty labels, but the accessible label is overriden by `aria-label`.<br>Learn more about floating labels from the Material Design guidelines: https://m3.material.io/components/text-fields/guidelines |
| `noAsterisk` | `no-asterisk` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the asterisk on the floating label, when the text field is required. |
| `noCounter` | `no-counter` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the character counter that `maxlength` shows. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Indicates that the user must specify a value for the input before the owning form can be submitted and will render an error state when `reportValidity()` is invoked when value is empty. Additionally the floating label will render an asterisk `"*"` when true. |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` | The current value of the text field. It is always a string. |
| `prefixText` | `prefix-text` | `string` | `''` | An optional prefix to display before the input value. |
| `suffixText` | `suffix-text` | `string` | `''` | An optional suffix to display after the input value. |
| `hasLeadingIcon` | `has-leading-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the text field has a leading icon. Used for SSR. |
| `hasTrailingIcon` | `has-trailing-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the text field has a trailing icon. Used for SSR. |
| `supportingText` | `supporting-text` | `string` | `''` | Conveys additional information below the text field, such as how it should be used. |
| `textDirection` | `text-direction` | `string` | `''` | Override the input text CSS `direction`. Useful for RTL languages that use LTR notation for fractions. |
| `rows` | `rows` | `number` | `2` | The number of rows to display for a `type="textarea"` text field. Defaults to 2. |
| `cols` | `cols` | `number` | `20` | The number of cols to display for a `type="textarea"` text field. Defaults to 20. |
| `inputMode` | `inputmode` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `enterKeyHint` | `enterkeyhint` | `string` | `''` | The input's `enterkeyhint`: the label of the enter key on virtual keyboards. |
| `max` | `max` | `string` | `''` | Defines the greatest value in the range of permitted values. |
| `maxLength` | `maxlength` | `number` | `-1` | The maximum number of characters a user can enter into the text field. Set to -1 for none. |
| `min` | `min` | `string` | `''` | Defines the most negative value in the range of permitted values. |
| `minLength` | `minlength` | `number` | `-1` | The minimum number of characters a user can enter into the text field. Set to -1 for none. |
| `noSpinner` | `no-spinner` | `boolean` | `false` | When true, hide the spinner for `type="number"` text fields. |
| `pattern` | `pattern` | `string` | `''` | A regular expression that the text field's value must match to pass constraint validation. |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Defines the text displayed in the textfield when it has no value. Provides a brief hint to the user as to the expected type of data that should be entered into the control. Unlike `label`, the placeholder is not visible and does not float when the textfield has a value. |
| `readOnly` | `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Indicates whether or not a user should be able to edit the text field's value. |
| `multiple` | `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Indicates that input accepts multiple email addresses. |
| `step` | `step` | `string` | `''` | Returns or sets the element's step attribute, which works with min and max to limit the increments at which a numeric or date-time value can be set. |
| `type` | `type` | `TextFieldType \| UnsupportedTextFieldType` | `'text'` | The `<input>` type to use, defaults to "text". The type greatly changes how the text field behaves.<br>Text fields support a limited number of `<input>` types:<br>- text - textarea - email - number - password - search - tel - url - date, datetime-local, month, time, week (the label stays floated, since the browser shows a format hint; without a trailing icon, the browser's picker icon is shown)<br>See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#input_types for more details on each input type. |
| `autocomplete` | `autocomplete` | `string` | `''` | Describes what, if any, type of autocomplete functionality the input should provide. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `undefined` | The HTML name to use in form submission. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Whether or not the element is disabled. |
| `selectionDirection` |  | `"forward" \| "none" \| "backward"` | `undefined` |  |
| `selectionEnd` |  | `number` | `undefined` |  |
| `selectionStart` |  | `number` | `undefined` |  |
| `valueAsNumber` |  | `number` | `undefined` |  |
| `valueAsDate` |  | `Date` | `undefined` |  |
| `form` |  | `HTMLFormElement` | `undefined` | The associated form element with which this element's value will submit. |
| `labels` |  | `NodeList` | `undefined` | The labels this element is associated with. |
| `validity` |  | `ValidityState` | `undefined` | Returns a ValidityState object that represents the validity states of the element. |
| `validationMessage` |  | `string` | `undefined` | Returns a validation error message or an empty string if the element is valid. |
| `willValidate` |  | `boolean` | `undefined` | Returns whether an element will successfully validate based on forms validation rules and constraints.<br>Disabled and readonly elements will not validate. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `select` | _None_ | `void` | Selects all the text in the text field. |
| `setRangeText` | `args` | `void` |  |
| `setSelectionRange` | `start`, `end`, `direction` | `void` | Sets the start and end positions of a selection in the text field. |
| `showPicker` | _None_ | `void` | Shows the browser picker for an input element of type "date", "time", etc.<br>For a full list of supported types, see: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/showPicker#browser_compatibility |
| `stepDown` | `stepDecrement` | `void` | Decrements the value of a numeric type text field by `step` or `n` `step` number of times. |
| `stepUp` | `stepIncrement` | `void` | Increments the value of a numeric type text field by `step` or `n` `step` number of times. |
| `reset` | _None_ | `void` | Reset the text field to its default value. |
| `formResetCallback` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `formStateRestoreCallback` | `state` | `void` |  |
| `checkValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch an `invalid` event. |
| `reportValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch a cancelable `invalid` event. If not canceled, a the current `validationMessage` will be reported to the user. |
| `setCustomValidity` | `error` | `void` | Sets the element's constraint validation error message. When set to a non-empty string, `validity.customError` will be true and `validationMessage` will display the provided error.<br>Use this method to customize error messages reported. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `select` | `Event` | Yes | No | The native `select` event on [`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/select_event) |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | The native `change` event on [`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/change_event) |
| `input` | `InputEvent` | Yes | Yes | The native `input` event on [`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/input_event) |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `leading-icon` | Icons or icon buttons at the start, each in a 48px box. |
| `trailing-icon` | Icons or icon buttons at the end, each in a 48px box. |

File: docs/components/select.md

# Select

[Select menus](https://m3.material.io/components/menus/overview#b1704de4-94b7-4177-9e96-b677ae767cb4)
open a list of options and show the selected option in a field.

*   Design article (*coming soon*)
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/select)
    

## Usage

Select (also referred to as a dropdown menu) allows choosing a value from a
fixed list of available options. It is analogous to the native HTML
[`<select>` element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/select).

```html
<petal-outlined-select>
  <petal-select-option aria-label="blank"></petal-select-option>
  <petal-select-option selected value="apple">
    <div slot="headline">Apple</div>
  </petal-select-option>
  <petal-select-option value="apricot">
    <div slot="headline">Apricot</div>
  </petal-select-option>
</petal-outlined-select>

<petal-filled-select>
  <petal-select-option aria-label="blank"></petal-select-option>
  <petal-select-option value="apple">
    <div slot="headline">Apple</div>
  </petal-select-option>
  <petal-select-option value="apricot">
    <div slot="headline">Apricot</div>
  </petal-select-option>
</petal-filled-select>
```

### Required select

Indicate that a selection is mandatory by adding the `required` attribute.

```html
<petal-filled-select required>
  <petal-select-option value="one">
    <div slot="headline">One</div>
  </petal-select-option>
  <petal-select-option value="two">
    <div slot="headline">Two</div>
  </petal-select-option>
</petal-filled-select>
```

### Label, supporting text and errors

`label` is the floating label. `supporting-text` shows under the field.
`error` with `error-text` shows an error in its place, as for text fields; a
required select also shows the browser's message after `reportValidity()`.
`no-asterisk` hides the asterisk of a required select's label.

```html
<petal-outlined-select label="Country" supporting-text="Where you live" required>
  <petal-select-option value="jp"><div slot="headline">Japan</div></petal-select-option>
  <petal-select-option value="cn"><div slot="headline">China</div></petal-select-option>
</petal-outlined-select>

<petal-outlined-select label="Plan" error error-text="Choose a plan">
  ...
</petal-outlined-select>
```

### Value and events

The select is form-associated: with a `name`, its `value` (the selected
option's `value`) is submitted with its form, like a native `<select>`. Read
or set `value`, `selectedIndex`, or call `select(value)` or
`selectIndex(index)`. `selectedOptions` holds the selected
`petal-select-option`, and `displayText` its text.

The select fires `input` and `change` when the user picks an option (not when
`value` is set by script), and `opening`, `opened`, `closing` and `closed`
around its menu.

```js
const select = document.querySelector('petal-outlined-select');
select.addEventListener('change', () => console.log(select.value));
select.value = 'cn';
```

An option's text comes from its `headline` slot (or its text); set the
option's `displayText` property to show other text in the field. Options take
the `supporting-text`, `start` and `end` slots of list items, and `disabled`.

### Icons

Put an icon in the `leading-icon` slot. The `trailing-icon` slot replaces the
dropdown arrow.

```html
<petal-filled-select label="Language">
  <petal-icon slot="leading-icon">translate</petal-icon>
  ...
</petal-filled-select>
```

### Menu position

The menu opens in the top layer (`menu-positioning="popover"`, the default),
so it is not cut off by scrolling containers or dialogs. `menu-align="end"`
aligns it with the end of the field. `quick` opens it without the animation.

## Accessibility

Give the select a `label`, or an `aria-label` when there is no visible label.
Keyboard: Space, Enter and the arrow keys open the menu; typing a letter moves
to the next option that starts with it (`typeahead-delay` sets how long typed
letters are kept).

## Compose

Select follows Jetpack Compose Material 3's exposed dropdown menu
(`ExposedDropdownMenuBox`, `ExposedDropdownMenu` and
`ExposedDropdownMenuDefaults`):

*   The field is a text field with the values of `petal-filled-text-field` and
    `petal-outlined-text-field`: at least 280px wide, 56px high, a 2px focused
    indicator or outline, letter spacing on text, and no hover state.
*   The trailing icon is the arrow drop down icon, turned by 180 degrees while
    the menu is open. Compose does not animate the turn, and neither does the
    select. A `trailing-icon` slot replaces the arrow.
*   The menu is exactly as wide as the select (`matchAnchorWidth`) and starts
    at the bottom of the field, with no gap; above the field if there is no
    room below. It is at most as high as the larger of the spaces above and
    below the field, less 48px (`MenuVerticalMargin`), and scrolls. Set
    `no-clamp-menu-width` to let the menu be wider than the select.
*   Options are the items of a `DropdownMenu`: at least 48px high, with 16px of
    padding at the sides (`ExposedDropdownMenuDefaults.ItemContentPadding`;
    12px in a plain menu), and the label large text style. The menu itself is
    `petal-menu`, which opens by scaling from 80% like `DropdownMenu`.

Compose's exposed dropdown has no selected option state; `petal-select-option`
keeps showing the selected option with the secondary container, as a native
`<select>` does.

## Theming

Select supports
[Material theming](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/docs/theming/README.md)
and can be customized in terms of color, typography, and shape.

### Filled Select tokens

Token                                            | Default value
------------------------------------------------ | -------------
`--md-filled-select-text-field-container-color`  | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-highest`
`--md-filled-select-text-field-container-shape`  | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small`
`--md-filled-select-text-field-input-text-color` | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-filled-select-text-field-input-text-font`  | `--md-sys-typescale-body-large-font`

*   [Filled Select tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-filled-select.scss)
    

To theme the select's dropdown menu, use the `petal-menu` component tokens on the
`::part(menu)` selector.

### Outlined Select tokens

Token                                              | Default value
-------------------------------------------------- | -------------
`--md-outlined-select-text-field-outline-color`    | `--md-sys-color-outline`
`--md-outlined-select-text-field-container-shape`  | `--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small`
`--md-outlined-select-text-field-input-text-color` | `--md-sys-color-on-surface`
`--md-outlined-select-text-field-input-text-font`  | `--md-sys-typescale-body-large-font`

*   [Outlined Select tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-outlined-select.scss)
    

## API

### PetalFilledSelect <code>&lt;petal-filled-select&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `quick` | `quick` | `boolean` | `false` | Opens the menu synchronously with no animation. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the select is required. |
| `errorText` | `error-text` | `string` | `''` | The error message that replaces supporting text when `error` is true. If `errorText` is an empty string, then the supporting text will continue to show.<br>This error message overrides the error message displayed by `reportValidity()`. |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | The floating label for the field. |
| `noAsterisk` | `no-asterisk` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the asterisk on the floating label, when the select is required. |
| `supportingText` | `supporting-text` | `string` | `''` | Conveys additional information below the select, such as how it should be used. |
| `error` | `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Gets or sets whether or not the select is in a visually invalid state.<br>This error state overrides the error state controlled by `reportValidity()`. |
| `menuPositioning` | `menu-positioning` | `"absolute" \| "fixed" \| "popover"` | `'popover'` | Whether or not the underlying petal-menu should be position: fixed to display in a top-level manner, or position: absolute.<br>position:fixed is useful for cases where select is inside of another element with stacking context and hidden overflows such as `petal-dialog`. |
| `clampMenuWidth` | `clamp-menu-width` | `boolean` | `true` | Deprecated: the menu is as wide as the select by default, as Compose's `ExposedDropdownMenu` (`matchAnchorWidth`). Setting this changes nothing; use `noClampMenuWidth` to let the menu be wider than the select. |
| `noClampMenuWidth` | `no-clamp-menu-width` | `boolean` | `false` | Lets the menu be wider than the select when its options are. By default the menu is exactly as wide as the select (Compose's `ExposedDropdownMenu`, `matchAnchorWidth`). |
| `typeaheadDelay` | `typeahead-delay` | `number` | `DEFAULT_TYPEAHEAD_BUFFER_TIME` | The max time between the keystrokes of the typeahead select / menu behavior before it clears the typeahead buffer. |
| `hasLeadingIcon` | `has-leading-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the text field has a leading icon. Used for SSR. |
| `displayText` | `display-text` | `string` | `''` | Text to display in the field. Only set for SSR. |
| `menuAlign` | `menu-align` | `"start" \| "end"` | `'start'` | Whether the menu should be aligned to the start or the end of the select's textbox. |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `undefined` |  |
| `selectedIndex` | `selected-index` | `number` | `undefined` |  |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `undefined` | The HTML name to use in form submission. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Whether or not the element is disabled. |
| `options` |  | `SelectOption[]` | `undefined` |  |
| `selectedOptions` |  | `SelectOption[]` | `undefined` |  |
| `form` |  | `HTMLFormElement` | `undefined` | The associated form element with which this element's value will submit. |
| `labels` |  | `NodeList` | `undefined` | The labels this element is associated with. |
| `validity` |  | `ValidityState` | `undefined` | Returns a ValidityState object that represents the validity states of the element. |
| `validationMessage` |  | `string` | `undefined` | Returns a validation error message or an empty string if the element is valid. |
| `willValidate` |  | `boolean` | `undefined` | Returns whether an element will successfully validate based on forms validation rules and constraints.<br>Disabled and readonly elements will not validate. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `select` | `value` | `void` | Selects an option given the value of the option, and updates MdSelect's value. |
| `selectIndex` | `index` | `void` | Selects an option given the index of the option, and updates MdSelect's value. |
| `reset` | _None_ | `void` | Reset the select to its default value. |
| `showPicker` | _None_ | `void` | Shows the picker. If it's already open, this is a no-op. |
| `getUpdateComplete` | _None_ | `Promise<boolean>` |  |
| `formResetCallback` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `formStateRestoreCallback` | `state` | `void` |  |
| `click` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `checkValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch an `invalid` event. |
| `reportValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch a cancelable `invalid` event. If not canceled, a the current `validationMessage` will be reported to the user. |
| `setCustomValidity` | `error` | `void` | Sets the element's constraint validation error message. When set to a non-empty string, `validity.customError` will be true and `validationMessage` will display the provided error.<br>Use this method to customize error messages reported. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | The native `change` event on [`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/change_event) |
| `input` | `InputEvent` | Yes | Yes | The native `input` event on [`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/input_event) |
| `opening` | `Event` | No | No | Fired when the select's menu is about to open. |
| `opened` | `Event` | No | No | Fired when the select's menu has finished animations and opened. |
| `closing` | `Event` | No | No | Fired when the select's menu is about to close. |
| `closed` | `Event` | No | No | Fired when the select's menu has finished animations and closed. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The `petal-select-option`s. |
| `leading-icon` | An icon at the start of the field. |
| `trailing-icon` | Replaces the dropdown arrow at the end. |

### PetalOutlinedSelect <code>&lt;petal-outlined-select&gt;</code>


The same properties, methods, events and slots as PetalFilledSelect.

### PetalSelectOption <code>&lt;petal-select-option&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the item and makes it non-selectable and non-interactive. |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the item in the selected visual state when a submenu is opened. |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` | Form value of the option. |
| `type` |  | `string` | `'option' as const` |  |
| `typeaheadText` |  | `string` | `undefined` |  |
| `displayText` |  | `string` | `undefined` |  |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `close-menu` | `CustomEvent<{initiator: SelectOption, reason: Reason, itemPath: SelectOption[]}>` | Yes | Yes | Closes the encapsulating menu on closable interaction. |
| `request-selection` | `Event` | Yes | Yes | Requests the parent md-select to select this element (and deselect others if single-selection) when `selected` changed to `true`. |
| `request-deselection` | `Event` | Yes | Yes | Requests the parent md-select to deselect this element when `selected` changed to `false`. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _default_ | The headline, as text (the same as the `headline` slot). |
| `headline` | The main line of text. |
| `overline` | A short line above the headline. |
| `supporting-text` | Lines below the headline. |
| `trailing-supporting-text` | Short text at the end, such as a count or a time. |
| `start` | Content at the start: an icon, an avatar, an image or a control. |
| `end` | Content at the end: an icon or a control. |

File: docs/components/checkbox.md

# Checkbox

[Checkboxes](https://m3.material.io/components/checkbox)
select any number of items from a set, or turn a single option on or off.

There's one type of checkbox in Material. Use this selection control when the
user needs to select one or more options from a list.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/checkbox) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/checkbox)
    

## Usage

Checkboxes may be standalone, pre-checked, or indeterminate.

```html
<petal-checkbox touch-target="wrapper"></petal-checkbox>
<petal-checkbox touch-target="wrapper" checked></petal-checkbox>
<petal-checkbox touch-target="wrapper" indeterminate></petal-checkbox>
```

### Label

Associate a label with a checkbox using the `<label>` element.

```html
<label>
  <petal-checkbox touch-target="wrapper"></petal-checkbox>
  Checkbox one
</label>

<petal-checkbox id="checkbox-two" touch-target="wrapper"></petal-checkbox>
<label for="checkbox-two">Checkbox two</label>
```

### Forms and events

A checkbox is form-associated like `<input type="checkbox">`: with a `name`, a
checked checkbox submits its `value` (`on` by default), and `required` makes
the form invalid until it is checked. It fires `input` and `change` when the
user toggles it. `indeterminate` shows a dash (for a "select all" box) until
the user toggles it.

```html
<form>
  <label><petal-checkbox name="terms" required></petal-checkbox> I agree</label>
  <label><petal-checkbox name="topics" value="news" checked></petal-checkbox> News</label>
</form>
```

```js
checkbox.addEventListener('change', () => console.log(checkbox.checked));
```

## Accessibility

Add an
[`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label)
attribute to checkboxes without labels or checkboxes whose labels need to be
more descriptive.

```html
<petal-checkbox aria-label="Select all checkboxes"></petal-checkbox>

<label>
  <petal-checkbox aria-label="Agree to terms and conditions"></petal-checkbox>
  Agree
</label>
```

> Note: checkboxes are not automatically labelled by `<label>` elements and
> always need an `aria-label`. See b/294081528.

## Compose behavior

The checkbox follows Jetpack Compose Material 3: a 20dp box with a 2dp outline, and the checkmark is drawn as a path (default spatial spring) that morphs into the indeterminate dash. Colors animate with the effects springs and do not change on hover, focus or press (only the ripple does). There is no error state in Compose.

## Theming

Checkbox supports [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized
in terms of color and shape.

### Tokens

Token                                    | Default value
---------------------------------------- | -----------------------------------
`--md-checkbox-outline-color`            | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-checkbox-selected-container-color` | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-checkbox-selected-icon-color`      | `--md-sys-color-on-primary`
`--md-checkbox-container-shape`          | `2px`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-checkbox.scss)
    

## API

### PetalCheckbox <code>&lt;petal-checkbox&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the checkbox is selected. |
| `indeterminate` | `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the checkbox is indeterminate. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | When true, require the checkbox to be selected when participating in form submission. |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `'on'` | The value of the checkbox that is submitted with a form when selected. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `undefined` | The HTML name to use in form submission. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Whether or not the element is disabled. |
| `form` |  | `HTMLFormElement` | `undefined` | The associated form element with which this element's value will submit. |
| `labels` |  | `NodeList` | `undefined` | The labels this element is associated with. |
| `validity` |  | `ValidityState` | `undefined` | Returns a ValidityState object that represents the validity states of the element. |
| `validationMessage` |  | `string` | `undefined` | Returns a validation error message or an empty string if the element is valid. |
| `willValidate` |  | `boolean` | `undefined` | Returns whether an element will successfully validate based on forms validation rules and constraints.<br>Disabled and readonly elements will not validate. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formResetCallback` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `formStateRestoreCallback` | `state` | `void` |  |
| `checkValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch an `invalid` event. |
| `reportValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch a cancelable `invalid` event. If not canceled, a the current `validationMessage` will be reported to the user. |
| `setCustomValidity` | `error` | `void` | Sets the element's constraint validation error message. When set to a non-empty string, `validity.customError` will be true and `validationMessage` will display the provided error.<br>Use this method to customize error messages reported. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | The native `change` event on [`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/change_event) |
| `input` | `InputEvent` | Yes | Yes | The native `input` event on [`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/input_event) |

File: docs/components/radio.md

# Radio button

[Radio buttons](https://m3.material.io/components/radio-button)
select exactly one option from a set.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/radio-button) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/radio)
    

## Usage

Radios behave like
[`<input type="radio">`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/radio)
elements and form a group with the same `name` attribute. Only one radio can be
selected in a group.

Radios can be pre-selected by adding a `checked` attribute.

Add a `value` to identify which radio is selected in a form.

```html
<form>
  <petal-radio name="animals" value="cats"></petal-radio>
  <petal-radio name="animals" value="dogs"></petal-radio>
  <petal-radio name="animals" value="birds" checked></petal-radio>
</form>
```

### Label

Associate a label with a radio using the `<label>` element.

```html
<petal-radio id="cats-radio" name="animals" value="cats"></petal-radio>
<label for="cats-radio">Cats</label>

<petal-radio id="dogs-radio" name="animals" value="dogs"></petal-radio>
<label for="dogs-radio">Dogs</label>
```

> Note: do not wrap radios inside of a `<label>`, which stops screen readers
> from correctly announcing the number of radios in a group.

### Forms and events

Radios with the same `name` form a group, in the same form or document. The
checked radio's `value` is submitted with the form; `required` on a radio of
the group makes the form invalid until one is checked. Arrow keys move the
selection within the group. A radio fires `input` and `change` when the user
checks it; read `checked` and `value`.

```js
form.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
  if (event.target.name === 'animals') console.log(event.target.value);
});
```

## Accessibility

Add an
[`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label)
attribute to radios without labels or radios whose labels need to be more
descriptive.

Place radios inside a
[`role="radiogroup"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Roles/radiogroup_role).
Radio groups must display a label, either with `aria-label` or
`aria-labelledby`.

```html
<div role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="group-title">
  <h3 id="group-title">Starting position</h3>
  <div>
    <petal-radio id="first-radio" name="group" value="1"
        aria-label="First"></petal-radio>
    <label for="first-radio">1st</label>
  </div>
  <div>
    <petal-radio id="second-radio" name="group" value="2"
        aria-label="Second"></petal-radio>
    <label for="second-radio">2nd</label>
  </div>
</div>
```

> Note: radios are not automatically labelled by `<label>` elements and always
> need an `aria-label`. See b/294081528.

## Compose behavior

The radio button follows Jetpack Compose Material 3: a 20dp ring with a 2dp stroke and a dot that grows with the fast spatial spring. The ring and dot are one color that animates with the default effects spring and does not change on hover, focus or press (only the ripple does).

## Theming

Radios support [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized in
terms of color.

### Tokens

Token                            | Default value
-------------------------------- | -----------------------------------
`--md-radio-icon-color`          | `--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant`
`--md-radio-selected-icon-color` | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-radio-icon-size`           | `20px`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-radio.scss)
    

## API

### PetalRadio <code>&lt;petal-radio&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not the radio is required. If any radio is required in a group, all radios are implicitly required. |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `'on'` | The element value to use in form submission when checked. |
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `undefined` |  |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `undefined` | The HTML name to use in form submission. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Whether or not the element is disabled. |
| `form` |  | `HTMLFormElement` | `undefined` | The associated form element with which this element's value will submit. |
| `labels` |  | `NodeList` | `undefined` | The labels this element is associated with. |
| `validity` |  | `ValidityState` | `undefined` | Returns a ValidityState object that represents the validity states of the element. |
| `validationMessage` |  | `string` | `undefined` | Returns a validation error message or an empty string if the element is valid. |
| `willValidate` |  | `boolean` | `undefined` | Returns whether an element will successfully validate based on forms validation rules and constraints.<br>Disabled and readonly elements will not validate. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formResetCallback` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `formStateRestoreCallback` | `state` | `void` |  |
| `checkValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch an `invalid` event. |
| `reportValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch a cancelable `invalid` event. If not canceled, a the current `validationMessage` will be reported to the user. |
| `setCustomValidity` | `error` | `void` | Sets the element's constraint validation error message. When set to a non-empty string, `validity.customError` will be true and `validationMessage` will display the provided error.<br>Use this method to customize error messages reported. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `InputEvent` | Yes | No | Dispatched when the value changes from user interaction. |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | Yes | Dispatched when the value changes from user interaction. |

# Switch

[Switches](https://m3.material.io/components/switch)
turn a single setting on or off.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/switch) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/switch)
    

## Usage

Switches are similar to checkboxes, and can be unselected or selected.

```html
<petal-switch></petal-switch>
<petal-switch selected></petal-switch>
```

### Icons

Icons can be used to visually emphasize the switch's selected state. Switches
can choose to display both icons or only selected icons.

```html
<petal-switch icons></petal-switch>
<petal-switch icons selected></petal-switch>

<petal-switch icons show-only-selected-icon></petal-switch>
<petal-switch icons show-only-selected-icon selected></petal-switch>
```

### Label

Associate a label with a switch using the `<label>` element.

```html
<label>
  Wi-Fi
  <petal-switch selected></petal-switch>
</label>

<label for="switch">Bluetooth</label>
<petal-switch id="switch"></petal-switch>
```

### Mouse hover

With a mouse or trackpad, the hovered thumb goes 30% of the way to its pressed
size (28px): from 16px to about 20px when off, from 24px to about 25px when on.
It moves on the thumb's own spring. This is a petal-elements addition; touch
screens keep Compose's look.

### Forms and events

A switch is form-associated like a checkbox: with a `name`, a selected switch
submits its `value` (`on` by default), and `required` makes the form invalid
until it is selected. Read or set `selected`. It fires `input` and `change`
when the user toggles it.

```html
<label>
  Wi-Fi
  <petal-switch name="wifi" selected></petal-switch>
</label>
```

```js
const wifi = document.querySelector('petal-switch[name="wifi"]');
wifi.addEventListener('change', () => console.log(wifi.selected));
```

## Accessibility

Add an
[`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label)
attribute to switches without labels or switches whose labels need to be more
descriptive.

```html
<petal-switch aria-label="Lights"></petal-switch>

<label>
  All
  <petal-switch aria-label="All notifications"></petal-switch>
</label>
```

> Note: switches are not automatically labelled by `<label>` elements and always
> need an `aria-label`. See b/294081528.

## Compose behavior

The switch follows Jetpack Compose Material 3: the thumb moves and resizes with the fast spatial spring (it overshoots), snaps to the pressed size on press, and the thumb color does not change on hover, focus or press. Colors and icons change without animation.

## Theming

Switches supports [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized
in terms of color and shape.

### Tokens

Token                               | Default value
----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------
`--md-switch-handle-color`          | `--md-sys-color-outline`
`--md-switch-handle-shape`          | `--md-sys-shape-corner-full`
`--md-switch-track-color`           | `--md-sys-color-surface-container-highest`
`--md-switch-track-shape`           | `--md-sys-shape-corner-full`
`--md-switch-selected-handle-color` | `--md-sys-color-on-primary`
`--md-switch-selected-track-color`  | `--md-sys-color-primary`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/tokens/_md-comp-switch.scss)
    

## API

### PetalSwitch <code>&lt;petal-switch&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Puts the switch in the selected state and sets the form submission value to the `value` property. |
| `icons` | `icons` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows both the selected and deselected icons. |
| `showOnlySelectedIcon` | `show-only-selected-icon` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows only the selected icon, and not the deselected icon. If `true`, overrides the behavior of the `icons` property. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | When true, require the switch to be selected when participating in form submission. |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `'on'` | The value associated with this switch on form submission. `null` is submitted when `selected` is `false`. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `undefined` | The HTML name to use in form submission. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Whether or not the element is disabled. |
| `form` |  | `HTMLFormElement` | `undefined` | The associated form element with which this element's value will submit. |
| `labels` |  | `NodeList` | `undefined` | The labels this element is associated with. |
| `validity` |  | `ValidityState` | `undefined` | Returns a ValidityState object that represents the validity states of the element. |
| `validationMessage` |  | `string` | `undefined` | Returns a validation error message or an empty string if the element is valid. |
| `willValidate` |  | `boolean` | `undefined` | Returns whether an element will successfully validate based on forms validation rules and constraints.<br>Disabled and readonly elements will not validate. |

#### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formResetCallback` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `formStateRestoreCallback` | `state` | `void` |  |
| `checkValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch an `invalid` event. |
| `reportValidity` | _None_ | `boolean` | Checks the element's constraint validation and returns true if the element is valid or false if not.<br>If invalid, this method will dispatch a cancelable `invalid` event. If not canceled, a the current `validationMessage` will be reported to the user. |
| `setCustomValidity` | `error` | `void` | Sets the element's constraint validation error message. When set to a non-empty string, `validity.customError` will be true and `validationMessage` will display the provided error.<br>Use this method to customize error messages reported. |

#### Events

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `InputEvent` | No | No | Fired whenever `selected` changes due to user interaction (bubbles and composed). |
| `change` | `Event` | No | No | Fired whenever `selected` changes due to user interaction (bubbles). |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `on-icon` | The icon in the thumb while selected (with `icons`); a check mark by default. |
| `off-icon` | The icon in the thumb while not selected (with `icons` and without `show-only-selected-icon`); a cross by default. |

File: docs/components/slider.md

# Sliders

[Sliders](https://m3.material.io/components/sliders)
pick a value, or a range of values, along a track. Volume and brightness
controls are typical uses.

Sliders can use icons or labels to represent a numeric or relative scale.

*   [Design article](https://m3.material.io/components/sliders) 
*   [API Documentation](#api)
*   [Source code](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/tree/main/slider)
    

## Usage

Sliders may be continuous or discrete, and may also represent a range.

```html
<petal-slider></petal-slider>
<petal-slider ticks value="50"></petal-slider>
<petal-slider range value-start="25" value-end="75"></petal-slider>
```

### Continuous

Allows users to select a value along a subjective range.

```html
<petal-slider min="0" max="100" value="50"></petal-slider>
```

### Discrete

Allows users to select a specific value from a predetermined range. Tick marks
may be used to indicate available values.

```html
<petal-slider step="5" ticks min="0" max="20"></petal-slider>
```

### Range

A range slider has two handles, and indicates a minimum and maximum value in a
range.

```html
<petal-slider range value-start="25" value-end="50"></petal-slider>
```

### Value label

A value label displays the specific value that corresponds with the handle's
placement.

The label appears while the handle is hovered, pressed or dragged, and while it
has keyboard focus. For range sliders, each handle has its own label.

```html
<petal-slider labeled></petal-slider>
```

`value-label` replaces the number shown in the label, for example with a
unit; set it as the value changes. A range slider takes `value-label-start`
and `value-label-end`.

```js
const slider = document.querySelector('petal-slider');
slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
  slider.valueLabel = `${slider.value}%`;
});
```

### Value, forms and events

`value` is a number between `min` and `max`, on multiples of `step`; a range
slider has `value-start` and `value-end` instead. The slider fires `input`
while it is dragged and `change` when it is let go, like a native range input.

It is form-associated: with a `name` it submits `value`. A range slider
submits two values: under `name-start` and `name-end`, or both under `name`.

```html
<form>
  <petal-slider name="volume" value="40" labeled></petal-slider>
  <petal-slider range name-start="min-price" name-end="max-price"
      min="0" max="500" step="10" value-start="100" value-end="300"></petal-slider>
</form>
```

## Accessibility

Name the slider with `aria-label` (or a `<label>`). A range slider names its
handles with `aria-label-start` and `aria-label-end`, and can read out other
text than the number with `aria-valuetext-start` and `aria-valuetext-end`
(`aria-valuetext` for a single handle). The arrow keys move the handle by
`step`; Page Up and Page Down by a larger amount; Home and End to the ends.

## Compose behavior

Sliders follow Jetpack Compose Material 3 Expressive (`Slider`, `RangeSlider`,
`SliderTokens`):

*   The handle is a 4dp x 44dp bar, half as wide while it is pressed, dragged or
    focused. There is no ripple or state layer.
*   The track is 16dp high with fully rounded ends, and stops 6dp before the
    handle on each side; the ends next to the handle have 2dp corners. A part
    of the track narrower than its corner is not drawn.
*   A 4dp stop indicator in the active track color marks the end of the
    inactive track (both ends of a range slider). Ticks are 4dp dots, with
    values between the first and the last tick inset by the track's corner
    radius, as in Compose.
*   The value label is a plain tooltip (inverse surface, 4dp corners) 4dp above
    the handle, as in Compose's slider samples. Compose shows it on hover,
    press and drag; petal-elements also shows it on keyboard focus.

## Theming

Slider supports [Material theming](../theming/README.md) and can be customized
in terms of color and shape.

### Tokens

Token                                      | Default value
------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------
`--md-slider-active-track-color`           | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-slider-active-track-height`          | `16px`
`--md-slider-inactive-track-color`         | `--md-sys-color-secondary-container`
`--md-slider-handle-color`                 | `--md-sys-color-primary`
`--md-slider-handle-width`                 | `4px`
`--md-slider-pressed-handle-width`         | `2px`
`--md-slider-handle-height`                | `44px`
`--md-slider-handle-shape`                 | `--md-sys-shape-corner-full`
`--md-slider-with-tick-marks-container-size` | `4px`
`--md-slider-label-container-color`        | `--md-sys-color-inverse-surface`
`--md-slider-label-text-color`             | `--md-sys-color-inverse-on-surface`

*   [All tokens](https://github.com/Saki340/petal-elements/blob/main/slider/internal/_slider.scss)
    

## API

### PetalSlider <code>&lt;petal-slider&gt;</code>

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | `min` | `number` | `0` | The slider minimum value |
| `max` | `max` | `number` | `100` | The slider maximum value |
| `value` | `value` | `number` | `undefined` | The slider value displayed when range is false. |
| `valueStart` | `value-start` | `number` | `undefined` | The slider start value displayed when range is true. |
| `valueEnd` | `value-end` | `number` | `undefined` | The slider end value displayed when range is true. |
| `valueLabel` | `value-label` | `string` | `''` | An optional label for the slider's value displayed when range is false; if not set, the label is the value itself. |
| `valueLabelStart` | `value-label-start` | `string` | `''` | An optional label for the slider's start value displayed when range is true; if not set, the label is the valueStart itself. |
| `valueLabelEnd` | `value-label-end` | `string` | `''` | An optional label for the slider's end value displayed when range is true; if not set, the label is the valueEnd itself. |
| `ariaLabelStart` | `aria-label-start` | `string` | `''` | Aria label for the slider's start handle displayed when range is true. |
| `ariaValueTextStart` | `aria-valuetext-start` | `string` | `''` | Aria value text for the slider's start value displayed when range is true. |
| `ariaLabelEnd` | `aria-label-end` | `string` | `''` | Aria label for the slider's end handle displayed when range is true. |
| `ariaValueTextEnd` | `aria-valuetext-end` | `string` | `''` | Aria value text for the slider's end value displayed when range is true. |
| `step` | `step` | `number` | `1` | The step between values. |
| `ticks` | `ticks` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not to show tick marks. |
| `labeled` | `labeled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not to show a value label when activated. |
| `range` | `range` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether or not to show a value range. When false, the slider displays a slideable handle for the value property; when true, it displays slideable handles for the valueStart and valueEnd properties. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `undefined` | The HTML name to use in form submission. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Whether or not the element is disabled. |
| `nameStart` |  | `string` | `undefined` |  |
| `nameEnd` |  | `string` | `undefined` |  |
| `form` |  | `HTMLFormElement` | `undefined` | The associated form element with which this element's value will submit. |
| `labels` |  | `NodeList` | `undefined` | The labels this element is associated with. |

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formResetCallback` | _None_ | `void` |  |
| `formStateRestoreCallback` | `state` | `void` |  |

| Event | Type | [Bubbles](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/bubbles) | [Composed](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/composed) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `Event` | Yes | No | The native `change` event on [`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/change_event) |
| `input` | `InputEvent` | Yes | Yes | The native `input` event on [`<input>`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/input_event) |
